seg.2b6b229e651e.src: FSSAI's standard says turmeric powder must be free from added colouring matter, including lead chromate, and from foreign starch. Its testing manual lists what inspectors check turmeric for: added dyes such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.
seg.2b6b229e651e.t: FSSAI-मानकं वदति यत् हरिद्राचूर्णं योजितैः रञ्जकद्रव्यैः, लेड-क्रोमेट इत्यनेन सह, बाह्यश्वेतसारेण च रहितं भवेत्। तस्य परीक्षणपुस्तिका निरीक्षकाः हरिद्रायां यत् परीक्षन्ते तत् सूचयति: मेटानिल्-येलो इत्यादयः योजिताः रञ्जकाः, सीसलवणानि, खटिकाचूर्णं च।
seg.2b6b229e651e.back: The FSSAI standard says that turmeric powder should be free of added colouring substances, including lead chromate, and of external starch. Its testing manual indicates what inspectors test for in turmeric: added colourants such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.

seg.b27088069a9d.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen, and some only a lab can find. This guide covers both, plus two popular tests that do not work for turmeric. Try them on any turmeric you buy, ours included.
seg.b27088069a9d.t: एतेषु किञ्चित् भवान् पाकशालायां परीक्षितुं शक्नोति, किञ्चित् तु केवलं प्रयोगशाला एव ज्ञातुं शक्नोति। एषा मार्गदर्शिका उभयं वर्णयति, तथा द्वे प्रसिद्धे परीक्षे अपि ये हरिद्रायै न कार्यं कुरुतः। भवान् यां कामपि हरिद्रां क्रीणाति, तस्याम् एताः परीक्षाः करोतु, अस्माकं हरिद्रायाम् अपि।
seg.b27088069a9d.back: Some of these you can test in the kitchen, but some only a laboratory can detect. This guide describes both, and also two well-known tests that do not work for turmeric. Do these tests on whatever turmeric you buy, on our turmeric too.

seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.src: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water with the powder settled at the bottom. Right: strong yellow water with yellow trails running down from the powder.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.t: हरिद्रापरीक्षायाः अनन्तरं जलस्य द्वे काचपात्रे। वामे: तले स्थितचूर्णेन सह पाण्डुपीतं जलम्। दक्षिणे: चूर्णात् अधः प्रवहन्तीभिः पीतरेखाभिः सह गाढपीतं जलम्।
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.back: Two glass vessels of water after the turmeric test. On the left: pale yellow water with powder settled at the bottom. On the right: deep yellow water with yellow streaks flowing down from the powder.

seg.c8b6eb5f9530.src: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is pale yellow. Right: strong yellow trails ran from the powder as it sank, and the water turned deep yellow. That one is worth a lab test.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.t: ⟦1⟧जलपरीक्षा⟦/1⟧वामे: चूर्णं तले स्थितम्, जलं च पाण्डुपीतम्। दक्षिणे: निमज्जतः चूर्णात् गाढपीतरेखाः प्रावहन्, जलं च गाढपीतं जातम्। तत् प्रयोगशालापरीक्षायोग्यम्।
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.back: ⟦1⟧Water test⟦/1⟧On the left: the powder settled at the bottom, and the water pale yellow. On the right: deep yellow streaks flowed from the sinking powder, and the water became deep yellow. That is fit for laboratory testing.

seg.a7363cc3fa37.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that turns strong yellow straight away points to added colour. This check cannot find lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer, use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric is starchy to begin with.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.t: एकं लघुचमसं हरिद्रां जलपूर्णे काचपात्रे प्रकिरतु, अचालयित्वा स्थिरीभवितुं त्यजतु। हरिद्रा निमज्जति, जलं च पाण्डुपीतं त्यजति; यत् जलं तत्क्षणं गाढपीतं भवति, तत् योजितवर्णं सूचयति। एषा परीक्षा लेड-क्रोमेटं खटिकां वा ज्ञातुं न शक्नोति, अतः निश्चितोत्तराय खाद्यपरीक्षणप्रयोगशालाम् उपयोजयतु। आयोडीन-परीक्षां त्यजतु: हरिद्रायां मूलतः एव श्वेतसारः अस्ति।
seg.a7363cc3fa37.back: Sprinkle one small spoon of turmeric onto a glass vessel full of water, and leave it to settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that immediately becomes deep yellow indicates added colour. This test cannot detect lead chromate or chalk, so for a definite answer use a food testing laboratory. Skip the iodine test: turmeric has starch from the root (from the root itself).

seg.9b20e15186d4.back: What FSSAI tests for in turmeric

seg.34d6f989bfaf.src: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow added colour in turmeric.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.t: यथा मेटानिल्-येलो, यत् निष्प्रभां हरिद्रां दीप्ततरां दर्शयितुं शक्नोति। FSSAI हरिद्रायां योजितवर्णं न अनुमन्यते।
seg.34d6f989bfaf.back: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric appear brighter. FSSAI does not permit added colour in turmeric.

seg.042cabe54b01.src: Lead chromate and other lead salts
seg.042cabe54b01.back: Lead chromate and other lead salts

seg.8310b11eab8b.src: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.
seg.8310b11eab8b.t: लेड-क्रोमेट वर्णलेपे उपयुज्यमानः पीतवर्णकः। स्टैनफर्ड-नेतृत्वे 2019 तमे 2024 तमे च वर्षे प्रकाशितैः अध्ययनैः दक्षिण-एशियायाः केषुचित् भागेषु हरिद्रायां सः प्राप्तः। FSSAI हरिद्रायां तं सर्वथा न अनुमन्यते।
seg.8310b11eab8b.back: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Through Stanford-led studies published in the years 2019 and 2024, it was found in turmeric in some parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not permit it in turmeric at all.

seg.4278e7c5416c.src: A cheap white powder that adds weight.
seg.4278e7c5416c.back: A low-priced white powder that increases weight.

seg.5a8b446bbce0.src: Flour or starch from other crops. FSSAI's standard rules it out too.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.t: अन्यसस्यानां पिष्टं श्वेतसारः वा। FSSAI-मानकं तम् अपि निषेधति।
seg.5a8b446bbce0.back: Flour or starch of other crops. The FSSAI standard forbids that too.

seg.1b1af7f63ffd.src: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.back: Fill a transparent glass vessel with water of room temperature.

seg.653731f2ed6f.src: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.653731f2ed6f.t: उपरि एकं समतलं लघुचमसं हरिद्राचूर्णं प्रकिरतु। मा चालयतु।
seg.653731f2ed6f.back: Sprinkle one level small spoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.

seg.ea5b43cf8436.src: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks. Look for coloured trails running down from it.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.t: चूर्णे निमज्जति सति प्रथमं निमेषं पश्यतु। तस्मात् अधः प्रवहन्तीः वर्णरेखाः अन्विष्यतु।
seg.ea5b43cf8436.back: While the powder sinks, watch the first minute. Look for colour streaks flowing down from it.

seg.e37698aaa3fb.src: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass against a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.t: 15 तः 20 निमेषान् यावत् त्यजतु। ततः काचपात्रं श्वेतभित्तेः पत्रस्य वा पुरतः धृत्वा स्थितचूर्णस्य उपरि जलं पश्यतु।
seg.e37698aaa3fb.back: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then, holding the glass vessel in front of a white wall or a sheet, look at the water above the settled powder.

seg.e8937cebf136.src: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom
seg.e8937cebf136.back: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom

seg.7253b4d90896.back: There is no sign of added colourant.

seg.256ce5cf303d.src: Strong yellow trails, or deep yellow water within minutes
seg.256ce5cf303d.t: गाढपीतरेखाः, अथवा निमेषेषु एव गाढपीतं जलम्
seg.256ce5cf303d.back: Deep yellow streaks, or deep yellow water within minutes

seg.ce06c8148072.src: Possible added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.ce06c8148072.t: योजितवर्णः सम्भवति। तस्य बैचस्य उपयोगं स्थगयतु, तत् परीक्षयतु च।
seg.ce06c8148072.back: Added colour is possible. Stop using that batch, and get it tested.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧किमर्थम् एतत् कार्यं करोति।⟦/1⟧ हरिद्रायाः स्वकीयः पीतवर्णः, कर्क्युमिन्, जले प्रायः न विलीयते, अतः चूर्णं निमज्जति जलं च केवलम् ईषत् रञ्जयति। मेटानिल्-येलो इत्यादयः रञ्जकाः सुकरं विलीयन्ते जलं च शीघ्रं रञ्जयन्ति।
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and colours the water only slightly. Colourants such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water quickly.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧किं न ज्ञायते।⟦/1⟧ लेड-क्रोमेट खटिका च अपि जले न विलीयेते, अतः ताभ्यां मिश्रिता हरिद्रा एतां परीक्षाम् उत्तरेत्। केवलं प्रयोगशालापरीक्षा एव ते निराकर्तुं शक्नोति।
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What is not detected.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, so turmeric mixed with them would pass this test. Only a laboratory test can rule them out.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: अतिसूक्ष्मं चूर्णं कञ्चित् कालं जलम् आविलं रक्षेत्। आविलं जलं न दोषः; पारदर्शकं गाढपीतं जलम् एव द्रष्टव्यम्।
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: Very fine powder may keep the water cloudy for some time. Cloudy water is not a fault; only transparent deep yellow water is what is to be watched for.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Test 2: If you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: शुष्कहरिद्रायाः एकम् अङ्गुलिखण्डं द्विधा भनक्तु। हरिद्रा आद्यन्तं पीत-नारङ्गवर्णा, अतः अन्तर्भागः बहिर्भागसदृशः एव दृश्येत। पाण्डुवर्णस्य निष्प्रभस्य वा अन्तर्भागस्य उपरि दीप्तपीता त्वक् पृष्ठे वर्णः योजितः इति सूचयेत्। विक्रेतारं तद्विषये पृच्छतु, अथवा तत् परीक्षयतु।
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break one finger-piece of dry turmeric in two. Turmeric is yellow-orange from beginning to end, so the inner part should look just like the outer part. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull inner part would indicate that colour was added on the surface. Ask the seller about that, or get it tested.

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: आयोडीन श्वेतसारेण संयुक्तं नील-कृष्णवर्णं भवति, हरिद्रायां पिष्टस्य अन्वेषणाय च प्रायः सूच्यते। किन्तु हरिद्रा स्वयं श्वेतसारयुक्ता, अतः उभयथा अपि नील-कृष्णा भवति। अत एव FSSAI इत्यस्य स्वीया पुस्तिका हरिद्रां विहाय अन्येषु चूर्णितमसालेषु आयोडीन-परीक्षाम् उपयुङ्क्ते।
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: Iodine combined with starch becomes blue-black in colour, and it is often suggested for detecting flour in turmeric. But turmeric itself contains starch, so it becomes blue-black either way. For that very reason FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test on ground spices other than turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: हरिद्रायां सीसस्य, मेटानिल्-येलो इत्यस्य, खटिकायाः च FSSAI-परीक्षाः सान्द्रं हाइड्रोक्लोरिक-अम्लं सल्फ्यूरिक-अम्लं वा उपयुञ्जते। एते अम्लाः त्वचं नेत्रे च दहन्ति। ते प्रयोगशालायाम् एव उचिताः, न पाकशालायाम्।
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric acid or sulphuric acid. These acids burn the skin and the eyes. They are proper only in a laboratory, not in the kitchen.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: For a definite answer: a food testing laboratory

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABL-मान्यताप्राप्ता खाद्यपरीक्षणप्रयोगशाला हरिद्रायां सीसं योजितवर्णान् च परीक्षितुं शक्नोति। प्रयोगशालां पृच्छतु कियान् प्रतिदर्शः आवश्यकः, चूर्णं तस्य मुद्राबद्धे पुटके स्वच्छे मुद्राबद्धे स्यूते वा रक्षतु, पुटके मुद्रितां बैच-सङ्ख्यां च लिखतु। FSSAI स्वजालस्थाने अधिसूचितानां खाद्यपरीक्षणप्रयोगशालानां सूचीं प्रकाशयति।
seg.1883beca4d73.back: An NABL-accredited food testing laboratory can test turmeric for lead and added colours. Ask the laboratory how much sample is needed, keep the powder in its sealed packet or in a clean sealed bag, and write down the batch number printed on the packet. FSSAI publishes the list of notified food testing laboratories on its website.

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: FSSAI अनुज्ञापत्रसङ्ख्या पञ्जीकरणसङ्ख्या वा। ताम् FSSAI इत्यस्य FoSCoS जालस्थाने अन्वेष्टुं शक्नोति।
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: An FSSAI licence number or registration number. You can search it on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: येन निर्मितं पुटीकृतं वा तस्य नाम सङ्केतः च।
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: The name and address of the one by whom it was made or packed.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: निवलपरिमाणम्, MRP, बैच-सङ्ख्या लॉट-सङ्ख्या वा, श्रेष्ठोपयोगतिथिः च।
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Net quantity, MRP, batch number or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: कुत्र उत्पादितम्। भिन्नप्रदेशानां हरिद्रा वर्णे भिद्यते, अतः नामाङ्कितः प्रदेशः समानस्य समानेन तुलनायां साहाय्यं करोति।
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was produced. Turmeric of different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps in comparing like with like.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: पुटकं जिप् बद्धं रक्षतु, अथवा चूर्णं शुष्कं वायुरोधकं पात्रं प्रति नयतु।
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the packet zip closed, or move the powder into a dry, airtight vessel.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: शुष्कं चमसम् उपयोजयतु। आर्द्रः चमसः एव हरिद्रां पिण्डितां करोति।
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. It is a wet spoon that makes turmeric lumpy.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: तां साक्षात् सूर्यातपात् दूरे रक्षतु, यः वर्णं म्लानयति।
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Keep it away from direct sunlight, which fades the colour.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: न स्वयमेव। वर्णः प्रकारेण, उत्पत्तिस्थानेन, शोषण-पेषण-रीत्या च परिवर्तते, अतः हरिद्राः बहु भिद्यन्ते। द्रष्टव्यं तु एतत् यत् वर्णः चूर्णात् अतिसुकरं निर्गच्छति वा न वा, यथा जलपरीक्षायाम्।
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not by itself. The colour changes with the variety, the place of origin, and the method of drying and grinding, so turmerics differ a lot. What is to be seen is whether the colour comes out of the powder very easily or not, as in the water test.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: हरिद्रायां सीसं नास्ति इति जलपरीक्षा दर्शयितुं शक्नोति किम्?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can the water test show that there is no lead in turmeric?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: न। लेड-क्रोमेट जले न विलीयते, अतः जलपरीक्षा तं द्रष्टुं न शक्नोति। केवलं प्रयोगशालापरीक्षा एव शक्नोति।
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water test cannot see it. Only a laboratory test can.

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: आर्द्रता। आर्द्रः चमसः विवृतं पुटकं वा चूर्णं जलं ग्राहयति। शुष्कचमसेन पिण्डान् भनक्तु, पुटकं च बद्धं रक्षतु।
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open packet makes the powder absorb water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon, and keep the packet closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.t: यदि काचित् परीक्षा अनुचिता दृश्यते, तर्हि किं करवाणि?
seg.87fe2929801d.back: If some test appears improper, then what should I do?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.t: तस्य बैचस्य उपयोगं स्थगयतु, पुटकं रक्षतु, बैच-सङ्ख्यया सह विक्रेतारं सम्पर्कयतु। FSSAI इत्यस्य Food Safety Connect अनुप्रयोगेन अपि सूचयितुं शक्नोति। यदि सा अस्माकं हरिद्रा, तर्हि पुटकस्य काचपात्रस्य च चित्रं WhatsApp द्वारा अस्मभ्यं प्रेषयतु।
seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using that batch, keep the packet, contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report through FSSAI's Food Safety Connect application. If it is our turmeric, then send us a picture of the packet and the glass vessel through WhatsApp.

seg.1dd4194330b1.src: Try these checks on ours too. If anything looks off, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number from the pack.
seg.1dd4194330b1.t: अस्माकं हरिद्रायाम् अपि एताः परीक्षाः करोतु। यदि किमपि अनुचितं दृश्यते, पुटकस्य बैच-सङ्ख्यया सह चित्रं ⟦1⟧WhatsApp द्वारा अस्मभ्यं प्रेषयतु⟦/1⟧।
seg.1dd4194330b1.back: Do these tests on our turmeric too. If anything appears improper, ⟦1⟧send us through WhatsApp⟦/1⟧ a picture with the packet's batch number.

seg.d25dae4babde.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · आन्ध्र कोडि कूरा · आन्ध्र चिकन करी
seg.d25dae4babde.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Andhra Kodi Koora · Andhra Chicken Curry

seg.91bce9460ade.src: Kodi kura is the chicken curry that fills Andhra homes on a Sunday afternoon: bone-in chicken marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked down in a gravy of deep-golden onions and tomatoes, and finished with garam masala. It goes to the table with hot rice, and the leftovers with dosa or chapati at night.
seg.91bce9460ade.t: कोडि कूरा इति तत् कुक्कुटमांसव्यञ्जनं यत् रविवासरस्य अपराह्णे आन्ध्रगृहेषु पच्यते: सास्थि कुक्कुटमांसं रक्तमरिचेन हरिद्रया च लिप्त्वा, गाढसुवर्णवर्णैः पलाण्डुभिः टमाटाभिः च कृते रसे पक्त्वा, अन्ते गरम-मसाला योज्यते। उष्णेन ओदनेन सह परिवेष्यते, अवशिष्टं च रात्रौ दोसया चपात्या वा सह।
seg.91bce9460ade.back: Kodi koora is that chicken curry which is cooked in Andhra homes on Sunday afternoon: bone-in chicken is smeared with red chilli and turmeric, cooked in a gravy made of deep-golden onions and tomatoes, and at the end garam masala is added. It is served with hot rice, and the leftover at night with dosa or chapati.

seg.2422ebb922bc.src: The heat here comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli that gives Andhra curries their bite and bright red colour, with our turmeric powder in the marinade. This recipe serves 4 and is properly fiery; the tips say how to scale it down.
seg.2422ebb922bc.t: अत्र तीक्ष्णता अस्माकं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णात् आगच्छति, गुण्टूरस्य अतितीक्ष्णः रक्तमरिचः यः आन्ध्रव्यञ्जनेभ्यः तीक्ष्णतां दीप्तरक्तवर्णं च ददाति; लेपने अस्माकं हरिद्राचूर्णम् अपि अस्ति। अयं पाकविधिः 4 जनेभ्यः, सम्यक् तीक्ष्णः च; तीक्ष्णतां कथं न्यूनीकुर्यात् इति सूचनासु उक्तम्।
seg.2422ebb922bc.back: Here the heat comes from our Teja red chilli powder, the extremely hot red chilli of Guntur which gives Andhra curries heat and bright red colour; in the marinade there is also our turmeric powder. This recipe is for 4 people, and properly hot; how to reduce the heat is told in the tips.

seg.6037465ed8d2.src: Total includes 30 minutes for the marinade.
seg.6037465ed8d2.back: 30 minutes for marinating are also counted in the total time.

seg.9cb820880217.src: Marinate chicken in curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook it in a deep-golden onion and tomato gravy. Finish with garam masala and coriander leaves.
seg.9cb820880217.t: कुक्कुटमांसं दध्ना, तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, हरिद्राचूर्णेन, लवणेन च लेपयतु, ततः गाढसुवर्णवर्णे पलाण्डु-टमाटा-रसे पचतु। अन्ते गरम-मसालां धान्यकपत्राणि च योजयतु।
seg.9cb820880217.back: Marinate the chicken with curd, Teja red chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook in a deep-golden onion-tomato gravy. At the end add garam masala and coriander leaves.

seg.d35e8cdc661c.src: 750 g chicken ⟦1⟧bone-in, curry-cut pieces, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.d35e8cdc661c.t: 750 g कुक्कुटमांसम् ⟦1⟧सास्थि, व्यञ्जनखण्डाः, प्रक्षाल्य सम्यक् जलं निःसार्य⟦/1⟧
seg.d35e8cdc661c.back: 750 g chicken ⟦1⟧bone-in, curry pieces, washed and water well drained⟦/1⟧

seg.9e9cb51b1458.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.back: 2 teaspoons Teja red chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.9654088d205e.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧plus more to taste at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.9654088d205e.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧more to taste at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.fff6117cc0f5.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual Andhra choice⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧in Andhra usually groundnut oil⟦/1⟧

seg.de3654151f5d.back: 3 cloves, 2 green cardamoms, 1 inch-size piece of cinnamon ⟦1⟧whole⟦/1⟧

seg.3347559a7b17.src: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for a thinner gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.back: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for a thin gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.cf5fbb1e5375.back: Also works well with ⟦1⟧Sannam red chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge if your kitchen is hot.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.t: कुक्कुटमांसे दधि, तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं, हरिद्राचूर्णं, लवणं च मर्दयतु। 30 निमेषान् स्थापयतु। यदि पाकशाला उष्णा, पात्रम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु।
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.back: Rub curd, Teja red chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt into the chicken. Keep for 30 minutes. If the kitchen is hot, cover the vessel and keep it in the refrigerator.

seg.217eb90c7dac.src: Heat the oil in a heavy pan or kadai on medium heat. Add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
seg.217eb90c7dac.t: स्थूलस्थाल्यां कटाहे वा मध्यमाग्नौ तैलं तापयतु। लवङ्गानि, एलाः, त्वचं च योजयित्वा कतिचन क्षणान् चटचटायितुं ददातु।
seg.217eb90c7dac.back: Heat oil in a thick pan or kadai on medium fire. Add cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon and let them crackle for a few seconds.

seg.41164e7a534a.src: Add the onions, green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.41164e7a534a.back: Add onions, green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.127dbd26bc4d.src: Fry the onions in oil till deep golden. This takes 12–15 minutes on medium heat; stir often so they brown evenly without burning.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.t: पलाण्डून् तैले गाढसुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु। मध्यमाग्नौ अस्मै 12–15 निमेषाः लगन्ति; पुनः पुनः चालयतु येन ते अदग्धाः समं रक्तीभवन्ति।
seg.127dbd26bc4d.back: Fry the onions in the oil until deep golden. On medium fire this takes 12–15 minutes; stir again and again so that they redden evenly without burning.

seg.3fa3e9f33095.src: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes, and cook till soft. Fry the paste for 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook the tomatoes for 5–6 minutes, mashing them, until they break down and oil shows at the edges.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.t: आर्द्रक-लशुन-पिष्टं, ततः टमाटाः योजयित्वा मृदुत्वपर्यन्तं पचतु। आमगन्धः यावत् न गच्छति तावत् पिष्टं 1 निमेषं भर्जयतु, ततः टमाटाः मर्दयन् 5–6 निमेषान् पचतु, यावत् ताः विलीय पार्श्वेषु तैलं न दृश्यते।
seg.3fa3e9f33095.back: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes, and cook until soft. Fry the paste 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook 5–6 minutes mashing the tomatoes, until they melt and oil is seen at the sides.

seg.24dbd7dfd784.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds.
seg.24dbd7dfd784.back: Mix in coriander powder and fry 30 seconds.

seg.461e7a0a9c22.src: Add the chicken and cook covered on medium heat till no pink remains near the bone. Fry it uncovered for the first 5 minutes until the pieces turn opaque, then pour in the hot water, cover and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.t: कुक्कुटमांसं योजयित्वा आच्छाद्य मध्यमाग्नौ पचतु, यावत् अस्थिसमीपे पाटलवर्णः किञ्चिदपि न अवशिष्यते। प्रथमान् 5 निमेषान् अनाच्छाद्य भर्जयतु यावत् खण्डाः अपारदर्शकाः भवन्ति, ततः उष्णजलं पातयित्वा, आच्छाद्य प्रायः 20 निमेषान् पचतु, मध्ये मध्ये चालयन्।
seg.461e7a0a9c22.back: Add the chicken, cover and cook on medium fire, until no pink colour at all remains near the bone. Fry the first 5 minutes uncovered until the pieces become opaque, then pour hot water, cover and cook about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.

seg.22f96ed1f76e.src: Check a thick piece: the chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.t: एकं स्थूलखण्डं परीक्षताम्: यदा अस्थिसमीपे पाटलवर्णः न अवशिष्यते रसः च स्वच्छः निर्गच्छति, तदा कुक्कुटमांसं पक्वम्। रसम् आस्वाद्य आवश्यकं चेत् लवणं योजयतु।
seg.22f96ed1f76e.back: Test one thick piece: when no pink colour remains near the bone and the juice comes out clear, then the chicken is cooked. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.

seg.f10b1f5ae914.src: Stir in garam masala and coriander leaves. Simmer 3 minutes, uncovered, until the gravy is as thick as you like and a red film of oil floats on top.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.t: गरम-मसालां धान्यकपत्राणि च मिश्रयतु। अनाच्छाद्य 3 निमेषान् मन्दं क्वाथयतु, यावत् रसः भवतः रुच्यनुसारं घनः भवति उपरि च तैलस्य रक्तस्तरः प्लवते।
seg.f10b1f5ae914.back: Mix in garam masala and coriander leaves. Simmer gently uncovered 3 minutes, until the gravy becomes thick to your taste and a red layer of oil floats on top.

seg.a7c73631b2ca.src: Switch off and rest the curry for 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavour comes together.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.t: अग्निं निर्वाप्य परिवेषणात् पूर्वं व्यञ्जनं 10 निमेषान् स्थापयतु; रसः स्थिरीभवति स्वादः च संयुज्यते।
seg.a7c73631b2ca.back: Turn off the fire and keep the curry 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavours combine.

seg.0b948e3072fa.src: Brown the onions deep golden; the gravy's colour and body come from them.
seg.0b948e3072fa.t: पलाण्डून् गाढसुवर्णवर्णं भर्जयतु; रसस्य वर्णः घनत्वं च तेभ्यः एव आगच्छतः।
seg.0b948e3072fa.back: Fry the onions deep golden; the colour and thickness of the gravy come from them alone.

seg.e0365adcf1bf.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium curry use 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder for red colour with gentler heat.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.t: तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम् अतितीक्ष्णम्। मध्यमव्यञ्जनाय 1 लघुचमसं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, अथवा रक्तवर्णाय मृदुतीक्ष्णतायै च सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.e0365adcf1bf.back: Teja red chilli powder is very hot. For a medium curry use 1 teaspoon, or for red colour and mild heat use Sannam red chilli powder.

seg.57940a63282d.src: Use bone-in pieces; the bones give the gravy its depth.
seg.57940a63282d.t: सास्थिखण्डान् प्रयुङ्क्ताम्; अस्थीनि रसाय गभीरतां ददति।
seg.57940a63282d.back: Use bone-in pieces; the bones give depth to the gravy.

seg.4f9718c3bc6f.src: Let the oil separate from the tomato masala before the chicken goes in, or the gravy tastes raw.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.t: कुक्कुटमांसयोजनात् पूर्वं टमाटा-मसालातः तैलं पृथक् भवितुं ददातु, अन्यथा रसः आमः इव लगति।
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.back: Before adding the chicken let the oil separate from the tomato masala, otherwise the gravy tastes as if raw.

seg.164627c386b7.src: Kobbari kodi kura: grind 3 tbsp grated coconut with 1 tbsp poppy seeds and a little water, and stir the paste in with the garam masala for a richer gravy.
seg.164627c386b7.t: कोब्बरि कोडि कूरा: 3 महाचमसान् घृष्टनारिकेलं 1 महाचमसेन खसखसेन किञ्चित् जलेन च सह पिनष्टु, अधिकसमृद्धाय रसाय च तत् पिष्टं गरम-मसालया सह मिश्रयतु।
seg.164627c386b7.back: Kobbari Kodi Koora: grind 3 tablespoons grated coconut with 1 tablespoon poppy seeds and a little water, and for a richer gravy mix that paste with the garam masala.

seg.7d79f857440a.src: Ground masala: dry-roast 1 tbsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and use instead of the coriander powder and garam masala.
seg.7d79f857440a.t: पिष्टमसाला: 1 महाचमसं धान्यकबीजानि, 1 लघुचमसं शतपुष्पाबीजानि, 3 लवङ्गानि, लघु त्वक्खण्डं च तैलं विना भर्जयित्वा पिनष्टु, धान्यकचूर्णस्य गरम-मसालायाः च स्थाने प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.7d79f857440a.back: Ground masala: dry-roast without oil 1 tablespoon coriander seeds, 1 teaspoon fennel seeds, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon and grind, and use in place of the coriander powder and garam masala.

seg.ea1fd7a2c573.src: Pressure cooker: after adding the chicken and water, cook for 2 whistles and let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.t: प्रेशर-कुकर: कुक्कुटमांसं जलं च योजयित्वा 2 सीत्कारपर्यन्तं पचतु, दाबः स्वयं न्यूनीभवितुं ददातु।
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.back: Pressure cooker: after adding chicken and water cook up to 2 whistles, let the pressure come down by itself.

seg.8b4376996905.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, the Sunday way. It also goes well with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.
seg.8b4376996905.t: उष्णं परिवेषयतु, बाष्पपक्वेन ओदनेन चमसमात्रेण घृतेन च सह, रविवासरस्य रीत्या। चपात्या, दोसया, रागि-सङ्गट्या वा सह अपि सम्यक् भवति।
seg.8b4376996905.back: Serve hot, with steamed rice and a spoonful of ghee, in the Sunday way. Also good with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.

seg.45cb0a9558e6.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. The curry tastes deeper the next day.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.t: आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां 2 दिनानि यावत् स्थापयतु; अन्तः यावत् सम्पूर्णतया बाष्पोष्णं न भवति तावत् पुनः तापयतु। परदिने व्यञ्जनस्य स्वादः गभीरतरः भवति।
seg.45cb0a9558e6.back: Cover and keep in the refrigerator up to 2 days; reheat until it is completely steaming hot inside. The next day the curry's flavour becomes deeper.

seg.bc11ae48bfcf.src: How do I make Andhra chicken curry less spicy?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.back: How do I make Andhra chicken curry less hot?

seg.aaa9ea580a50.src: Cut the Teja chilli powder to 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour with gentler heat. A spoon of curd stirred in at the end also softens the bite.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.t: तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं 1 लघुचमसं यावत् न्यूनीकरोतु, अथवा सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, यत् तमेव रक्तवर्णं मृदुतीक्ष्णतया सह ददाति। अन्ते चमसमात्रं दधि मिश्रितम् अपि तीक्ष्णतां मृदूकरोति।
seg.aaa9ea580a50.back: Reduce the Teja red chilli powder to 1 teaspoon, or use Sannam red chilli powder, which gives the same red colour with mild heat. A spoonful of curd mixed in at the end also softens the heat.

seg.fe399a2a853e.src: Why is Andhra chicken curry so spicy?
seg.fe399a2a853e.back: Why is Andhra chicken curry so hot?

seg.ada87f188506.src: Andhra cooking uses Guntur chillies such as Teja, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in most other regional curries. The heat is part of the dish.
seg.ada87f188506.t: आन्ध्रपाके तेजा इत्यादयः गुण्टूर-रक्तमरिचाः प्रयुज्यन्ते, ये अन्येषु बहुषु प्रादेशिकव्यञ्जनेषु प्रयुक्तात् रक्तमरिचचूर्णात् बहु अधिकतीक्ष्णाः। तीक्ष्णता अस्य व्यञ्जनस्य अङ्गम्।
seg.ada87f188506.back: In Andhra cooking Guntur red chillies like Teja are used, which are much hotter than the red chilli powder used in many other regional curries. The heat is a part of this dish.

seg.fc940ab96cce.src: How do I know the chicken is cooked through?
seg.fc940ab96cce.t: कुक्कुटमांसम् अन्तः यावत् पक्वम् इति कथं जानीयाम्?
seg.fc940ab96cce.back: How do I know the chicken is cooked through inside?

seg.1445f73d2fc1.src: Cut into the thickest piece near the bone. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.t: अस्थिसमीपे स्थूलतमं खण्डं छित्त्वा पश्यतु। यदा अस्थिसमीपे पाटलवर्णः न अवशिष्यते रसः च स्वच्छः निर्गच्छति, तदा कुक्कुटमांसं पक्वम्।
seg.1445f73d2fc1.back: Cut the thickest piece near the bone and look. When no pink colour remains near the bone and the juice comes out clear, then the chicken is cooked.

seg.736c9b09bcd3.src: Can I make kodi kura without curd?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.t: दधि विना कोडि कूरा कर्तुं शक्नोमि किम्?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.back: Can I make kodi koora without curd?

seg.f9ab2afc44b4.src: Yes. Marinate the chicken with the chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tbsp lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.t: आम्। कुक्कुटमांसं रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, हरिद्राचूर्णेन, लवणेन, 1 महाचमसेन जम्बीररसेन च लेपयतु, रसे च एकाम् अधिकां टमाटां योजयतु।
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.back: Yes. Marinate the chicken with red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and add one extra tomato to the gravy.

seg.49c9832aa59a.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Andhra Kodi Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.t: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · आन्ध्र कोडि कूरा पाकविधिः | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.back: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Andhra Kodi Koora recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.dcb6c98b640e.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. The Andhra Sunday chicken curry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.t: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. आन्ध्रस्य रविवासरीयं कुक्कुटमांसव्यञ्जनम्: तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन हरिद्राचूर्णेन च लिप्तं कुक्कुटमांसं, गाढे पलाण्डु-टमाटा-रसे गरम-मसालया सह पक्वम्।
seg.dcb6c98b640e.back: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. Andhra's Sunday chicken curry: chicken smeared with Teja red chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a thick onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.

seg.979d83e76a0e.src: Andhra Kodi Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.979d83e76a0e.t: आन्ध्र कोडि कूरा: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.979d83e76a0e.back: Andhra Kodi Koora: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.ef9179c0bfa9.back: 540 g packet of Teja red chilli powder

seg.dd8d5de6151e.back: 3 cloves, 2 green cardamoms, 1 inch-size piece of cinnamon

seg.d04209f30de4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · Gud Wala Meetha Pongal
seg.d04209f30de4.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · बेल्लम पोंगलि · गुड़ वाला मीठा पोंगल
seg.d04209f30de4.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · sweet pongal with jaggery

seg.b79702dac541.src: Bellam pongali is the sweet pongal that Telugu homes cook on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and enriched with ghee. It is offered as naivedyam before the festive meal, and it is also the prasadam at many temples and Friday pujas.
seg.b79702dac541.t: बेल्लम पोंगलि इति तत् मधुरं पोंगलं यत् तेलुगुगृहेषु सङ्क्रान्तेः प्रातः पच्यते: तण्डुलाः भृष्टमुद्गदालं च अतिमृदु पच्यन्ते, ततः गुडेन मधुरीक्रियन्ते घृतेन च समृद्धाः क्रियन्ते। उत्सवभोजनात् पूर्वं नैवेद्यरूपेण अर्प्यते, बहुषु देवालयेषु शुक्रवासरपूजासु च प्रसादः अपि भवति।
seg.b79702dac541.back: Bellam pongali is that sweet pongal which is cooked in Telugu homes on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal are cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and made rich with ghee. Before the festival meal it is offered as naivedyam, and in many temples and Friday pujas it is also prasadam.

seg.17053455adbb.src: Cane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and a round, toffee-like sweetness, and ghee-fried whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack add the crunch. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17053455adbb.t: इक्षुगुडः अस्मै लघुपिङ्गलवर्णं टॉफी-सदृशं पूर्णं माधुर्यं च ददाति, अस्माकं जीडिपप्पु-पुटकस्य घृतभृष्टानि अखण्डकाजूतकानि च खरस्पर्शं योजयन्ति। अयं पाकविधिः 4 जनेभ्यः।
seg.17053455adbb.back: Sugarcane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and full, toffee-like sweetness, and the ghee-roasted whole cashews from our Jeedipappu packet add a crisp texture. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.50377f017e4e.src: Cook time is for a pressure cooker; allow about 15 minutes more in a pot.
seg.50377f017e4e.t: पाककालः प्रेशर-कुकराय; भाण्डे प्रायः 15 निमेषाः अधिकाः लगन्ति।
seg.50377f017e4e.back: Cooking time is for a pressure cooker; in a pot about 15 minutes more are needed.

seg.b323962ddab1.src: Cook roasted moong dal and rice till very soft, stir in melted cane jaggery and simmer till glossy. Finish with ghee-fried cashews, raisins and cardamom.
seg.b323962ddab1.t: भृष्टमुद्गदालं तण्डुलान् च अतिमृदुत्वपर्यन्तं पचतु, द्रवीकृतम् इक्षुगुडं मिश्रयित्वा चिक्कणत्वपर्यन्तं मन्दं क्वाथयतु। अन्ते घृतभृष्टानि काजूतकानि, शुष्कद्राक्षाः, एलाः च योजयतु।
seg.b323962ddab1.back: Cook the roasted moong dal and rice until very soft, mix in melted sugarcane jaggery and simmer gently until glossy. At the end add ghee-roasted cashews, raisins and cardamom.

seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.src: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧split yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.back: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧split yellow moong (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.9f8bf29ce704.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.t: 1 चषकं घृष्टः इक्षुगुडः ⟦1⟧लघु निपीड्य, प्रायः 150 g; अधिकमाधुर्याय किञ्चित् अधिकः⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly pressed, about 150 g; a little more for more sweetness⟦/1⟧

seg.8dff8f977372.src: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧to melt the jaggery⟦/1⟧
seg.8dff8f977372.back: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧for melting the jaggery⟦/1⟧

seg.c9f89d999d7a.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram) ⟦1⟧optional; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.back: A pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram) ⟦1⟧optional; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧

seg.b1655e025b6c.back: Can also be sweetened with ⟦1⟧palm jaggery⟦/1⟧.

seg.a6184e3e789c.src: Roast the moong dal till light golden, then cook it with the rice till very soft and mushy. Start by dry-roasting the dal in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low heat, stirring, until it smells nutty and turns light golden, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.a6184e3e789c.t: मुद्गदालं लघुसुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु, ततः तण्डुलैः सह अतिमृदु मर्दनीयं च यावत् पचतु। प्रथमं प्रेशर-कुकरे स्थूलतलभाण्डे वा मन्दाग्नौ दालं तैलं विना चालयन् भर्जयतु, यावत् बीजगन्धः आगच्छति लघुसुवर्णवर्णं च भवति, प्रायः 3–4 निमेषाः।
seg.a6184e3e789c.back: Roast the moong dal until light golden, then cook with the rice until very soft and mashable. First in the pressure cooker or a thick-bottomed pot on low fire roast the dal without oil, stirring, until a nutty (seed-like) smell comes and it becomes light golden, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.03597768c72a.src: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash both together in 2–3 changes of water, and drain.
seg.03597768c72a.t: भृष्टदाले तण्डुलान् योजयतु, उभौ सह 2–3 वारं जलं परिवर्त्य प्रक्षालयतु, जलं च निःसारयतु।
seg.03597768c72a.back: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash both together changing the water 2–3 times, and drain the water.

seg.1c139f802ab6.src: Add the 3 cups water. Pressure cook for 4–5 whistles on medium heat and let the pressure drop on its own, or simmer covered in a pot for 25–30 minutes, adding a splash of hot water if it dries out.
seg.1c139f802ab6.t: 3 चषकान् जलं योजयतु। मध्यमाग्नौ 4–5 सीत्कारपर्यन्तं पचतु, दाबः स्वयं न्यूनीभवितुं ददातु, अथवा भाण्डे आच्छाद्य 25–30 निमेषान् मन्दं क्वाथयतु, शुष्कं भवति चेत् किञ्चित् उष्णजलं योजयतु।
seg.1c139f802ab6.back: Add 3 cups of water. On medium fire cook up to 4–5 whistles, let the pressure come down by itself, or in a pot cover and simmer gently 25–30 minutes, adding a little hot water if it becomes dry.

seg.5c9fcb8182ea.src: Open and mash the rice and dal lightly with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.t: उद्घाट्य तण्डुलान् दालं च दर्व्याः पृष्ठभागेन लघु मर्दयतु। तत् मृदु यवागूसदृशं च भवेत्, न शुष्कम्।
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.back: Open and lightly mash the rice and dal with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and like porridge, not dry.

seg.41870045e57c.src: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour it into the rice. Warm the jaggery and water in a small pan on low heat, stirring, just until it dissolves, about 2–3 minutes; it does not need to boil.
seg.41870045e57c.t: गुडं ¼ चषके जले द्रवीकृत्य तण्डुलेषु पातयतु। लघुस्थाल्यां मन्दाग्नौ गुडं जलं च चालयन् केवलं विलयपर्यन्तं तापयतु, प्रायः 2–3 निमेषाः; क्वथनस्य आवश्यकता नास्ति।
seg.41870045e57c.back: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup of water and pour into the rice. In a small pan on low fire heat the jaggery and water, stirring, only until dissolved, about 2–3 minutes; there is no need to boil.

seg.ca9ed938d301.src: Simmer, stirring, till thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; stir in 2 tbsp ghee. Keep the heat low and stir all the way to the bottom, as the pongali catches easily once the jaggery is in.
seg.ca9ed938d301.t: चालयन् घनत्वं चिक्कणत्वं च यावत् मन्दं क्वाथयतु, 5–7 निमेषाः; 2 महाचमसौ घृतं मिश्रयतु। अग्निं मन्दं रक्षतु तलपर्यन्तं च चालयतु, यतः गुडयोजनात् परं पोंगलिः सुलभं तले लगति।
seg.ca9ed938d301.back: Stirring, simmer gently until thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; mix in 2 tablespoons of ghee. Keep the fire low and stir to the bottom, because after the jaggery is added the pongali easily sticks to the bottom.

seg.58e11747230d.src: Taste, and stir in a little more melted jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.58e11747230d.t: आस्वादयतु, अधिकमाधुर्यम् इच्छति चेत् किञ्चित् अधिकं द्रवगुडं मिश्रयतु।
seg.58e11747230d.back: Taste, and if you want more sweetness mix in a little more liquid jaggery.

seg.9eabfb77c3db.src: Fry the cashews in the rest of the ghee; add with the cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.t: अवशिष्टे घृते काजूतकानि भर्जयतु; एलाभिः सह योजयतु। लघुस्थाल्यां अवशिष्टौ 2 महाचमसौ घृतं मध्यम-मन्दाग्नौ तापयित्वा काजूतकानि सुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं चालयतु, प्रायः 1 निमेषम्, अन्तिमेषु कतिपयक्षणेषु शुष्कद्राक्षाः योजयतु यावत् ताः स्फीताः भवन्ति।
seg.9eabfb77c3db.back: Roast the cashews in the remaining ghee; add with the cardamom. In a small pan heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of ghee on medium-low fire and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, in the last few moments add the raisins until they puff up.

seg.4f12a8dd8723.src: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and the camphor, if using, and stir well.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.t: काजूतकानि, शुष्कद्राक्षाः, घृतं च पोंगल्याः उपरि पातयतु, एलाचूर्णं प्रयुज्यते चेत् कर्पूरं च प्रकीर्य सम्यक् चालयतु।
seg.4f12a8dd8723.back: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle cardamom powder and, if it is used, camphor, and stir well.

seg.25eb1725b7f2.src: Switch off and serve warm. Pongali thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of hot water if needed.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.t: अग्निं निर्वाप्य कोष्णं परिवेषयतु। स्थिता पोंगलिः घना भवति; आवश्यकं चेत् कतिपयचमसैः उष्णजलैः तनूकरोतु।
seg.25eb1725b7f2.back: Turn off the fire and serve lukewarm. Pongali that has stood becomes thick; if needed thin it with a few spoons of hot water.

seg.d8d20508ad3b.src: Cook the rice and dal fully soft; they stop softening once the jaggery goes in.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.t: तण्डुलान् दालं च पूर्णमृदुत्वपर्यन्तं पचतु; गुडयोजनात् परं ते अधिकं न मृदूभवन्ति।
seg.d8d20508ad3b.back: Cook the rice and dal until fully soft; after the jaggery is added they do not soften further.

seg.c5408f916731.src: Roasting the moong dal gives pongali its nutty smell; keep the heat low so it turns golden, not brown.
seg.c5408f916731.t: मुद्गदालस्य भर्जनेन पोंगल्यै बीजसदृशः गन्धः लभ्यते; अग्निं मन्दं रक्षतु येन सुवर्णवर्णं भवति, न पिङ्गलम्।
seg.c5408f916731.back: By roasting the moong dal a nutty (seed-like) aroma is obtained for the pongali; keep the fire low so that it becomes golden, not brown.

seg.5ed9375ff107.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring once the jaggery is in; it catches and burns quickly.
seg.5ed9375ff107.t: स्थूलतलस्थालीं प्रयुङ्क्ताम् गुडयोजनात् परं च चालयन् तिष्ठतु; सा शीघ्रं तले लगति दह्यते च।
seg.5ed9375ff107.back: Use a thick-bottomed pan and keep stirring after the jaggery is added; it quickly sticks to the bottom and burns.

seg.92b31a616baa.src: Take the pongali off the heat while it is still a little loose; it sets as it cools.
seg.92b31a616baa.t: पोंगलिः किञ्चित् तरला सती एव अग्नेः अवतारयतु; शीतला सती सा घनीभवति।
seg.92b31a616baa.back: Take the pongali off the fire while it is still a little runny; when it is cool it becomes thick.

seg.1c14403a599f.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker pongali with a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.1c14403a599f.t: तालगुडः: तावत्प्रमाणं घृष्टं तालगुडं प्रयुज्य गाढवर्णा पोंगलिः गभीरं धूमसदृशं माधुर्यं च लभ्यते।
seg.1c14403a599f.back: Palm jaggery: using the same quantity of grated palm jaggery the pongali gets a dark colour and a deep smoky sweetness.

seg.d1a4e19c923c.src: Chakkera pongali: use ¾ cup sugar in place of the jaggery for a pale, sugar-sweet version.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.t: चक्केर पोंगलि: पाण्डुवर्णायै शर्करामधुरायै पोंगल्यै गुडस्य स्थाने ¾ चषकं शर्करां प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.d1a4e19c923c.back: Chakkera Pongali: for a pale, sugar-sweet pongali use ¾ cup sugar in place of the jaggery.

seg.44acc6e45d4b.src: Offer it as naivedyam on Sankranti morning, then serve it warm with the festive meal, alongside pulihora and garelu.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.t: सङ्क्रान्तेः प्रातः नैवेद्यरूपेण अर्पयतु, ततः उत्सवभोजने पुलिहोरया गारेलुभिः च सह कोष्णां परिवेषयतु।
seg.44acc6e45d4b.back: Offer as naivedyam on Sankranti morning, then serve lukewarm at the festival meal with pulihora and garelu.

seg.b4e15a70f8c8.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm with a splash of hot water and a little ghee, stirring, before serving.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.t: अवशिष्टाम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु 2 दिनेषु च भक्षयतु। परिवेषणात् पूर्वं किञ्चित् उष्णजलं स्वल्पं घृतं च योजयित्वा चालयन् तापयतु।
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.back: Cover the leftover and keep it in the refrigerator and eat within 2 days. Before serving add a little hot water and a little ghee and heat while stirring.

seg.70c91f153ba8.src: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?
seg.70c91f153ba8.back: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?

seg.75f25d8f552a.src: Pongali on its own often means the savoury version made with pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are the sweet versions, made with sugar or jaggery.
seg.75f25d8f552a.t: केवलं पोंगलिः इति प्रायः मरिचेन जीरकेण च कृतः लवणयुक्तः प्रकारः। चक्केर पोंगलिः बेल्लम पोंगलिः च मधुरौ प्रकारौ, शर्करया गुडेन वा कृतौ।
seg.75f25d8f552a.back: Just "pongali" is usually the salty type made with pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are the sweet types, made with sugar or jaggery.

seg.94d3b2adcbef.src: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.t: प्रेशर-कुकरे बेल्लम पोंगलिं कर्तुं शक्नोमि किम्?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.back: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?

seg.269aace6e2a8.src: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water for 4–5 whistles, let the pressure drop on its own, then add the melted jaggery and simmer in the open cooker.
seg.269aace6e2a8.t: आम्। भृष्टदालं तण्डुलान् च 3 चषकैः जलैः सह 4–5 सीत्कारपर्यन्तं पचतु, दाबः स्वयं न्यूनीभवितुं ददातु, ततः द्रवगुडं योजयित्वा अनाच्छादिते कुकरे मन्दं क्वाथयतु।
seg.269aace6e2a8.back: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups of water up to 4–5 whistles, let the pressure come down by itself, then add the liquid jaggery and simmer gently in the open cooker.

seg.cd439685b7b5.src: Why did my pongali turn hard after cooling?
seg.cd439685b7b5.t: शीतलीभवनानन्तरं मम पोंगलिः किमर्थं कठिना जाता?
seg.cd439685b7b5.back: Why did my pongali become hard after cooling?

seg.696811a7ce7d.src: Pongali sets as it cools, and simmering too long after the jaggery goes in makes it firmer. Take it off while it is still a little loose, and loosen leftovers with hot water.
seg.696811a7ce7d.t: पोंगलिः शीतला सती घनीभवति, गुडयोजनात् परं दीर्घकालं क्वाथनेन च कठिनतरा भवति। किञ्चित् तरला सती एव अवतारयतु, अवशिष्टां च उष्णजलेन तनूकरोतु।
seg.696811a7ce7d.back: Pongali becomes thick when it is cool, and by long boiling after the jaggery is added it becomes harder. Take it off while still a little runny, and thin the leftover with hot water.

seg.b0499dbc1bd0.src: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.back: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?

seg.7ee832015d30.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The pongali turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7ee832015d30.t: आम्। तावत्प्रमाणं घृष्टं तालगुडं (ताटि बेल्लम) प्रयुङ्क्ताम्। पोंगलिः गाढवर्णा भवति, तस्याः स्वादः गभीरः किञ्चित् धूमसदृशः च।
seg.7ee832015d30.back: Yes. Use the same quantity of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The pongali becomes dark coloured, its taste deep and a little smoky.

seg.978f1b90a63e.src: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with cane jaggery and finished with ghee-fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.978f1b90a63e.t: బెల్లం పొంగలి. सङ्क्रान्त्यै बेल्लम पोंगलि: तण्डुलाः भृष्टमुद्गदालं च मृदु पक्वाः, इक्षुगुडेन मधुरीकृताः, अन्ते घृतभृष्टैः काजूतकैः सह। 4 जनेभ्यः।
seg.978f1b90a63e.back: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with sugarcane jaggery, at the end with ghee-roasted cashews. For 4 people.

seg.ad0644e2314c.src: Bellam Pongali: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.ad0644e2314c.t: बेल्लम पोंगलि: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.ad0644e2314c.back: Bellam Pongali: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram)
seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.back: A pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram)

seg.79401823a930.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.0fff539adaed.src: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick fish steaks simmered in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies and curry leaves. It is a Sunday lunch dish, and many homes cook it in a clay pot and keep it for the next day, when the gravy has soaked into the fish.
seg.0fff539adaed.t: चेपल पुलुसु इति तटीय-आन्ध्रस्य चिञ्चा-मत्स्यव्यञ्जनम्, गोदावरी-मण्डलेषु विशेषयत्नेन क्रियते: स्थूलाः मत्स्यखण्डाः पलाण्डुभिः हरितमरिचैः कृष्णनिम्बपत्रैः च सह अम्ले रक्ते चिञ्चारसे मन्दं क्वाथ्यन्ते। एतत् रविवासरस्य मध्याह्नभोजनस्य व्यञ्जनम्, बहुषु गृहेषु मृद्भाण्डे पक्त्वा परदिनाय रक्ष्यते, यदा रसः मत्स्येषु प्रविष्टः भवति।
seg.0fff539adaed.back: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind-fish curry of coastal Andhra, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick fish pieces are simmered gently in sour red tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies and curry leaves. It is a Sunday lunch dish, in many homes cooked in a clay pot and kept for the next day, when the gravy has entered the fish.

seg.17fc336d9c12.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the marinade and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its deep red colour and a steady heat that balances the tamarind. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17fc336d9c12.t: अस्माकं हरिद्राचूर्णं लेपने रसे च उभयत्र योज्यते। सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं पुलुसवे गाढरक्तवर्णं स्थिरां तीक्ष्णतां च ददाति या चिञ्चायाः अम्लतां सन्तुलयति। अयं पाकविधिः 4 जनेभ्यः।
seg.17fc336d9c12.back: Our turmeric powder is added both in the marinade and in the gravy. Sannam red chilli powder gives the pulusu a deep red colour and steady heat that balances the sourness of the tamarind. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.4ba98eee496a.src: Prep includes the 15-minute marinade. The curry tastes even better after resting a few hours.
seg.4ba98eee496a.t: सज्जताकाले 15 निमेषाणां लेपनम् अन्तर्भवति। कतिपयहोराः स्थापितं व्यञ्जनं ततोऽपि स्वादुतरं भवति।
seg.4ba98eee496a.back: The preparation time includes 15 minutes of marinating. A curry kept for a few hours becomes even tastier than that.

seg.aed84f9a20f5.src: Marinate fish with salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onions and spices, boil them in tamarind water, then simmer the fish gently in the gravy without stirring.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.t: मत्स्यान् लवणेन, हरिद्रया, रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन च लेपयतु, पलाण्डून् मसालाः च भर्जयित्वा चिञ्चाजले क्वाथयतु, ततः अचालयन् मत्स्यान् रसे मन्दं क्वाथयतु।
seg.aed84f9a20f5.back: Marinate the fish with salt, turmeric and red chilli powder, fry the onions and masalas and boil in tamarind water, then without stirring simmer the fish gently in the gravy.

seg.5ce3c9cccf94.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.t: 500 g मत्स्यखण्डाः ⟦1⟧दृढमांसः मत्स्यः स्थूलखण्डेषु कर्तितः: रोहितः (बोच्चा), कोरमीनु (मरेल्), सीर्-मत्स्यः (वंजरम्) वा⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm-fleshed fish cut into thick pieces: rohu (bochcha), korameenu (murrel), or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.23a800982a03.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.t: 40 g चिञ्चा ⟦1⟧जम्बीरप्रमाणः गोलः, 2 चषकेषु कोष्णजलेषु 15 निमेषान् आर्द्रीकृतः⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧lemon-sized ball, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups of lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.f8dec19a56f9.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ tsp for the marinade, ¼ tsp for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.t: ½ लघुचमसः हरिद्राचूर्णम् ⟦1⟧¼ लघुचमसः लेपनाय, ¼ लघुचमसः रसाय⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ teaspoon for the marinade, ¼ teaspoon for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.c78341163232.src: 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 tsp for the marinade, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.t: 2 महाचमसौ सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम् ⟦1⟧1 लघुचमसः लेपनाय, शेषं रसाय⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.back: 2 tablespoons Sannam red chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon for the marinade, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.bcbd97cd906a.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.ba6dcf57651d.back: Also works well with ⟦1⟧Teja red chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.2fafef6b8781.src: Wash the fish pieces gently in water two or three times and drain them well.
seg.2fafef6b8781.t: मत्स्यखण्डान् जले द्विः त्रिः वा मृदु प्रक्षाल्य सम्यक् जलं निःसारयतु।
seg.2fafef6b8781.back: Gently wash the fish pieces in water two or three times and drain the water well.

seg.cf370c2b1459.src: Rub the fish with salt, turmeric and 1 tsp chilli powder; rest 15 minutes. Use 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp of the turmeric powder for the marinade.
seg.cf370c2b1459.t: मत्स्येषु लवणं, हरिद्रां, 1 लघुचमसं रक्तमरिचचूर्णं च मर्दयतु; 15 निमेषान् स्थापयतु। लेपनाय 1 लघुचमसं लवणं ¼ लघुचमसं हरिद्राचूर्णं च प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.cf370c2b1459.back: Rub salt, turmeric and 1 teaspoon red chilli powder on the fish; keep 15 minutes. For the marinade use 1 teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon turmeric powder.

seg.0c7defd6c85a.src: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain it. You should have about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.t: आर्द्रीकृतां चिञ्चां तस्याः जले सम्यक् निष्पीड्य गालयतु। प्रायः 2 चषकाः तनुचिञ्चाजलं भवेत्।
seg.0c7defd6c85a.back: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain. There should be about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.

seg.a8777ed4c461.src: Heat the oil in a wide pan or clay pot on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds and cumin seeds and let them splutter, taking care that the fenugreek does not turn dark.
seg.a8777ed4c461.t: विस्तृतस्थाल्यां मृद्भाण्डे वा मध्यमाग्नौ तैलं तापयतु। मेथिकाबीजानि, सर्षपान्, जीरकं च योजयित्वा स्फुटितुं ददातु, मेथिका कृष्णा न भवेत् इति अवधत्ताम्।
seg.a8777ed4c461.back: In a wide pan or clay pot heat oil on medium fire. Add fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds and cumin and let them splutter, taking care that the fenugreek does not become black.

seg.e87b5c1bcc02.src: Fry the onions, chillies and curry leaves in oil till soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onions about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add the ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, the remaining Sannam chilli powder and the coriander powder and stir for 30 seconds.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.t: पलाण्डून्, मरिचान्, कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि च तैले मृदुत्वपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु; मसालाचूर्णानि योजयतु। पलाण्डून् प्रायः 6–8 निमेषान् मृदुत्वं लघुसुवर्णवर्णं च यावत् भर्जयतु, आर्द्रक-लशुन-पिष्टं टमाटां च योजयित्वा 2 निमेषान् पचतु, ततः अवशिष्टं हरिद्राचूर्णम्, अवशिष्टं सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं, धान्यकचूर्णं च योजयित्वा 30 क्षणान् चालयतु।
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.back: Fry the onions, chillies and curry leaves in the oil until soft; add the masala powders. Fry the onions about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add the ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, the remaining Sannam red chilli powder and coriander powder and stir 30 seconds.

seg.61e849535fa9.src: Pour in the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes till the oil rises. Add the salt for the gravy; the raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy slightly thick.
seg.61e849535fa9.t: चिञ्चाजलं पातयित्वा तैलं यावत् उपरि उत्तिष्ठति तावत् 10 निमेषान् क्वाथयतु। रसाय लवणं योजयतु; चिञ्चायाः आमगन्धः गतः स्यात् रसः च किञ्चित् घनः।
seg.61e849535fa9.back: Pour the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes until the oil rises to the top. Add salt for the gravy; the raw smell of the tamarind should have gone and the gravy should be a little thick.

seg.65cb3d6833cd.src: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, as the fish will take in some of it.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.t: रसम् आस्वादयतु। सः स्पष्टम् अम्लः, लवणयुक्तः, तीक्ष्णः च भवेत्, यतः मत्स्याः तस्य किञ्चित् अवशोषयिष्यन्ति।
seg.65cb3d6833cd.back: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, because the fish will absorb some of it.

seg.fc6f288cacf9.src: Slide in the fish and simmer covered 10–12 minutes; swirl, do not stir. Lay the pieces in one layer, spoon gravy over them and keep the heat low.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.t: मत्स्यान् मन्दं रसे निवेश्य आच्छाद्य 10–12 निमेषान् मन्दं क्वाथयतु; भाण्डं परिभ्रामयतु, मा चालयतु। खण्डान् एकस्मिन् स्तरे स्थापयतु, उपरि चमसेन रसं पातयतु, अग्निं मन्दं रक्षतु।
seg.fc6f288cacf9.back: Gently place the fish in the gravy, cover and simmer gently 10–12 minutes; swirl the vessel, do not stir. Place the pieces in one layer, pour gravy on top with a spoon, keep the fire low.

seg.9fed4db6e81b.src: Check one piece at the thickest part: the fish is cooked when the flesh is white or opaque right through and comes away from the bone easily.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.t: एकस्य खण्डस्य स्थूलतमं भागं परीक्षताम्: यदा मांसम् अन्तः यावत् श्वेतम् अपारदर्शकं वा भवति कण्टकात् च सुलभं पृथक् भवति, तदा मत्स्यः पक्वः।
seg.9fed4db6e81b.back: Test the thickest part of one piece: when the flesh is white or opaque right through inside and separates easily from the bone, then the fish is cooked.

seg.8a5166c34dc3.src: Sprinkle the coriander leaves, switch off and let the pulusu rest at least 30 minutes, covered, before serving.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.t: धान्यकपत्राणि प्रकिरतु, अग्निं निर्वापयतु, परिवेषणात् पूर्वं च पुलुसुम् आच्छाद्य न्यूनातिन्यूनं 30 निमेषान् स्थापयतु।
seg.8a5166c34dc3.back: Sprinkle coriander leaves, turn off the fire, and before serving keep the pulusu covered for at least 30 minutes.

seg.c6819a9980cc.src: Swirl the pan instead of stirring so the fish stays whole.
seg.c6819a9980cc.t: चालनस्य स्थाने स्थालीं परिभ्रामयतु येन मत्स्याः अखण्डाः तिष्ठन्ति।
seg.c6819a9980cc.back: Instead of stirring, swirl the pan so that the fish stay whole.

seg.1333bb67a0a8.src: Pick a firm fish with thick steaks; thin fillets break up in the long simmer.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.t: स्थूलखण्डयुक्तं दृढमांसं मत्स्यं चिनोतु; तनुखण्डाः दीर्घक्वाथने भिद्यन्ते।
seg.1333bb67a0a8.back: Choose a firm-fleshed fish with thick pieces; thin pieces break in long simmering.

seg.dd6f5d867621.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat. Use 1½ tbsp for a milder pulusu, or the full 2 tbsp for the usual Andhra heat.
seg.dd6f5d867621.t: सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं मध्यमां तीक्ष्णतां ददाति। मृदुतरस्य पुलुसोः कृते 1½ महाचमसान् प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, अथवा आन्ध्रस्य सामान्यतीक्ष्णतायै पूर्णौ 2 महाचमसौ।
seg.dd6f5d867621.back: Sannam red chilli powder gives medium heat. For a milder pulusu use 1½ tablespoons, or a full 2 tablespoons for Andhra's usual heat.

seg.6196c7ae078f.src: Boil the tamarind gravy well before the fish goes in; once the fish is in, you cannot cook it much longer without it breaking.
seg.6196c7ae078f.t: मत्स्ययोजनात् पूर्वं चिञ्चारसं सम्यक् क्वाथयतु; मत्स्येषु योजितेषु तान् अभित्त्वा दीर्घकालं पक्तुं न शक्यते।
seg.6196c7ae078f.back: Boil the tamarind gravy well before adding the fish; once the fish are added they cannot be cooked a long time without breaking them.

seg.cadf91d0b4a1.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu, use 1 tbsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam in the gravy. Teja is very hot; start with 2 tsp if unsure.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.t: तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम्: अधिकतीक्ष्णाय पुलुसवे रसे सन्नमस्य स्थाने 1 महाचमसं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्। तेजा अतितीक्ष्णम्; संशये 2 लघुचमसैः आरभताम्।
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.back: Teja red chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu use 1 tablespoon Teja red chilli powder in the gravy instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot; if in doubt start with 2 teaspoons.

seg.1639b09f9df2.src: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and simmer only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.
seg.1639b09f9df2.t: रोय्यल पुलुसु: 400 g शोधितान् चिङ्गटान् प्रयुज्य केवलं 5–6 निमेषान् मन्दं क्वाथयतु, यावत् ते पाटलवर्णाः भूत्वा कुञ्चिताः भवन्ति।
seg.1639b09f9df2.back: Royyala Pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and simmer gently only 5–6 minutes, until they become pink and curled.

seg.f5f2c78097e7.src: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer, Godavari homes add slices of raw mango and use less tamarind.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.t: मामिडिकाय पुलुसु: ग्रीष्मे गोदावरी-गृहेषु आम्रफलस्य अपक्वखण्डाः योज्यन्ते चिञ्चा च न्यूना प्रयुज्यते।
seg.f5f2c78097e7.back: Mamidikaya Pulusu: in summer in Godavari homes pieces of unripe mango are added and less tamarind is used.

seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.src: Serve with hot steamed rice and sliced onions. Many Godavari homes serve it the next day, when the flavours have settled.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.t: उष्णेन बाष्पपक्वेन ओदनेन कर्तितपलाण्डुभिः च सह परिवेषयतु। बहुषु गोदावरी-गृहेषु परदिने परिवेष्यते, यदा स्वादाः स्थिराः भवन्ति।
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.back: Serve with hot steamed rice and cut onions. In many Godavari homes it is served the next day, when the flavours have settled.

seg.ec67fc31e8d9.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.t: अवशिष्टम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु 2 दिनेषु च भक्षयतु। स्थाल्याम् अचालयन् मन्दं पुनः तापयतु।
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.back: Cover the leftover, keep it in the refrigerator and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring.

seg.3fb4609a3953.src: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?
seg.3fb4609a3953.back: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?

seg.81c757cf9b6b.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.t: स्थूलखण्डेषु कर्तिताः नदीसमुद्रयोः दृढमांसाः मत्स्याः: रोहितः (बोच्चा), मरेल् (कोरमीनु), कतला, सीर्-मत्स्यः वा। कण्टकयुक्ताः लघुमत्स्याः अपि उपयुज्यन्ते, किन्तु मृदु व्यवहर्तव्याः।
seg.81c757cf9b6b.back: Firm-fleshed river and sea fish cut into thick pieces: rohu (bochcha), murrel (korameenu), catla, or seer fish. Small bony fish are also used, but must be handled gently.

seg.1d2170a88905.src: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?
seg.1d2170a88905.t: चेपल पुलुसु परदिने किमर्थं स्वादुतरं लगति?
seg.1d2170a88905.back: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?

seg.566bd302c316.src: Resting gives the fish time to soak up the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat even out. That is why many homes cook it in the morning for dinner or the next day.
seg.566bd302c316.t: स्थापनेन मत्स्याः चिञ्चा-रक्तमरिच-रसम् अवशोषयितुं कालं लभन्ते, अम्लता तीक्ष्णता च समीभवतः। अतः बहुषु गृहेषु प्रातः पच्यते रात्रिभोजनाय परदिनाय वा।
seg.566bd302c316.back: By resting, the fish get time to absorb the tamarind-red-chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat become balanced. So in many homes it is cooked in the morning for dinner or for the next day.

seg.53fa2d1b73d6.src: How do I stop the fish from breaking in the curry?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.t: व्यञ्जने मत्स्याः न भिद्येरन् इति कथं करवाणि?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.back: How do I make sure the fish do not break in the curry?

seg.adc2b712af00.src: Use thick steaks, add them only after the gravy has boiled, keep the heat low and swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.
seg.adc2b712af00.t: स्थूलखण्डान् प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, रसे क्वथिते एव योजयतु, अग्निं मन्दं रक्षतु, चमसेन चालनस्य स्थाने स्थालीं परिभ्रामयतु।
seg.adc2b712af00.back: Use thick pieces, add them only when the gravy is boiled, keep the fire low, swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.

seg.9f483b378e98.src: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?
seg.9f483b378e98.back: How much tamarind for 500 g of fish?

seg.f77f33d6b7c5.src: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups of warm water. Use a little less if you add tomato or raw mango.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.t: प्रायः 40 g, जम्बीरप्रमाणः गोलः, 2 चषकेषु कोष्णजलेषु आर्द्रीकृतः। टमाटाम् अपक्वाम्रं वा योजयति चेत् किञ्चित् न्यूनां प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.back: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups of lukewarm water. If you add tomato or unripe mango use a little less.

seg.d9010e0c2ca6.src: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra Fish Curry Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.back: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra fish curry recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.03c44db05afe.src: చేపల పులుసు. Godavari-style fish curry: fish simmered in a tangy tamarind gravy with onions, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. Serves 4, with tips and FAQs.
seg.03c44db05afe.t: చేపల పులుసు. गोदावरी-शैल्या मत्स्यव्यञ्जनम्: पलाण्डुभिः, अस्माकं हरिद्रया, सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन च सह अम्ले चिञ्चारसे मन्दं क्वथिताः मत्स्याः। 4 जनेभ्यः, सूचनाभिः प्रश्नोत्तरैः च सह।
seg.03c44db05afe.back: చేపల పులుసు. Fish curry in Godavari style: fish gently simmered in sour tamarind gravy with onions, our turmeric and Sannam red chilli powder. For 4 people, with tips and questions-answers.

seg.d8b8fe1085c2.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.244c08d4fc5c.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.244c08d4fc5c.t: आन्ध्र चेपल पुलुसु: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.244c08d4fc5c.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.2aa804fbf5dd.back: 540 g packet of Sannam red chilli powder

seg.a6f8caae0640.back: Gongura Mamsam ⟦1⟧(goat meat with gongura leaves)⟦/1⟧

seg.fabe2a976262.src: Gongura mamsam is mutton cooked with gongura, the sour sorrel leaf that Andhra, and Guntur above all, treats as its own. The mutton is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then simmered with gongura that has been sauteed down to a dark, tangy paste, until the curry is thick and the oil rises to the top.
seg.fabe2a976262.t: गोंगूर मांसम् इति गोंगूरेण सह पक्वम् अजमांसम्; गोंगूरं तत् अम्लपत्रं यत् आन्ध्रं, विशेषतः गुण्टूरं, स्वकीयं मन्यते। अजमांसं रक्तमरिचेन हरिद्रया च सह मृदु पच्यते, ततः भर्जनेन गाढम् अम्लं पिष्टमिव कृतेन गोंगूरेण सह मन्दं क्वाथ्यते, यावत् व्यञ्जनं घनं भवति तैलं च उपरि उत्तिष्ठति।
seg.fabe2a976262.back: Gongura mamsam is goat meat cooked with gongura; gongura is that sour leaf which Andhra, especially Guntur, considers its own. The goat meat is cooked soft with red chilli and turmeric, then simmered gently with gongura made by frying into a thick sour paste-like mass, until the curry becomes thick and the oil rises to the top.

seg.a26e996a46c7.src: Gongura's sharp sourness needs strong heat to stand up to it, and that comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli, with our turmeric powder alongside. Serves 4 with rice.
seg.a26e996a46c7.t: गोंगूरस्य तीव्राम्लतायाः प्रतिरोधाय प्रबला तीक्ष्णता आवश्यकी, सा च अस्माकं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णात् आगच्छति, गुण्टूरस्य अतितीक्ष्णः रक्तमरिचः, सह अस्माकं हरिद्राचूर्णम्। ओदनेन सह 4 जनेभ्यः।
seg.a26e996a46c7.back: To stand up to gongura's sharp sourness strong heat is needed, and it comes from our Teja red chilli powder, the extremely hot red chilli of Guntur, along with our turmeric powder. With rice for 4 people.

seg.18985156497a.src: Pressure-cook mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then simmer it with an onion masala and sauteed gongura leaves till thick and the oil floats on top.
seg.18985156497a.t: अजमांसं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, हरिद्राचूर्णेन, आर्द्रक-लशुन-पिष्टेन च सह प्रेशर-कुकरे पचतु, ततः पलाण्डु-मसालया भृष्टगोंगूरपत्रैः च सह घनत्वपर्यन्तं तैलं यावत् उपरि प्लवते तावत् मन्दं क्वाथयतु।
seg.18985156497a.back: Cook the goat meat in a pressure cooker with Teja red chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then with the onion masala and fried gongura leaves simmer gently until thick, until the oil floats on top.

seg.b4cc59b185d3.src: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧bone-in curry cut, washed and drained⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.t: 750 g अजमांसम् ⟦1⟧सास्थि व्यञ्जनखण्डाः, प्रक्षाल्य जलं निःसार्य⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.back: 750 g goat meat ⟦1⟧bone-in curry pieces, washed and water drained⟦/1⟧

seg.b66b468c45f7.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), picked from the stems, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.t: 4 चषकाः गोंगूरपत्राणि ⟦1⟧प्रायः 2 गुच्छौ (150 g), वृन्तेभ्यः चित्वा, प्रक्षाल्य सम्यक् जलं निःसार्य⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), picked from the stalks, washed and water well drained⟦/1⟧

seg.9d6372d75a2f.src: 4 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧

seg.c89b5d92359a.src: Put the mutton in a pressure cooker with the Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave for 15 minutes.
seg.c89b5d92359a.t: अजमांसं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, हरिद्राचूर्णेन, आर्द्रक-लशुन-पिष्टेन, लवणेन च सह प्रेशर-कुकरे स्थापयित्वा सम्यक् मिश्रयतु 15 निमेषान् च त्यजतु।
seg.c89b5d92359a.back: Place the goat meat in the pressure cooker with Teja red chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave 15 minutes.

seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.src: Pressure-cook the mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add the 1½ cups water and cook for 5–6 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.t: अजमांसं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, हरिद्रया, आर्द्रक-लशुन-पिष्टेन, लवणेन, जलेन च सह प्रेशर-कुकरे पचतु। 1½ चषकौ जलं योजयित्वा मध्यमाग्नौ 5–6 सीत्कारपर्यन्तं पचतु, ततः दाबः स्वयं न्यूनीभवितुं ददातु।
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.back: Cook the goat meat in the pressure cooker with Teja red chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add 1½ cups of water and cook on medium fire up to 5–6 whistles, then let the pressure come down by itself.

seg.c084351b01db.src: Open the cooker and check a piece: the mutton is done when it is tender and pulls away from the bone easily with a spoon. If not, cook for 1–2 more whistles.
seg.c084351b01db.t: कुकरम् उद्घाट्य एकं खण्डं परीक्षताम्: यदा अजमांसं मृदु भवति चमसेन अस्थ्नः सुलभं पृथक् भवति, तदा पक्वम्। अन्यथा 1–2 अधिकसीत्कारपर्यन्तं पचतु।
seg.c084351b01db.back: Open the cooker and test one piece: when the goat meat is soft and separates easily from the bone with a spoon, then it is cooked. Otherwise cook 1–2 more whistles.

seg.80af0da3b5a1.src: While the mutton cooks, heat the 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium heat.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.t: अजमांसे पच्यमाने स्थाल्यां मध्यमाग्नौ 1 महाचमसं तैलं तापयतु।
seg.80af0da3b5a1.back: While the goat meat is cooking, heat 1 tablespoon oil in a pan on medium fire.

seg.c59d6a34def2.src: Saute the gongura with green chillies in a little oil till it melts to a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir often and mash the leaves with the back of the spoon as they wilt.
seg.c59d6a34def2.t: गोंगूरं हरितमरिचैः सह स्वल्पे तैले भर्जयतु यावत् तत् विलीय गाढपिष्टं भवति। अस्मै 8–10 निमेषाः लगन्ति; पुनः पुनः चालयतु, म्लायमानानि पत्राणि चमसस्य पृष्ठभागेन मर्दयतु।
seg.c59d6a34def2.back: Fry the gongura with the green chillies in a little oil until it melts and becomes a thick paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir again and again, mash the wilting leaves with the back of the spoon.

seg.37056d0dd9cf.src: Heat the 4 tbsp oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.t: स्थूलकटाहे मध्यमाग्नौ 4 महाचमसान् तैलं तापयित्वा लवङ्गानि, एलाः, त्वचं च योजयतु।
seg.37056d0dd9cf.back: In a thick kadai on medium fire heat 4 tablespoons of oil and add cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon.

seg.26a945a9fad3.src: Fry the onions with whole spices till golden. Add the curry leaves with the onions, and give them 10–12 minutes, stirring often.
seg.26a945a9fad3.t: अखण्डमसालाभिः सह पलाण्डून् सुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु। पलाण्डुभिः सह कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि योजयतु, पुनः पुनः चालयन् 10–12 निमेषान् ददातु।
seg.26a945a9fad3.back: Fry the onions with the whole masalas until golden. Add curry leaves with the onions, giving 10–12 minutes while stirring again and again.

seg.4dd72cc1abd0.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its stock, then the gongura.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.t: धान्यकचूर्णं मिश्रयित्वा 30 क्षणान् भर्जयतु। अजमांसं तस्य यूषं च योजयतु, ततः गोंगूरम्।
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.back: Mix in coriander powder and fry 30 seconds. Add the goat meat and its stock, then the gongura.

seg.46f5f6c735ac.src: Simmer till thick and the oil floats on top. Keep the heat low, stir now and then, and allow 12–15 minutes. Taste and adjust the salt now, once the sourness of the gongura is in.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.t: घनत्वपर्यन्तं तैलं यावत् उपरि प्लवते तावत् मन्दं क्वाथयतु। अग्निं मन्दं रक्षतु, मध्ये मध्ये चालयतु, 12–15 निमेषान् ददातु। गोंगूरस्य अम्लतायां मिलितायाम् इदानीम् आस्वाद्य लवणं समीकरोतु।
seg.46f5f6c735ac.back: Simmer gently until thick, until the oil floats on top. Keep the fire low, stir now and then, giving 12–15 minutes. Once the gongura's sourness has blended, now taste and adjust the salt.

seg.0abf0f798bd3.src: Stir in garam masala. Cook 2 more minutes, then switch off and rest for 10 minutes before serving.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.t: गरम-मसालां मिश्रयतु। 2 निमेषान् अधिकं पचतु, ततः अग्निं निर्वाप्य परिवेषणात् पूर्वं 10 निमेषान् स्थापयतु।
seg.0abf0f798bd3.back: Mix in garam masala. Cook 2 minutes more, then turn off the fire and keep 10 minutes before serving.

seg.c57eb6bfb001.src: Taste after the gongura goes in; its sourness varies from bunch to bunch.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.t: गोंगूरयोजनात् परम् आस्वादयतु; तस्य अम्लता गुच्छात् गुच्छं भिद्यते।
seg.c57eb6bfb001.back: Taste after adding the gongura; its sourness differs from bunch to bunch.

seg.5544823d42b4.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or Sannam chilli powder; do not cut it out entirely, or the gongura tastes flat and sour.
seg.5544823d42b4.t: तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम् अतितीक्ष्णम्। मध्यमतीक्ष्णतायै 1 लघुचमसं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, अथवा सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम्; सर्वथा मा त्यजतु, अन्यथा गोंगूरं नीरसं केवलाम्लं च लगति।
seg.5544823d42b4.back: Teja red chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or Sannam red chilli powder; do not leave it out entirely, otherwise the gongura tastes flat and only sour.

seg.62683a58a9fd.src: Do not use an aluminium pan for the gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and darkens the curry. Use steel or cast iron.
seg.62683a58a9fd.t: गोंगूराय एल्युमिनियम-स्थालीं मा प्रयुङ्क्ताम्; तस्य अम्लता धातुना सह प्रतिक्रियां कृत्वा व्यञ्जनं कृष्णीकरोति। स्टील्-पात्रं ढालित-लोहपात्रं वा प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.62683a58a9fd.back: Do not use an aluminium pan for gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and makes the curry black. Use a steel vessel or a cast-iron vessel.

seg.d036336075e5.src: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala to balance it.
seg.d036336075e5.t: यदि गोंगूरम् अत्यम्लं, सन्तुलनाय मसालायां 1 अधिकं पलाण्डुं योजयतु।
seg.d036336075e5.back: If the gongura is too sour, add 1 more onion to the masala for balance.

seg.8faa3986eaa2.src: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken, skip the pressure cooker and cook it covered in the masala for 20–25 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone, before the gongura goes in.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.t: गोंगूर-कुक्कुटमांसम्: 750 g सास्थि कुक्कुटमांसं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, प्रेशर-कुकरं त्यजतु, गोंगूरयोजनात् पूर्वं मसालायाम् आच्छाद्य 20–25 निमेषान् पचतु, यावत् अस्थिसमीपे पाटलवर्णः न अवशिष्यते।
seg.8faa3986eaa2.back: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken, skip the pressure cooker, before adding the gongura cook covered in the masala 20–25 minutes, until no pink colour remains near the bone.

seg.2ebce7872a6e.src: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add them after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, just until they turn pink and curl, then add the gongura.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.t: गोंगूर रोय्यलु: 500 g शोधितान् चिङ्गटान् प्रयुज्य पलाण्डूनाम् अनन्तरं योजयित्वा 5–6 निमेषान् पचतु, केवलं यावत् ते पाटलवर्णाः भूत्वा कुञ्चिताः भवन्ति, ततः गोंगूरं योजयतु।
seg.2ebce7872a6e.back: Gongura Royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add them after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, only until they become pink and curled, then add the gongura.

seg.7f3c45600b1c.src: Red chilli gongura: fry 6 dried red chillies with the gongura and grind them together for a darker, sharper curry.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.t: शुष्करक्तमरिच-गोंगूरम्: गाढतराय तीक्ष्णतराय च व्यञ्जनाय 6 शुष्करक्तमरिचान् गोंगूरेण सह भर्जयित्वा सह पिनष्टु।
seg.7f3c45600b1c.back: Dry red chilli gongura: for a thicker, hotter curry fry 6 dry red chillies with the gongura and grind together.

seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte. A plain raw onion on the side is the Guntur way.
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.t: उष्णं परिवेषयतु, बाष्पपक्वेन ओदनेन चमसमात्रेण घृतेन च सह, अथवा जोन्न रोट्टे (यवनालरोटिका) सह। पार्श्वे एकः अपक्वः पलाण्डुः इति गुण्टूरस्य रीतिः।
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.back: Serve hot, with steamed rice and a spoonful of ghee, or with jonna rotte (sorghum flatbread). A raw onion on the side is Guntur's way.

seg.a4e072616940.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. Like most sour curries, it tastes better the next day.
seg.a4e072616940.t: आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां 3 दिनानि यावत् स्थापयतु; अन्तः यावत् सम्पूर्णतया बाष्पोष्णं न भवति तावत् पुनः तापयतु। बहूनाम् अम्लव्यञ्जनानाम् इव परदिने स्वादुतरं लगति।
seg.a4e072616940.back: Cover and keep in the refrigerator up to 3 days; reheat until it is completely steaming hot inside. Like many sour dishes it tastes better the next day.

seg.056a57b2c0f8.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.50430ec58f61.src: Gongura is sorrel leaves, also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and cook down to a dark paste.
