seg.50430ec58f61.t: गोंगूरं सॉरेल्-पत्राणि, यानि रोज़ेल् रेड्-सॉरेल् इति अपि उच्यन्ते (मराठीभाषायाम् अम्बाडी, हिन्दीभाषायां पित्वा)। पत्राणि अम्लानि, पक्वानि च गाढपिष्टं भवन्ति।
seg.50430ec58f61.back: Gongura is sorrel leaves, which are also called roselle red-sorrel (in Marathi ambadi, in Hindi pitwa). The leaves are sour, and when cooked become a thick paste.

seg.c813168eb832.src: Can I use gongura pickle instead of gongura leaves?
seg.c813168eb832.t: गोंगूरपत्राणां स्थाने गोंगूर-सन्धानं प्रयोक्तुं शक्नोमि किम्?
seg.c813168eb832.back: Can I use gongura pickle instead of gongura leaves?

seg.e1453431b91a.src: Yes, in a pinch. Stir in 3–4 tbsp gongura pickle in place of the sauteed leaves and cut down the salt and chilli powder, since the pickle already has both.
seg.e1453431b91a.t: आम्, आवश्यकतायाम्। भृष्टपत्राणां स्थाने 3–4 महाचमसान् गोंगूर-सन्धानं मिश्रयतु लवणं रक्तमरिचचूर्णं च न्यूनीकरोतु, यतः सन्धाने उभे पूर्वम् एव स्तः।
seg.e1453431b91a.back: Yes, if needed. In place of the fried leaves mix in 3–4 tablespoons of gongura pickle and reduce the salt and red chilli powder, because both are already in the pickle.

seg.13ee618e3c36.src: How long should I pressure-cook mutton for gongura mamsam?
seg.13ee618e3c36.t: गोंगूर मांसम् इत्यस्मै अजमांसं प्रेशर-कुकरे कियत्कालं पचेयम्?
seg.13ee618e3c36.back: How long should I cook the goat meat in the pressure cooker for gongura mamsam?

seg.5888ba63831a.src: About 5–6 whistles on medium heat for bone-in curry-cut mutton. It is done when the meat pulls away from the bone easily; older mutton may need 1–2 more whistles.
seg.5888ba63831a.t: सास्थि-व्यञ्जनखण्डाय अजमांसाय मध्यमाग्नौ प्रायः 5–6 सीत्काराः। यदा मांसम् अस्थ्नः सुलभं पृथक् भवति तदा पक्वम्; वृद्धाजमांसाय 1–2 अधिकसीत्काराः आवश्यकाः स्युः।
seg.5888ba63831a.back: For bone-in curry-cut goat meat about 5–6 whistles on medium fire. When the meat separates easily from the bone then it is cooked; for older goat meat 1–2 more whistles may be needed.

seg.5f47c430018f.src: How do I make gongura mutton less spicy?
seg.5f47c430018f.back: How do I make gongura goat meat less hot?

seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and use 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, as it balances the sourness of the gongura.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.t: 1 लघुचमसं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं प्रयुङ्क्ताम् अथवा तस्य स्थाने सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम्, 2 हरितमरिचौ च प्रयुङ्क्ताम्। किञ्चित् तीक्ष्णतां रक्षतु, यतः सा गोंगूरस्य अम्लतां सन्तुलयति।
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.back: Use 1 teaspoon Teja red chilli powder or Sannam red chilli powder in its place, and 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, because it balances the gongura's sourness.

seg.df5186f8f459.src: గోంగూర మాంసం. Gongura mutton, the Guntur way: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered with sour sorrel leaves till thick.
seg.df5186f8f459.t: గోంగూర మాంసం. गुण्टूर-रीत्या गोंगूर-अजमांसम्: तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन हरिद्राचूर्णेन च पक्वम् अजमांसं, ततः अम्लैः सॉरेल्-पत्रैः सह घनत्वपर्यन्तं मन्दं क्वथितम्।
seg.df5186f8f459.back: గోంగూర మాంసం. Gongura goat meat in Guntur style: goat meat cooked with Teja red chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered gently until thick with sour sorrel leaves.

seg.ba26416f3fd1.back: Gongura Mamsam (goat meat with gongura leaves) · 1acrefarms

seg.dffa96c4d761.src: Gongura Mamsam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.dffa96c4d761.t: गोंगूर मांसम्: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.dffa96c4d761.back: Gongura Mamsam: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.a7dd4a4d025c.src: Gongura pachadi is the chutney Andhra is best known for: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves fried down in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. Around Guntur and Palnadu it is on the table almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with sliced onion on the side.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.t: गोंगूर पच्चडि इति सः अवलेहः येन आन्ध्रं सर्वाधिकं प्रसिद्धम्: अम्लानि गोंगूर (सॉरेल्) पत्राणि तैले भर्जयित्वा भृष्टमसालाभिः, लशुनेन, रक्तमरिचेन च सह पिष्यन्ते। गुण्टूर-पल्नाडु-प्रदेशयोः प्रायः प्रतिदिनं भोजनपात्रे भवति, उष्णे ओदने चमसमात्रेण घृतेन सह मिश्रितः, पार्श्वे कर्तितपलाण्डुना सह।
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.back: Gongura pachadi is the chutney for which Andhra is most famous: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves are fried in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. In the Guntur and Palnadu regions it is on the plate almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoonful of ghee, with cut onion on the side.

seg.73ddd8b1df98.src: Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the sharp heat that stands up to the sourness of the leaves. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.t: तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम् अस्मै गाढरक्तवर्णं पत्राणाम् अम्लतां प्रतिरुन्धानां तीक्ष्णतां च ददाति। अनेन विधिना प्रायः 1½ चषकौ भवतः, 6 जनेभ्यः पर्याप्तम्।
seg.73ddd8b1df98.back: Teja red chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and a heat that stands up to the sourness of the leaves. By this method about 1½ cups are made, enough for 6 people.

seg.1689d390a49e.src: Total includes cooling the leaves and spices before grinding.
seg.1689d390a49e.t: पेषणात् पूर्वं पत्राणां मसालानां च शीतलीकरणम् आहत्य-काले गणितम्।
seg.1689d390a49e.back: The cooling of the leaves and spices before grinding is counted in the total time.

seg.b4b21c43d6d9.src: Fry gongura leaves in oil till they turn to a dark mash, then grind them with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. Finish with a mustard and dal tempering.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.t: गोंगूरपत्राणि तैले गाढमर्दितत्वपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु, ततः भृष्टधान्यकेन, मेथिकया, लशुनेन, तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, लवणेन च सह पिनष्टु। अन्ते सर्षप-दाल-संस्कारं ददातु।
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.back: Fry the gongura leaves in oil until thoroughly mashed, then grind with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja red chilli powder and salt. At the end give a mustard-dal tempering.

seg.bc1f3c96e98a.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧picked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.t: 4 चषकाः गोंगूरपत्राणि ⟦1⟧2 बृहद्गुच्छेभ्यः चितानि, प्रायः 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧picked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e478a092b07c.src: 1 tbsp sesame oil ⟦1⟧gingelly oil, for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.back: 1 tablespoon sesame oil ⟦1⟧for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧

seg.b00132daaabc.src: ¼ tsp fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.t: ¼ लघुचमसः मेथिकाबीजानि ⟦1⟧मेन्तुलु; न अधिकम्, अन्यथा पच्चडि तिक्ता भवति⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; not more, otherwise the pachadi becomes bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.c1657b10781a.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for a milder pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.t: 2 लघुचमसौ तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम् ⟦1⟧अतितीक्ष्णम्; मृदुतरायै पच्चड्यै 1 लघुचमसं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.back: 2 teaspoons Teja red chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for a milder pachadi use 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.69e8fc35d187.src: Pick the gongura leaves off the stems and wash them in 2–3 changes of water. Spread them on a cloth and pat them completely dry; water left on the leaves splutters in the oil and shortens how long the pachadi keeps.
seg.69e8fc35d187.t: गोंगूरपत्राणि वृन्तेभ्यः चित्वा 2–3 वारं जलं परिवर्त्य प्रक्षालयतु। वस्त्रे प्रसार्य पूर्णतया शोषयतु; पत्रेषु अवशिष्टं जलं तैले स्फुटति, पच्चडि च अल्पकालं तिष्ठति।
seg.69e8fc35d187.back: Pick the gongura leaves from the stalks and wash 2–3 times changing the water. Spread on a cloth and dry completely; water remaining on the leaves splutters in the oil, and the pachadi keeps for a short time.

seg.1b214adb5a9c.src: Roast the coriander, cumin and fenugreek till fragrant; let them cool. Use a dry pan on low heat and stir all the time: the fenugreek should turn one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.t: धान्यकं, जीरकं, मेथिकां च सुगन्धपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु; शीतलीभवितुं ददातु। मन्दाग्नौ शुष्कस्थालीं प्रयुज्य सततं चालयतु: मेथिका एकछायया गाढा भवेत्, प्रायः 2 निमेषाः, न तु पिङ्गला।
seg.1b214adb5a9c.back: Roast the coriander, cumin and fenugreek until fragrant; let cool. Using a dry pan on low fire stir constantly: the fenugreek should become one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.

seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.src: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tbsp oil till they wilt to a dark mash, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium heat and stir often; the leaves shrink fast, turn from green to a dull olive-brown, and almost all their water cooks off.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.t: गोंगूरपत्राणि 1 महाचमसे तैले म्लानि गाढमर्दितानि च यावत् भर्जयतु, 6–8 निमेषाः। मध्यमाग्नौ विस्तृतस्थालीं प्रयुज्य पुनः पुनः चालयतु; पत्राणि शीघ्रं सङ्कुचन्ति, हरितात् मलिन-जैतून-पिङ्गलवर्णं भवन्ति, प्रायः सर्वं जलं च शुष्यति।
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.back: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tablespoon of oil until wilted and thoroughly mashed, 6–8 minutes. Using a wide pan on medium fire stir again and again; the leaves quickly shrink, turn from green to a dull olive-brown colour, and almost all the water dries up.

seg.adc2540067f6.src: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.
seg.adc2540067f6.t: पत्राणि स्थाल्यां प्रसार्य पूर्णतया शीतलीभवितुं ददातु, प्रायः 10 निमेषाः।
seg.adc2540067f6.back: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.

seg.78d34fa0267e.src: Grind the spices with the garlic, chilli powder and salt, then pulse in the leaves. Grind the roasted spices, the 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt to a coarse powder first.
seg.78d34fa0267e.t: मसालाः लशुनेन, रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, लवणेन च सह पिनष्टु, ततः पत्राणि योजयित्वा अल्पावर्तनैः पिनष्टु। प्रथमं भृष्टमसालाः, 6 लशुनकलिकाः, तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं, लवणं च स्थूलचूर्णं कुरुताम्।
seg.78d34fa0267e.back: Grind the spices with garlic, red chilli powder and salt, then add the leaves and grind in short pulses. First make the roasted spices, 6 garlic cloves, Teja red chilli powder and salt into a coarse powder.

seg.e84cadbb2f28.src: Add the cooled leaves and pulse 3–4 times to a coarse paste, without any water. Many Andhra homes pound it in a stone mortar (rolu) instead.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.t: शीतलानि पत्राणि योजयित्वा जलं विना 3–4 वारम् अल्पावर्तनैः स्थूलपिष्टं कुरुताम्। बहुषु आन्ध्रगृहेषु तस्य स्थाने शिलाखले (रोलु) कुट्यते।
seg.e84cadbb2f28.back: Add the cooled leaves and without water make a coarse paste in 3–4 short pulses. In many Andhra homes it is pounded instead on a stone mortar (rolu).

seg.c04597c43292.src: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. Add a pinch more salt if the sourness feels too sharp.
seg.c04597c43292.t: आस्वादयतु: तत् अम्लं, तीक्ष्णं, सम्यक् लवणयुक्तं च भवेत्। अम्लता अतितीव्रा प्रतीयते चेत् लवणस्य चिमटिकाम् अधिकां योजयतु।
seg.c04597c43292.back: Taste: it should be sour, hot and properly salted. If the sourness seems too sharp add one more pinch of salt.

seg.317793f8bd6d.src: Temper mustard, dals, red chillies and curry leaves in the rest of the oil; mix it in. Heat the 2 tbsp sesame oil in a small pan, let the mustard seeds crackle, fry the chana dal and urad dal till golden, then add the red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few seconds. Pour it over the pachadi and stir well.
seg.317793f8bd6d.t: अवशिष्टे तैले सर्षपाः, दाले, रक्तमरिचाः, कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि च संस्कृत्य मिश्रयतु। लघुस्थाल्यां 2 महाचमसौ तिलतैलं तापयित्वा सर्षपान् स्फुटितुं ददातु, चणकदालं माषदालं च सुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु, ततः रक्तमरिचान्, कुट्टितलशुनं, कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि, हिङ्गु च कतिपयक्षणान् योजयतु। तत् पच्चड्याः उपरि पातयित्वा सम्यक् चालयतु।
seg.317793f8bd6d.back: In the remaining oil temper the mustard seeds, dals, red chillies and curry leaves and mix in. In a small pan heat 2 tablespoons sesame oil and let the mustard seeds splutter, fry the chana dal and urad dal until golden, then add the red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few moments. Pour that over the pachadi and stir well.

seg.bd6dcf672985.src: Let the pachadi sit for 30 minutes if you can, so the flavours come together, then spoon it into a clean, dry glass jar.
seg.bd6dcf672985.t: शक्यं चेत् पच्चडिं 30 निमेषान् स्थापयतु येन स्वादाः संयुज्यन्ते, ततः स्वच्छे शुष्के काचपात्रे चमसेन पूरयतु।
seg.bd6dcf672985.back: If possible keep the pachadi 30 minutes so that the flavours combine, then fill it with a spoon into a clean dry glass jar.

seg.e0bb74b2a966.src: Dry the leaves fully before frying so the pachadi keeps longer.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.t: भर्जनात् पूर्वं पत्राणि पूर्णतया शोषयतु येन पच्चडि दीर्घकालं तिष्ठति।
seg.e0bb74b2a966.back: Dry the leaves completely before frying so that the pachadi keeps for a long time.

seg.29688dc9fded.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a milder pachadi use 1 tsp, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.29688dc9fded.t: तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम् अतितीक्ष्णम्। मृदुतरायै पच्चड्यै 1 लघुचमसं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, अथवा अर्धं तेजा अर्धं सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं च।
seg.29688dc9fded.back: Teja red chilli powder is very hot. For a milder pachadi use 1 teaspoon, or half Teja and half Sannam red chilli powder.

seg.d1fa39431c01.src: Keep the fenugreek to ¼ tsp and roast it only one shade darker; more, or darker, makes the pachadi bitter.
seg.d1fa39431c01.t: मेथिकां ¼ लघुचमसमात्रां रक्षतु एकछायया गाढां यावत् एव भर्जयतु च; अधिका गाढतरा वा पच्चडिं तिक्तां करोति।
seg.d1fa39431c01.back: Keep the fenugreek to only ¼ teaspoon and roast only until one shade darker; more, or darker, makes the pachadi bitter.

seg.00435dc24e2d.src: Pulse, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with bits of leaf you can see.
seg.00435dc24e2d.t: अल्पावर्तनैः पिनष्टु, मसृणं मा पिनष्टु: गोंगूर पच्चडि स्थूला भवेत्, दृश्यमानैः पत्रखण्डैः सह।
seg.00435dc24e2d.back: Grind in short pulses, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with visible pieces of leaf.

seg.70ea8f84244b.src: Do not skimp on the oil; the layer of oil on top helps the pachadi keep.
seg.70ea8f84244b.t: तैले कार्पण्यं मा करोतु; उपरि तैलस्तरः पच्चडिं दीर्घकालं रक्षितुं साहाय्यं करोति।
seg.70ea8f84244b.back: Do not be stingy with the oil; the oil layer on top helps keep the pachadi a long time.

seg.bd2018335c09.src: With onion: stir 1 small onion, finely chopped, into a portion just before serving, and eat it the same day.
seg.bd2018335c09.t: पलाण्डुना सह: परिवेषणात् किञ्चित् पूर्वम् एकस्मिन् भागे 1 लघुं सूक्ष्मकर्तितं पलाण्डुं मिश्रयतु, तस्मिन्नेव दिने च भक्षयतु।
seg.bd2018335c09.back: With onion: a little before serving mix 1 small finely cut onion into one portion, and eat it the same day.

seg.77f8d979d9c5.src: Whole red chillies: in place of the chilli powder, fry 12–15 dried red chillies in a little oil and grind them with the spices.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.t: अखण्डरक्तमरिचाः: रक्तमरिचचूर्णस्य स्थाने 12–15 शुष्करक्तमरिचान् स्वल्पे तैले भर्जयित्वा मसालाभिः सह पिनष्टु।
seg.77f8d979d9c5.back: Whole red chillies: instead of red chilli powder fry 12–15 dry red chillies in a little oil and grind with the spices.

seg.98bf90687f81.src: Green chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and cut the chilli powder to 1 tsp, for a sharper, greener heat.
seg.98bf90687f81.t: हरितमरिच-गोंगूरम्: तीक्ष्णतरायै हरिततीक्ष्णतायै पत्रैः सह 6–8 हरितमरिचान् भर्जयतु रक्तमरिचचूर्णं च 1 लघुचमसं यावत् न्यूनीकरोतु।
seg.98bf90687f81.back: Green chilli gongura: for a sharper green heat fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and reduce the red chilli powder to 1 teaspoon.

seg.3ffc938ce36f.src: Mix a spoon into hot rice with ghee and eat with sliced raw onion on the side. It also goes well with dosa, idli and as a side on any Andhra meal plate.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.t: उष्णे ओदने घृतेन सह चमसमात्रं मिश्रयतु पार्श्वे कर्तितापक्वपलाण्डुना सह भक्षयतु। दोसया, इड्ल्या च सह, कस्मिन्नपि आन्ध्रभोजनपात्रे पार्श्वव्यञ्जनरूपेण च सम्यक् भवति।
seg.3ffc938ce36f.back: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with ghee and eat with cut raw onion on the side. Also good with dosa and idli, and as a side dish on any Andhra meal plate.

seg.9b58b3a03e55.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks, always using a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top helps it keep.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.t: स्वच्छे शुष्के काचपात्रे शीतकपेटिकायां 2 सप्ताहान् यावत् रक्षतु, सर्वदा शुष्कं चमसं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्। उपरि तनुः तैलस्तरः तत् दीर्घकालं रक्षितुं साहाय्यं करोति।
seg.9b58b3a03e55.back: Keep in a clean dry glass jar in the refrigerator up to 2 weeks, always use a dry spoon. A thin oil layer on top helps keep it a long time.

seg.5fb383e7c1ab.src: What is gongura called in English?
seg.5fb383e7c1ab.back: By what name is gongura called in English?

seg.100f275734bd.src: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, often sold as sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking areas it is called ambadi.
seg.100f275734bd.t: गोंगूरं रोज़ेल्-वृक्षस्य पत्रम्, यत् प्रायः सॉरेल्-पत्राणि रेड्-सॉरेल् इति वा नाम्ना विक्रीयते। हिन्दी-मराठी-भाषिप्रदेशेषु अम्बाडी इति उच्यते।
seg.100f275734bd.back: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, which is usually sold under the name sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking regions it is called ambadi.

seg.7f27f7848f6b.src: How do I make gongura pachadi less sour?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.back: How do I make gongura pachadi less sour?

seg.a8b5b3cafa35.src: Add a little more salt and chilli, or stir in 1 tsp grated jaggery. Frying the leaves down well also mellows their sourness.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.t: किञ्चित् अधिकं लवणं रक्तमरिचं च योजयतु, अथवा 1 लघुचमसं घृष्टगुडं मिश्रयतु। पत्राणां सम्यक् भर्जनेन अपि अम्लता मृदूभवति।
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.back: Add a little more salt and red chilli, or mix in 1 teaspoon grated jaggery. By frying the leaves properly the sourness also softens.

seg.5bc83cd0bb23.src: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.back: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?

seg.bcbd736912c5.src: Usually too much fenugreek, or fenugreek roasted too dark. Keep it to ¼ tsp and stop roasting when it is one shade darker.
seg.bcbd736912c5.t: प्रायः अतिमात्रया मेथिकया, अतिगाढं भृष्टया मेथिकया वा। ¼ लघुचमसमात्रां रक्षतु एकछायया गाढायां सत्यां भर्जनं स्थगयतु च।
seg.bcbd736912c5.back: Usually from too much fenugreek, or from fenugreek roasted too dark. Keep it to only ¼ teaspoon and stop roasting when it is one shade darker.

seg.f5ec54c6b341.src: How long does gongura pachadi last?
seg.f5ec54c6b341.back: How long does gongura pachadi keep?

seg.693b158b80df.src: About 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry glass jar, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge, eat it within 2–3 days.
seg.693b158b80df.t: यदि पत्राणि सम्यक् शोषितानि सर्वदा शुष्कः चमसः च प्रयुज्यते, तर्हि शुष्के काचपात्रे शीतकपेटिकायां प्रायः 2 सप्ताहान्। शीतकपेटिकायाः बहिः 2–3 दिनेषु भक्षयतु।
seg.693b158b80df.back: If the leaves are dried properly and a dry spoon is always used, then about 2 weeks in a dry glass jar in the refrigerator. Outside the refrigerator eat within 2–3 days.

seg.a8b7816171d1.src: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Gongura pachadi the Guntur way: sorrel leaves fried down, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. Serves 6.
seg.a8b7816171d1.t: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. गुण्टूर-रीत्या गोंगूर पच्चडि: सॉरेल्-पत्राणि भर्जयित्वा, भृष्टमसालाभिः लशुनेन तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन च सह पिष्ट्वा, ततः संस्कृतानि। 6 जनेभ्यः।
seg.a8b7816171d1.back: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Gongura pachadi in Guntur style: sorrel leaves fried, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja red chilli powder, then tempered. For 6 people.

seg.de566b9f7c3e.src: Gongura Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.de566b9f7c3e.t: गोंगूर पच्चडि: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.de566b9f7c3e.back: Gongura Pachadi: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.70fd98f238a4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra's egg curry in tamarind gravy)⟦/1⟧

seg.dd0da0936d87.src: Kodi guddu pulusu is the Andhra egg curry that many homes make when there is no meat in the house: hard-boiled eggs simmered in a tangy gravy of tamarind and slow-fried onions. It is thinner and sourer than a North Indian egg curry, made to be mixed into plenty of hot rice.
seg.dd0da0936d87.t: कोडि गुड्डु पुलुसु इति आन्ध्रस्य तत् अण्डव्यञ्जनं यत् गृहे मांसे असति बहूनि कुटुम्बानि कुर्वन्ति: क्वथितानि अण्डानि चिञ्चायाः मन्दभृष्टपलाण्डूनां च अम्ले रसे मन्दं क्वाथ्यन्ते। एतत् उत्तरभारतीयात् अण्डव्यञ्जनात् तनुतरम् अम्लतरं च, प्रचुरे उष्णे ओदने मिश्रणाय कृतम्।
seg.dd0da0936d87.back: Kodi guddu pulusu is that egg curry of Andhra which many families make when there is no meat at home: boiled eggs are simmered gently in a sour gravy of tamarind and slowly fried onions. It is thinner and more sour than the North Indian egg curry, made for mixing into plenty of hot rice.

seg.27588d5a0d73.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its red colour and a steady medium heat, and our turmeric powder (Pasupu) gives the golden base. A little jaggery rounds off the sourness.
seg.27588d5a0d73.t: अस्माकं सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं पुलुसवे रक्तवर्णं स्थिरां मध्यमतीक्ष्णतां च ददाति, अस्माकं हरिद्राचूर्णं (पसुपु) सुवर्णम् आधारं ददाति। स्वल्पः गुडः अम्लतां समीकरोति।
seg.27588d5a0d73.back: Our Sannam red chilli powder gives the pulusu red colour and steady medium heat, our turmeric powder (pasupu) gives a golden base. A little jaggery balances the sourness.

seg.3c683c3f8074.src: Boil and slit the eggs. Fry onions, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, simmer, then cook the eggs in the gravy till it thickens.
seg.3c683c3f8074.t: अण्डानि क्वथयित्वा विदारयतु। पलाण्डून् भर्जयित्वा हरिद्रां, सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं, चिञ्चाजलं च योजयतु, मन्दं क्वाथयतु, ततः अण्डानि रसे घनत्वपर्यन्तं पचतु।
seg.3c683c3f8074.back: Boil the eggs and slit them. Fry the onions and add turmeric, Sannam red chilli powder and tamarind water, simmer gently, then cook the eggs in the gravy until thick.

seg.8c348975674a.src: a pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.back: A pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional)⟦/1⟧

seg.3a31dc522e29.src: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups warm water⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.t: 20 g चिञ्चा ⟦1⟧जम्बीरप्रमाणः गोलः, 1½ चषकयोः कोष्णजलयोः आर्द्रीकृतः⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.back: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups of lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.d56c07ca17af.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil or sesame oil⟦/1⟧

seg.5b3cff6eb38d.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; use 1½ tsp for milder⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam red chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium hot; for milder, 1½ teaspoons⟦/1⟧

seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.src: Soak the tamarind in the warm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze it well, strain and keep the tamarind water; discard the fibres and seeds.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.t: चिञ्चां कोष्णजले 15 निमेषान् आर्द्रीकरोतु। सम्यक् निष्पीड्य गालयित्वा चिञ्चाजलं रक्षतु; तन्तून् बीजानि च त्यजतु।
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.back: Soak the tamarind in lukewarm water 15 minutes. Squeeze well, strain and keep the tamarind water; discard the fibres and seeds.

seg.e7eefe0a36b0.src: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel them and make 3–4 shallow slits on each. Start them in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from the boil, then cool them in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.t: अण्डानि 10 निमेषान् क्वथयतु, त्वचं निष्कास्य प्रत्येकस्मिन् 3–4 अगभीराः विदारणाः कुरुताम्। कक्षतापमानस्य जले आरभताम्, क्वथनात् 10 निमेषान् गणयतु, ततः त्वग्निष्कासनात् पूर्वं जले शीतलीकरोतु। पीतकः अन्तः यावत् दृढः पाण्डुपीतः च भवेत्।
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.back: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel off the shell and make 3–4 shallow slits in each. Start in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from boiling, then cool in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through inside.

seg.6747ea35bd7d.src: Optional: heat 1 tsp of the oil with the pinch of turmeric and roll the eggs in it for 2 minutes until lightly blistered. Keep aside.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.t: ऐच्छिकम्: 1 लघुचमसं तैलं हरिद्राचिमटिकया सह तापयित्वा अण्डानि 2 निमेषान् तस्मिन् परिवर्तयतु यावत् लघुस्फोटाः दृश्यन्ते। पृथक् स्थापयतु।
seg.6747ea35bd7d.back: Optional: heat 1 teaspoon oil with a pinch of turmeric and turn the eggs in it 2 minutes until small blisters are seen. Set aside.

seg.9d3c50e45f8b.src: Heat the rest of the oil in a kadai on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds and let them turn light brown; they turn bitter if they go dark.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.t: अवशिष्टं तैलं कटाहे मध्यमाग्नौ तापयतु। मेथिकाबीजानि योजयित्वा लघुपिङ्गलानि भवितुं ददातु; गाढानि चेत् तिक्तानि भवन्ति।
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.back: Heat the remaining oil in a kadai on medium fire. Add fenugreek seeds and let them become light brown; if dark, they become bitter.

seg.c867d4469da7.src: Fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and onions in the oil till soft and golden. Add the mustard seeds first and let them splutter, then the curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then the onions for about 8 minutes.
seg.c867d4469da7.t: सर्षपान्, कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि, पलाण्डून् च तैले मृदुत्वं सुवर्णवर्णं च यावत् भर्जयतु। प्रथमं सर्षपान् योजयित्वा स्फुटितुं ददातु, ततः कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि, हरितमरिचान्, हिङ्गु च, ततः पलाण्डून् प्रायः 8 निमेषान्।
seg.c867d4469da7.back: Fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and onions in the oil until soft and golden. First add the mustard seeds and let them splutter, then curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then the onions about 8 minutes.

seg.ae0272dd2475.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the coriander powder with the chilli powder so it fries for a few seconds first.
seg.ae0272dd2475.t: अग्निं मन्दं करोतु। हरिद्रां, सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं, लवणं च योजयतु, ततः चिञ्चाजलम्; 10 निमेषान् मन्दं क्वाथयतु। रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन सह धान्यकचूर्णम् अपि मिश्रयतु येन तत् प्रथमं कतिपयक्षणान् भृज्यते।
seg.ae0272dd2475.back: Lower the fire. Add turmeric, Sannam red chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; simmer gently 10 minutes. Also mix in coriander powder with the red chilli powder so that it is first fried for a few moments.

seg.01aeed8b749f.src: The raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy should look glossy. Add ½ cup water if it thickens too fast.
seg.01aeed8b749f.t: चिञ्चायाः आमगन्धः गतः स्यात् रसः च चिक्कणः दृश्येत। अतिशीघ्रं घनीभवति चेत् ½ चषकं जलं योजयतु।
seg.01aeed8b749f.back: The raw smell of the tamarind should have gone and the gravy should look glossy. If it thickens too quickly add ½ cup water.

seg.74f1a1affff6.src: Slide in the eggs and simmer 5 minutes more till the gravy thickens. Spoon the gravy over the eggs now and then.
seg.74f1a1affff6.t: अण्डानि मन्दं निवेश्य रसः यावत् घनीभवति तावत् 5 निमेषान् अधिकं मन्दं क्वाथयतु। मध्ये मध्ये अण्डानाम् उपरि चमसेन रसं पातयतु।
seg.74f1a1affff6.back: Gently place in the eggs and simmer gently 5 minutes more until the gravy thickens. Now and then pour gravy over the eggs with a spoon.

seg.299781c49104.src: Stir in the jaggery, taste and adjust the salt or sourness, and scatter the coriander leaves.
seg.299781c49104.t: गुडं मिश्रयतु, आस्वाद्य लवणम् अम्लतां वा समीकरोतु, धान्यकपत्राणि च प्रकिरतु।
seg.299781c49104.back: Mix in the jaggery, taste and adjust salt or sourness, and sprinkle coriander leaves.

seg.d0ce3c2b157a.src: Switch off and let the pulusu rest for 10 minutes before serving so the eggs take on the gravy.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.t: अग्निं निर्वाप्य परिवेषणात् पूर्वं पुलुसुं 10 निमेषान् स्थापयतु येन अण्डानि रसस्वादं गृह्णन्ति।
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.back: Turn off the fire and keep the pulusu 10 minutes before serving so that the eggs take on the taste of the gravy.

seg.feebbb94999b.src: Slits let the tangy gravy into the eggs.
seg.feebbb94999b.back: The slits let the sour gravy into the eggs.

seg.98394356bb39.src: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shells come off cleanly.
seg.98394356bb39.t: क्वथितानि अण्डानि त्वग्निष्कासनात् पूर्वं जले शीतलीकरोतु; त्वचः स्वच्छं निर्गच्छन्ति।
seg.98394356bb39.back: Cool boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shells come off cleanly.

seg.f4306708f8c5.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ tsp Teja chilli powder along with it.
seg.f4306708f8c5.t: सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं मध्यमां तीक्ष्णतां ददाति; अधिकतीक्ष्णाय पुलुसवे तेन सह ½ लघुचमसं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं योजयतु।
seg.f4306708f8c5.back: Sannam red chilli powder gives medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ teaspoon Teja red chilli powder with it.

seg.fc1643db807e.src: Pulusu tastes better after it rests, and even more the next day, as the eggs soak up the tamarind.
seg.fc1643db807e.t: स्थापितः पुलुसुः स्वादुतरः भवति, परदिने ततोऽपि अधिकः, यतः अण्डानि चिञ्चाम् अवशोषयन्ति।
seg.fc1643db807e.back: A pulusu that has rested becomes tastier, the next day even more, because the eggs absorb the tamarind.

seg.b19fe3919add.src: Tomato: add 1 chopped tomato after the onions for a softer, less sour gravy.
seg.b19fe3919add.t: टमाटा: मृदुतराय न्यूनाम्लाय रसाय पलाण्डूनाम् अनन्तरं 1 कर्तितां टमाटां योजयतु।
seg.b19fe3919add.back: Tomato: for a milder, less sour gravy add 1 cut tomato after the onions.

seg.0d78d434249e.src: Sesame: stir in 1 tbsp roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes for a thicker, nutty gravy.
seg.0d78d434249e.t: तिलाः: घनतराय बीजसदृशस्वादाय रसाय अन्तिमेषु 5 निमेषेषु 1 महाचमसं भृष्टतिलचूर्णं मिश्रयतु।
seg.0d78d434249e.back: Sesame: for a thicker gravy with a nutty (seed-like) taste mix in 1 tablespoon roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes.

seg.e4adab31c02b.src: Mamidikaya: in summer, replace half the tamarind with a few pieces of raw mango cooked in the gravy.
seg.e4adab31c02b.t: मामिडिकाय: ग्रीष्मे अर्धचिञ्चायाः स्थाने कतिपयान् अपक्वाम्रखण्डान् रसे पचतु।
seg.e4adab31c02b.back: Mamidikaya: in summer, instead of half the tamarind cook a few pieces of unripe mango in the gravy.

seg.bbf897873153.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, with a crisp fry or appadalu on the side. It also goes with chapati or dosa.
seg.bbf897873153.t: उष्णं परिवेषयतु, बाष्पपक्वेन ओदनेन चमसमात्रेण घृतेन च सह, पार्श्वे खरभृष्टव्यञ्जनेन अप्पडालु (पर्पटैः) वा सह। चपात्या दोसया वा सह अपि उपयुक्तम्।
seg.bbf897873153.back: Serve hot, with steamed rice and a spoonful of ghee, with a crisp-fried side dish or appadalu (papads) on the side. Also suitable with chapati or dosa.

seg.7a5a4bbedfff.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu gently in a pan with a splash of water.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.t: अवशिष्टम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु 2 दिनेषु च भक्षयतु। पुलुसुं स्थाल्यां स्वल्पेन जलेन सह मन्दं तापयतु।
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.back: Cover the leftover, keep it in the refrigerator and eat within 2 days. Heat the pulusu gently in a pan with a little water.

seg.3dae693db30c.src: How long should I boil eggs for egg curry?
seg.3dae693db30c.back: How long should I boil the eggs for egg curry?

seg.2d6d1a298a24.src: About 10 minutes from the time the water boils. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through, with no runny centre, before the eggs go into the gravy.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.t: जलक्वथनात् प्रायः 10 निमेषाः। रसे योजनात् पूर्वं पीतकः अन्तः यावत् दृढः पाण्डुपीतः च भवेत्, मध्ये द्रवं विना।
seg.2d6d1a298a24.back: About 10 minutes from the water boiling. Before adding to the gravy the yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through inside, without liquid in the middle.

seg.4abaae123f39.src: Why do you make slits on eggs for pulusu?
seg.4abaae123f39.back: Why are slits made in the eggs for pulusu?

seg.d3f5992ccd6e.src: Shallow slits let the tamarind gravy soak into the egg white. Without them the gravy stays on the surface and the egg tastes plain.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.t: अगभीराः विदारणाः चिञ्चारसम् अण्डस्य श्वेतभागे प्रवेशयन्ति। ताभिः विना रसः पृष्ठे एव तिष्ठति अण्डं च नीरसं लगति।
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.back: Shallow slits let the tamarind gravy into the white part of the egg. Without them the gravy stays only on the surface and the egg tastes flat.

seg.7a591bf728ac.src: How do I reduce the sourness of the pulusu?
seg.7a591bf728ac.back: How can I reduce the sourness of the pulusu?

seg.0a2bf657f386.src: Simmer it a few minutes longer, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or stir in a little water. Use a smaller ball of tamarind next time.
seg.0a2bf657f386.t: कतिपयनिमेषान् अधिकं मन्दं क्वाथयतु, एकं लघुचमसं घृष्टगुडं योजयतु, अथवा किञ्चित् जलं मिश्रयतु। अग्रिमवारं चिञ्चायाः लघुतरं गोलं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.0a2bf657f386.back: Simmer gently a few minutes more, add one teaspoon grated jaggery, or mix in a little water. Next time use a smaller ball of tamarind.

seg.f9a34864523d.src: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?
seg.f9a34864523d.back: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?

seg.08bcae4f5075.src: Pulusu is a thinner, tangy tamarind gravy made to mix with rice. A regular egg curry is usually built on onion and tomato, with no tamarind and a thicker masala.
seg.08bcae4f5075.t: पुलुसु इति ओदनेन सह मिश्रणाय कृतः तनुः अम्लः चिञ्चारसः। सामान्यम् अण्डव्यञ्जनं प्रायः पलाण्डु-टमाटा-आधारितम्, चिञ्चां विना घनमसालया च सह।
seg.08bcae4f5075.back: Pulusu is a thin, sour tamarind gravy made for mixing with rice. The usual egg curry is mostly onion-tomato based, without tamarind and with a thick masala.

seg.6977652a1279.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg Pulusu Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.back: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg pulusu recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs simmered in a tangy tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. Serves 4.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.t: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. कोडि गुड्डु पुलुसु, आन्ध्रस्य अण्डव्यञ्जनम्: क्वथितानि अण्डानि सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन हरिद्रया च रञ्जिते अम्ले चिञ्चा-पलाण्डु-रसे मन्दं क्वाथ्यन्ते। 4 जनेभ्यः।
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.back: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra's egg curry: boiled eggs are simmered gently in a sour tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam red chilli powder and turmeric. For 4 people.

seg.24e368a0d7e4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra's egg curry in tamarind gravy) · 1acrefarms

seg.583485fac40c.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.583485fac40c.t: कोडि गुड्डु पुलुसु: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.583485fac40c.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.722d155a3c4f.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura ⟦1⟧(Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.722d155a3c4f.back: Gutti Vankaya Koora ⟦1⟧(Andhra's stuffed brinjal curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.00fde8f92a7e.src: Gutti vankaya kura is the stuffed brinjal curry that Andhra homes make for Sunday lunches, weddings and when guests come over. Small, round purple brinjals are slit, packed with a roasted peanut, sesame and coconut masala, and cooked slowly in oil until they turn soft and the masala clings to them.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.t: गुत्ति वंकाय कूरा इति तत् पूरितवृन्ताकव्यञ्जनं यत् आन्ध्रगृहेषु रविवासरस्य मध्याह्नभोजनाय, विवाहेषु, अतिथीनाम् आगमने च क्रियते। लघूनि वर्तुलानि नीललोहितानि वृन्ताकानि विदार्य भृष्टभूचणक-तिल-नारिकेल-मसालया पूर्यन्ते, मृदूनि भवन्ति मसाला च लगति यावत् तैले मन्दं पच्यन्ते।
seg.00fde8f92a7e.back: Gutti vankaya koora is that stuffed brinjal curry which is made in Andhra homes for Sunday lunch, at weddings, and when guests arrive. Small round purple brinjals are slit and filled with a roasted groundnut-sesame-coconut masala, and cooked gently in oil until they become soft and the masala clings.

seg.27fd58488499.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing its red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder rounds it off. Serve it with hot rice or chapati. This recipe serves 4.
seg.27fd58488499.t: अस्माकं सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं पूरणाय रक्तवर्णं मध्यमतीक्ष्णतां च ददाति, हरिद्राचूर्णं च स्वादं पूरयति। उष्णेन ओदनेन चपात्या वा सह परिवेषयतु। अयं पाकविधिः 4 जनेभ्यः।
seg.27fd58488499.back: Our Sannam red chilli powder gives the stuffing red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder completes the taste. Serve with hot rice or chapati. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.dea818e2c052.src: Roast peanuts, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, stuff small brinjals and cook them slowly in oil until soft.
seg.dea818e2c052.t: भूचणकान्, तिलान्, शुष्कनारिकेलं, धान्यकबीजानि च भर्जयित्वा सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, हरिद्राचूर्णेन, लवणेन च सह पिनष्टु, लघुवृन्ताकेषु पूरयित्वा तैले मृदुत्वपर्यन्तं मन्दं पचतु।
seg.dea818e2c052.back: Roast groundnuts, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds and grind with Sannam red chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, fill into small brinjals and cook gently in oil until soft.

seg.1ba4509b5345.src: 3 tbsp peanuts ⟦1⟧raw, with or without skins⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.back: 3 tablespoons groundnuts ⟦1⟧raw, with skin or without skin⟦/1⟧

seg.b0b877b509dc.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam red chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧

seg.df2079b45203.src: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple ones⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.back: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple⟦/1⟧

seg.3994d7458465.back: 2 tablespoons coriander leaves ⟦1⟧chopped, for adding at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.d56e638c12d0.src: Dry-roast the peanuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds; grind with the spices. Roast the peanuts first on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, then add the coriander seeds, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and the coconut for the last 30 seconds, until it is light golden. Let it cool.
seg.d56e638c12d0.t: भूचणकान्, तिलान्, नारिकेलं, धान्यकबीजानि च तैलं विना भर्जयतु; मसालाभिः सह पिनष्टु। प्रथमं भूचणकान् मध्यम-मन्दाग्नौ 3–4 निमेषान् भर्जयतु, ततः धान्यकबीजानि, जीरकं, तिलान् च 1 निमेषं, अन्तिमेषु 30 क्षणेषु नारिकेलं च, यावत् तत् लघुसुवर्णवर्णं भवति। शीतलीभवितुं ददातु।
seg.d56e638c12d0.back: Roast the groundnuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds without oil; grind with the spices. First roast the groundnuts on medium-low fire 3–4 minutes, then coriander seeds, cumin and sesame 1 minute, and in the last 30 seconds the coconut, until it becomes light golden. Let cool.

seg.26e4a965b3f7.src: In a mixer, grind the roasted mix with the garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind to a coarse powder without water. It should clump when pressed.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.t: मिश्रकयन्त्रे भृष्टमिश्रणं लशुनेन, सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, हरिद्राचूर्णेन, लवणेन, चिञ्चया च सह जलं विना स्थूलचूर्णं पिनष्टु। निपीडितं सत् पिण्डीभवेत्।
seg.26e4a965b3f7.back: In a mixer grind the roasted mixture with garlic, Sannam red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind without water into a coarse powder. When pressed it should clump.

seg.5784e45d4bff.src: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, leaving the stalk on.
seg.5784e45d4bff.t: वृन्ताकानि प्रक्षाल्य हरितशिखां किञ्चित् कर्तयतु, वृन्तं रक्षतु।
seg.5784e45d4bff.back: Wash the brinjals and trim the green crown a little, keep the stem.

seg.02665f13e5af.src: Slit each brinjal in a cross from the bottom, keeping the stem on, and pack in the stuffing. Cut about three-quarters of the way up so the four quarters stay joined at the top. Drop each one into a bowl of salted water as you go, then drain.
seg.02665f13e5af.t: प्रत्येकं वृन्ताकम् अधोभागात् स्वस्तिकाकारेण विदारयतु, वृन्तं रक्षन्, पूरणं च पूरयतु। प्रायः त्रिपादपर्यन्तम् ऊर्ध्वं कर्तयतु येन चत्वारः भागाः उपरि संयुक्ताः तिष्ठन्ति। कर्तनसमये प्रत्येकं लवणजलपात्रे निक्षिपतु, ततः जलं निःसारयतु।
seg.02665f13e5af.back: Slit each brinjal from the bottom in a cross shape, keeping the stem, and fill the stuffing. Cut upward to about three-quarters so that the four parts stay joined at the top. While cutting drop each into a bowl of salt water, then drain the water.

seg.498fc880430b.src: Press about 1 heaped tsp of stuffing into each brinjal. Keep the leftover stuffing aside.
seg.498fc880430b.t: प्रत्येकस्मिन् वृन्ताके प्रायः 1 पूर्णं लघुचमसं पूरणं निपीड्य पूरयतु। अवशिष्टं पूरणं पृथक् स्थापयतु।
seg.498fc880430b.back: Press about 1 full teaspoon of stuffing into each brinjal. Set the remaining stuffing aside.

seg.3daa0935ccba.src: Heat the oil in a wide, heavy pan on medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and, when they splutter, the curry leaves and onion, if using. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
seg.3daa0935ccba.t: विस्तृतस्थूलस्थाल्यां मध्यमाग्नौ तैलं तापयतु। सर्षपान् योजयतु, स्फुटितेषु कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि, प्रयुज्यते चेत् पलाण्डुं च। पलाण्डुं मृदुत्वपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु, प्रायः 3 निमेषाः।
seg.3daa0935ccba.back: In a wide thick pan heat oil on medium fire. Add mustard seeds, when they splutter curry leaves, and the onion if used. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.

seg.3a140b72d6a0.src: Place the stuffed brinjals in a single layer in the pan.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.back: Place the stuffed brinjals in the pan in one layer.

seg.1ae98f10b6ed.src: Cook the brinjals in hot oil, covered, on a low flame, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the stuffing stays in, and cook for 15–18 minutes, until the skins wrinkle.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.t: उष्णतैले वृन्ताकानि आच्छाद्य मन्दाग्नौ पचतु, प्रति 4–5 निमेषान् मृदु परिवर्तयन्। पूरणं अन्तः तिष्ठेत् इति चमसं सन्दंशं वा प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, त्वचः यावत् सङ्कुचिताः भवन्ति तावत् 15–18 निमेषान् पचतु।
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.back: Cook the brinjals in the hot oil covered on low fire, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the stuffing stays inside, cook 15–18 minutes until the skins become wrinkled.

seg.50530663a626.src: Add the leftover stuffing with ½ cup water; simmer till the brinjals are soft. Cover and cook on low for 8–10 minutes more, until the masala thickens and oil shows at the sides.
seg.50530663a626.t: अवशिष्टं पूरणं ½ चषकेण जलेन सह योजयतु; वृन्ताकानि यावत् मृदूनि भवन्ति तावत् मन्दं क्वाथयतु। आच्छाद्य मन्दाग्नौ 8–10 निमेषान् अधिकं पचतु, यावत् मसाला घनीभवति पार्श्वेषु तैलं च दृश्यते।
seg.50530663a626.back: Add the remaining stuffing with ½ cup water; simmer gently until the brinjals become soft. Cover and cook 8–10 minutes more on low fire, until the masala thickens and oil is seen at the sides.

seg.2a2726cfebd5.src: Check doneness: a knife should slide through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Sprinkle the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.t: पक्वतां परीक्षताम्: स्थूलतमे वृन्ताके छुरिका निर्विरोधं प्रविशेत्। धान्यकपत्राणि प्रकीर्य अग्निं निर्वापयतु।
seg.2a2726cfebd5.back: Test for doneness: a knife should enter the thickest brinjal without resistance. Sprinkle coriander leaves and turn off the fire.

seg.c2e59cef6130.src: Keep the stalks on so the brinjals hold together while they cook and turn.
seg.c2e59cef6130.t: वृन्तानि रक्षतु येन पाकसमये परिवर्तनसमये च वृन्ताकानि संयुक्तानि तिष्ठन्ति।
seg.c2e59cef6130.back: Keep the stems so that the brinjals stay joined while cooking and turning.

seg.15314c3b05cd.src: Pick small, glossy brinjals of the same size, so they cook evenly; large ones stay hard in the centre.
seg.15314c3b05cd.t: समानप्रमाणानि लघूनि चिक्कणानि वृन्ताकानि चिनोतु येन समं पच्यन्ते; बृहन्ति मध्ये कठिनानि तिष्ठन्ति।
seg.15314c3b05cd.back: Choose small glossy brinjals of equal size so that they cook evenly; large ones stay hard in the middle.

seg.208cff8b9d46.src: Roast the peanuts and sesame on medium-low heat; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.
seg.208cff8b9d46.t: भूचणकान् तिलान् च मध्यम-मन्दाग्नौ भर्जयतु; दग्धाः तिलाः सम्पूर्णां मसालां तिक्तां कुर्वन्ति।
seg.208cff8b9d46.back: Roast the groundnuts and sesame on medium-low fire; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.

seg.7779355bd06d.src: For a milder curry, use 1½ tsp Sannam chilli powder; for more heat, go up to 1 tbsp.
seg.7779355bd06d.t: मृदुतराय व्यञ्जनाय 1½ लघुचमसौ सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्; अधिकतीक्ष्णतायै 1 महाचमसं यावत् वर्धयतु।
seg.7779355bd06d.back: For a milder curry use 1½ teaspoons Sannam red chilli powder; for more heat increase up to 1 tablespoon.

seg.742d7eb81437.src: With onion masala: grind 1 small onion into the stuffing for a softer, slightly sweet gravy.
seg.742d7eb81437.t: पलाण्डु-मसालया सह: मृदुतराय किञ्चित् मधुराय रसाय पूरणे 1 लघुपलाण्डुं पिनष्टु।
seg.742d7eb81437.back: With onion masala: for a milder, slightly sweet gravy grind 1 small onion into the stuffing.

seg.abde9958c7fa.src: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and use 1 tbsp more peanuts and sesame.
seg.abde9958c7fa.t: नारिकेलं विना: नारिकेलं त्यक्त्वा 1 महाचमसं अधिकान् भूचणकान् तिलान् च प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.abde9958c7fa.back: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and use 1 tablespoon more groundnuts and sesame.

seg.b9a6b34c8c73.src: Gravy style: add 1 cup water in place of ½ cup in the last step for a thinner curry to mix into rice.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.t: रसशैली: ओदने मिश्रणाय तनुतराय व्यञ्जनाय अन्तिमे सोपाने ½ चषकस्य स्थाने 1 चषकं जलं योजयतु।
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.back: Gravy style: for a thinner curry for mixing into rice, at the last step add 1 cup of water instead of ½ cup.

seg.80faf3a5e4b1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.t: उष्णं परिवेषयतु, बाष्पपक्वेन ओदनेन चमसमात्रेण घृतेन च सह, अथवा चपात्या जोन्न रोट्टे वा सह।
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.back: Serve hot, with steamed rice and a spoonful of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.

seg.9adac1f51f99.src: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm gently with a splash of water.
seg.9adac1f51f99.t: आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु 2 दिनेषु च भक्षयतु। स्वल्पेन जलेन सह मन्दं तापयतु।
seg.9adac1f51f99.back: Cover, keep in the refrigerator and eat within 2 days. Heat gently with a little water.

seg.83ffeb71bb2a.src: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.back: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?

seg.76c81f4beef2.src: Small, round purple brinjals about the size of an egg, with a glossy skin and green stalk. They cook through in the time the masala takes and hold the stuffing well.
seg.76c81f4beef2.t: अण्डप्रमाणानि लघूनि वर्तुलानि नीललोहितानि वृन्ताकानि, चिक्कणत्वचा हरितवृन्तेन च सह। यावता कालेन मसाला पच्यते तावता एतानि अन्तः यावत् पच्यन्ते पूरणं च सम्यक् धारयन्ति।
seg.76c81f4beef2.back: Egg-sized small round purple brinjals, with glossy skin and a green stem. In the time the masala cooks these cook right through inside and hold the stuffing well.

seg.71325f387d2a.src: How do I know the brinjals are cooked?
seg.71325f387d2a.back: How do I know the brinjals are cooked?

seg.c65656faa952.src: The skins wrinkle and soften, and a knife slides through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Undercooked brinjals feel firm and spongy in the centre.
seg.c65656faa952.t: त्वचः सङ्कुचिताः मृदवः च भवन्ति, स्थूलतमे वृन्ताके छुरिका निर्विरोधं प्रविशति। अपक्वानि वृन्ताकानि मध्ये दृढानि स्पञ्जसदृशानि च लगन्ति।
seg.c65656faa952.back: The skins become wrinkled and soft, a knife enters the thickest brinjal without resistance. Uncooked brinjals feel firm and spongy in the middle.

seg.297ebd94e89c.src: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?
seg.297ebd94e89c.t: नारिकेलं विना गुत्ति वंकायं कर्तुं शक्नोमि किम्?
seg.297ebd94e89c.back: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?

seg.f9ad1045b4c1.src: Yes. Use 1 tbsp more peanuts and 1 tbsp more sesame seeds in place of the coconut; the masala tastes nuttier.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.t: आम्। नारिकेलस्य स्थाने 1 महाचमसं अधिकान् भूचणकान् 1 महाचमसं अधिकान् तिलान् च प्रयुङ्क्ताम्; मसालायाः स्वादः अधिकं बीजसदृशः भवति।
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.back: Yes. Instead of the coconut use 1 tablespoon more groundnuts and 1 tablespoon more sesame; the masala's taste becomes more nutty (seed-like).

seg.534e126ba995.src: Why do my brinjals fall apart?
seg.534e126ba995.back: Why do my brinjals fall apart?

seg.96bfe0b8ed06.src: The stalk was removed or the cross was cut all the way through. Keep the stalk on, stop the slit about a quarter from the top and turn them gently.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.t: वृन्तं निष्कासितम् आसीत् अथवा स्वस्तिकः सर्वथा छिन्नः। वृन्तं रक्षतु, उपरितः प्रायः पादभागे अवशिष्टे विदारणं स्थगयतु, मृदु च परिवर्तयतु।
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.back: The stem was removed or the cross was cut all the way. Keep the stem, stop the slit with about a quarter remaining from the top, and turn gently.

seg.69e1140e9c6e.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Gutti Vankaya Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.t: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · गुत्ति वंकाय कूरा पाकविधिः | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.back: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Gutti Vankaya Koora recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.d09cc87e5fde.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted peanut, sesame and coconut, ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then slow-cooked in oil.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.t: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. भृष्टभूचणक-तिल-नारिकेलैः सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन हरिद्राचूर्णेन च सह पिष्टैः पूरितानि लघुवृन्ताकानि, ततः तैले मन्दं पक्वानि।
seg.d09cc87e5fde.back: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted groundnut-sesame-coconut ground with Sannam red chilli powder and turmeric powder, then cooked gently in oil.

seg.e6d2d516a538.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura (Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.e6d2d516a538.back: Gutti Vankaya Koora (Andhra's stuffed brinjal curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.edfa611d692c.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.edfa611d692c.t: गुत्ति वंकाय कूरा: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.edfa611d692c.back: Gutti Vankaya Koora: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.111c74722b7d.src: Jeedipappu pakodi is the cashew pakoda that Andhra sweet shops and homes fry for tea time, festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spiced coat of besan and rice flour, fried till crisp. Made without onion, it keeps for days in a jar, so many homes fry a batch for Diwali and Sankranti visitors.
seg.111c74722b7d.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडि इति काजूतक-पकोडा यां आन्ध्रस्य मिष्टान्नापणाः गृहाणि च चायकालाय, उत्सवेभ्यः, अतिथिभ्यः च भर्जयन्ति: अखण्डकाजूतकानि चणकपिष्टस्य तण्डुलपिष्टस्य च तनुना मसालायुक्तेन आवरणेन, खरत्वपर्यन्तं भृष्टानि। पलाण्डुं विना कृता सा पात्रे बहूनि दिनानि तिष्ठति, अतः बहुषु गृहेषु दीपावल्यां सङ्क्रान्त्यां च आगच्छद्भ्यः अतिथिभ्यः एकः भागः भर्ज्यते।
seg.111c74722b7d.back: Jeedipappu pakodi is the cashew pakoda which Andhra sweet shops and homes fry for teatime, for festivals and for guests: whole cashews in a thin spiced coating of gram flour and rice flour, fried until crisp. Made without onion it keeps many days in a container, so in many homes at Deepavali and Sankranti a batch is fried for visiting guests.

seg.b4f22aebea20.src: Whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack stay crunchy inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe serves 4.
seg.b4f22aebea20.t: अस्माकं जीडिपप्पु-पुटकस्य अखण्डकाजूतकानि आवरणस्य अन्तः खराणि तिष्ठन्ति, सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं च मध्यमतीक्ष्णतां कोष्णरक्तवर्णं च ददाति। अयं पाकविधिः 4 जनेभ्यः।
seg.b4f22aebea20.back: The whole cashews from our Jeedipappu packet stay crisp inside the coating, and Sannam red chilli powder gives medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.a21c4d5f661e.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and crisp.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.t: पकोड्याः शीतलीभवनाय खरीभवनाय च 5 निमेषाः अपि आहत्य-काले गणिताः।
seg.a21c4d5f661e.back: 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and crisp are also counted in the total time.

seg.0f4b2d277930.src: Toss whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle in just enough water to coat, and deep fry till golden and crisp.
seg.0f4b2d277930.t: अखण्डकाजूतकानि चणकपिष्टेन, तण्डुलपिष्टेन, सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, लवणेन, चमसमात्रेण उष्णतैलेन च सह मिश्रयतु, आवरणाय यावत् आवश्यकं तावत् जलं प्रोक्षयतु, सुवर्णवर्णं खरत्वं च यावत् गभीरतैले भर्जयतु।
seg.0f4b2d277930.back: Mix whole cashews with gram flour, rice flour, Sannam red chilli powder, salt and a spoonful of hot oil, sprinkle only as much water as needed for coating, and deep-fry in oil until golden and crisp.

seg.d97defcf6bd2.src: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; split any very large ones in half⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.t: 1 चषकम् अखण्डकाजूतकानि ⟦1⟧प्रायः 150 g; अतिबृहन्ति अर्धं कुरुताम्⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.back: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; halve very large ones⟦/1⟧

seg.0fb432c2000d.src: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.back: ½ cup gram flour ⟦1⟧besan, about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.4530b28d3c24.src: 2 tbsp rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.back: 2 tablespoons rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧

seg.069bf214d83d.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; add ½ tsp more for a hotter pakodi⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.t: 1 लघुचमसः सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम् ⟦1⟧मध्यमतीक्ष्णम्; अधिकतीक्ष्णायै पकोड्यै ½ लघुचमसः अधिकः⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam red chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium hot; for a hotter pakodi ½ teaspoon more⟦/1⟧

seg.c5de5bb5101e.src: 1 tbsp hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.back: 1 tablespoon hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧

seg.a24adfc46507.src: 2–3 tbsp water ⟦1⟧sprinkled in a little at a time⟦/1⟧

seg.9a0fd1249b07.src: oil for deep frying ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧

seg.8423a6481648.src: Rinse the cashews and drain them well; a slightly damp surface helps the flour stick.
seg.8423a6481648.t: काजूतकानि प्रक्षाल्य सम्यक् जलं निःसारयतु; किञ्चित् आर्द्रः पृष्ठभागः पिष्टस्य लगने साहाय्यं करोति।
seg.8423a6481648.back: Wash the cashews and drain the water well; a slightly damp surface helps the flour stick.

seg.0d03259dc451.src: Heat the oil for deep frying in a kadai on medium heat.
seg.0d03259dc451.back: Heat oil for deep-frying in a kadai on medium fire.

seg.c7fa1a156718.src: Mix the besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and add the green chillies, coriander leaves and asafoetida at the same time.
seg.c7fa1a156718.t: चणकपिष्टं, तण्डुलपिष्टं, रक्तमरिचचूर्णं, लवणम्, आर्द्रक-लशुन-पिष्टं, कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि च मिश्रयतु। विस्तृतपात्रं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, तदानीम् एव हरितमरिचान्, धान्यकपत्राणि, हिङ्गु च योजयतु।
seg.c7fa1a156718.back: Mix the gram flour, rice flour, red chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and at that time add the green chillies, coriander leaves and asafoetida.

seg.346911fb291b.src: Rub in 1 tbsp hot oil, add the cashews and sprinkle water till the flour just coats them. Spoon the hot oil from the kadai with care and rub it into the flour mix with your fingertips first, then add the cashews and sprinkle the water 1 tbsp at a time, tossing, until the flour clings to every cashew. The mix should look like damp crumbs, not a batter.
seg.346911fb291b.t: 1 महाचमसम् उष्णतैलं मर्दयित्वा मिश्रयतु, काजूतकानि योजयतु, पिष्टं यावत् तानि आवृणोति तावत् जलं प्रोक्षयतु। कटाहात् उष्णतैलं सावधानं चमसेन गृहीत्वा प्रथमम् अङ्गुल्यग्रैः पिष्टमिश्रणे मर्दयतु, ततः काजूतकानि योजयित्वा एकवारं 1 महाचमसं जलं प्रोक्षयन् परिवर्तयतु, यावत् प्रत्येकस्मिन् काजूतके पिष्टं लगति। मिश्रणम् आर्द्रचूर्णखण्डसदृशं दृश्येत, न तु घोलसदृशम्।
seg.346911fb291b.back: Rub in 1 tablespoon of hot oil and mix, add the cashews, sprinkle water until the flour coats them. Carefully take hot oil from the kadai with a spoon and first rub it into the flour mixture with the fingertips, then add the cashews and toss, sprinkling 1 tablespoon of water at a time, until the flour sticks to each cashew. The mixture should look like damp crumbs, not like a batter.

seg.05a50e3b5ae8.src: Check the oil: a pinch of the mix dropped in should rise to the top in 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it browns at once, the oil is too hot.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.t: तैलं परीक्षताम्: मिश्रणस्य चिमटिका निक्षिप्ता 2–3 क्षणेषु स्थिरबुद्बुदैः सह उपरि उत्तिष्ठेत्। सद्यः पिङ्गलीभवति चेत् तैलम् अत्युष्णम्।
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.back: Test the oil: a pinch of the mixture dropped in should rise to the top with steady bubbles in 2–3 moments. If it browns immediately the oil is too hot.

seg.f3e77b6c0f73.src: Drop small clusters into medium-hot oil. Pick up 3–4 coated cashews at a time with your fingers and let them fall loosely into the oil, without crowding the kadai.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.t: मध्योष्णतैले लघुगुच्छान् निक्षिपतु। अङ्गुलीभिः एकवारं 3–4 आवृतकाजूतकानि गृहीत्वा शिथिलं तैले पातयतु, कटाहे सम्मर्दं विना।
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.back: Drop small clusters into moderately hot oil. With the fingers take 3–4 coated cashews at a time and drop them loosely into the oil, without crowding the kadai.

seg.5e4bfdad4c05.src: Fry, turning, till golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; drain on paper. The bubbles around the pakodi get smaller and slow down when they are done.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.t: परिवर्तयन् सुवर्णवर्णं खरत्वं च यावत् भर्जयतु, 5–6 निमेषाः; पत्रे तैलं निःसारयतु। पक्वायां पकोड्यां परितः बुद्बुदाः लघवः मन्दाः च भवन्ति।
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.back: Fry, turning, until golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; drain the oil on a paper. When the pakodi is done the bubbles around it become small and slow.

seg.eb1a58e02e89.src: Fry the rest in batches the same way, letting the oil come back to heat between batches.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.t: अवशिष्टं तथैव भागशः भर्जयतु, भागानां मध्ये तैलं पुनः उष्णीभवितुं ददातु।
seg.eb1a58e02e89.back: Fry the rest in the same way in batches, letting the oil reheat between batches.

seg.8ab193492427.src: Let the pakodi rest for 5 minutes on the paper; they crisp up further as they cool. Sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder over the top, if you like.
seg.8ab193492427.t: पकोडीः पत्रे 5 निमेषान् स्थापयतु; शीतलीभवन्त्यः ताः अधिकं खराः भवन्ति। इच्छति चेत् उपरि लवणस्य रक्तमरिचचूर्णस्य वा चिमटिकां प्रकिरतु।
seg.8ab193492427.back: Keep the pakodis on the paper 5 minutes; as they cool they become more crisp. If you wish sprinkle a pinch of salt or red chilli powder on top.

seg.c8ded38fad10.src: Keep the batter thick and dry, not runny, or the pakodi turns soft.
seg.c8ded38fad10.t: घोलं घनं शुष्कं च रक्षतु, न तरलम्, अन्यथा पकोडी मृद्वी भवति।
seg.c8ded38fad10.back: Keep the batter thick and dry, not runny, otherwise the pakodi becomes soft.

seg.9670def7c10b.src: Fry on medium heat: cashews brown fast, and on high heat the coating colours before the cashew inside is toasted.
seg.9670def7c10b.t: मध्यमाग्नौ भर्जयतु: काजूतकानि शीघ्रं पिङ्गलानि भवन्ति, तीव्राग्नौ च अन्तःस्थं काजूतकं भृष्टं भवितुं पूर्वम् एव आवरणस्य वर्णः परिवर्तते।
seg.9670def7c10b.back: Fry on medium fire: cashews quickly become brown, and on high fire the coating's colour changes before the cashew inside is roasted.

seg.76602f605fc8.src: The spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.
seg.76602f605fc8.t: पिष्टे मर्दितं चमसमात्रम् उष्णतैलं पकोडीं लघ्वीं खरां च करोति।
seg.76602f605fc8.back: A spoonful of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.

seg.2494998e92ed.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a good red colour; use ½ tsp for children.
seg.2494998e92ed.t: सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं मध्यमतीक्ष्णतां सुन्दरं रक्तवर्णं च ददाति; बालेभ्यः ½ लघुचमसं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.2494998e92ed.back: Sannam red chilli powder gives medium heat and a beautiful red colour; for children use ½ teaspoon.

seg.7f70d313349e.src: Hotter: replace half the Sannam chilli powder with Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.
seg.7f70d313349e.t: अधिकतीक्ष्णम्: अर्धस्य सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णस्य स्थाने तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, यत् बहु अधिकतीक्ष्णम्।
seg.7f70d313349e.back: Hotter: in place of half the Sannam red chilli powder use Teja red chilli powder, which is much hotter.

seg.2b2be3846a1d.src: With onion: add 1 small onion, thinly sliced, with the cashews for a softer, sweeter pakodi, and eat it the same day.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.t: पलाण्डुना सह: मृदुतरायै मधुरतरायै पकोड्यै काजूतकैः सह 1 लघुं तनुकर्तितं पलाण्डुं योजयतु, तस्मिन्नेव दिने च भक्षयतु।
seg.2b2be3846a1d.back: With onion: for a softer, sweeter pakodi add 1 small thinly cut onion with the cashews, and eat it the same day.

seg.7f852eddc8b5.src: Mint: add 2 tbsp chopped mint leaves along with the coriander leaves.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.t: पुदीना: धान्यकपत्रैः सह 2 महाचमसौ कर्तितानि पुदीनापत्राणि योजयतु।
seg.7f852eddc8b5.back: Mint: add 2 tablespoons cut mint leaves with the coriander leaves.

seg.cd47edc05460.src: Serve warm with evening tea or filter coffee. They also go into lunch boxes or onto the side of a rice-and-pappu meal.
seg.cd47edc05460.t: सायं चायेन फिल्टर-काफ्या वा सह कोष्णाः परिवेषयतु। भोजनपेटिकासु ओदन-पप्पु-भोजनस्य पार्श्वे वा अपि उपयुक्ताः।
seg.cd47edc05460.back: Serve lukewarm in the evening with tea or filter coffee. Also suitable in lunch boxes or beside a rice-pappu meal.

seg.e2777b4dabb7.src: Once fully cooled, keep them in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they soften, warm them in a dry pan on low heat for 2–3 minutes.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.t: पूर्णतया शीतलीभूताः वायुरोधिपात्रे कक्षतापमाने रक्षतु 4–5 दिनेषु च भक्षयतु। मृद्व्यः भवन्ति चेत् शुष्कस्थाल्यां मन्दाग्नौ 2–3 निमेषान् तापयतु।
seg.e2777b4dabb7.back: When completely cooled keep in an airtight container at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they become soft heat in a dry pan on low fire 2–3 minutes.

seg.f8c9120f7f67.src: Why did my cashew pakodi turn soft?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.back: Why did my cashew pakodi become soft?

seg.346050614d3a.src: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low heat. Keep the mix like damp crumbs and fry on medium heat until the bubbles slow down.
seg.346050614d3a.t: पिष्टे अतिजलेन, मन्दाग्नौ भर्जनेन वा। मिश्रणम् आर्द्रचूर्णखण्डसदृशं रक्षतु, बुद्बुदाः यावत् मन्दाः भवन्ति तावत् मध्यमाग्नौ भर्जयतु।
seg.346050614d3a.back: From too much water in the flour, or from frying on low fire. Keep the mixture like damp crumbs, fry on medium fire until the bubbles become slow.

seg.921421ebf2c6.src: Should I soak cashews before making pakodi?
seg.921421ebf2c6.back: Should the cashews be soaked before making pakodi?

seg.e6e487728264.src: No soak is needed. A quick rinse is enough to help the flour stick; cashews soaked for long lose some of their crunch.
seg.e6e487728264.t: आर्द्रीकरणस्य आवश्यकता नास्ति। पिष्टलगनाय एकवारं प्रक्षालनं पर्याप्तम्; दीर्घकालम् आर्द्रीकृतानि काजूतकानि किञ्चित् खरत्वं त्यजन्ति।
seg.e6e487728264.back: There is no need for soaking. For the flour to stick one washing is enough; cashews soaked a long time lose some crispness.

seg.905443e515e2.src: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?
seg.905443e515e2.t: तण्डुलपिष्टं विना काजूतक-पकोडीं कर्तुं शक्नोमि किम्?
seg.905443e515e2.back: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?

seg.72a2c55cca9c.src: Yes. Use 2 tbsp more besan, or 1 tbsp cornflour. Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so the pakodi will be a little softer without it.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.t: आम्। 2 महाचमसौ अधिकं चणकपिष्टं, 1 महाचमसं मक्काश्वेतसारं वा प्रयुङ्क्ताम्। तण्डुलपिष्टं खरतमम् आवरणं ददाति, अतः तेन विना पकोडी किञ्चित् मृद्वी भविष्यति।
seg.72a2c55cca9c.back: Yes. Use 2 tablespoons more gram flour, or 1 tablespoon cornflour (maize starch). Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so without it the pakodi will be a little softer.

seg.f129edc737b1.src: How long does cashew pakodi stay crisp?
seg.f129edc737b1.back: How long does cashew pakodi stay crisp?

seg.d73ef4b28b6d.src: About 4–5 days in an airtight jar, as long as it cools completely before it goes in.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.t: वायुरोधिपात्रे प्रायः 4–5 दिनानि, यदि पात्रे स्थापनात् पूर्वं पूर्णतया शीतलीभवति।
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.back: About 4–5 days in an airtight container, if it is completely cooled before being placed in the container.

seg.62c3aa71c55a.src: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crisp cashew pakodi with whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.62c3aa71c55a.t: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. अस्माकं जीडिपप्पु-पुटकस्य अखण्डकाजूतकैः, चणकपिष्टेन, तण्डुलपिष्टेन, सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन च कृता खरा काजूतक-पकोडी। क्रमशः विधिः, सूचनाः, प्रश्नोत्तराणि च।
seg.62c3aa71c55a.back: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crisp cashew pakodi made with whole cashews from our Jeedipappu packet, gram flour, rice flour and Sannam red chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.f560ff3badb6.src: Jeedipappu Pakodi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.f560ff3badb6.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडि: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.f560ff3badb6.back: Jeedipappu Pakodi: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.a64f3158d8da.src: Upma is the everyday Andhra tiffin: semolina cooked soft in a seasoned water with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is the dressed-up version, with a good handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, the way it is made for guests, for festival mornings and at weddings, often served next to pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.
seg.a64f3158d8da.t: उप्मा आन्ध्रस्य दैनिकः प्रातराशः: पलाण्डुना, हरितमरिचैः, कृष्णनिम्बपत्रैः च संस्कृते जले रवा मृदु पच्यते। जीडिपप्पु उप्मा तस्य अलङ्कृतं रूपम्, घृते सुवर्णवर्णं भृष्टैः मुष्टिमात्रैः काजूतकैः सह, यथा अतिथिभ्यः, उत्सवप्रभातेषु, विवाहेषु च क्रियते, प्रायः पेसरट्टु-पार्श्वे चमसमात्रया शर्करया वा सह परिवेष्यते।
seg.a64f3158d8da.back: Upma is Andhra's daily breakfast: rava cooked soft in water tempered with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is its dressed-up form, with handfuls of cashews roasted golden in ghee, as made for guests, on festival mornings and at weddings, usually served beside pesarattu or with a spoonful of sugar.

seg.f9bc03f64077.src: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy against the soft rava. It is on the table in about 25 minutes. This recipe serves 3.
seg.f9bc03f64077.t: अस्माकं जीडिपप्पु-काजूतकानि अखण्डानि अलङ्कारहीनानि च, अतः समं भृज्यन्ते मृद्व्यां रवायां खराणि तिष्ठन्ति। प्रायः 25 निमेषेषु भोजनपात्रे भवति। अयं पाकविधिः 3 जनेभ्यः।
seg.f9bc03f64077.back: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and unadorned, so they roast evenly and stay crisp in the soft rava. It is on the plate in about 25 minutes. This recipe is for 3 people.

seg.5ef4d1713249.src: Roast rava, fry cashews in ghee, then temper and soften onion and chillies. Boil water with salt, stir in the rava, cover and finish with the cashews.
seg.5ef4d1713249.t: रवां भर्जयतु, काजूतकानि घृते भर्जयतु, ततः संस्कारं दत्त्वा पलाण्डुं मरिचान् च मृदूकरोतु। लवणेन सह जलं क्वाथयित्वा रवां मिश्रयतु, आच्छादयतु, अन्ते काजूतकानि योजयतु।
seg.5ef4d1713249.back: Roast the rava, roast the cashews in ghee, then give the tempering and soften the onion and chillies. Boil water with salt and mix in the rava, cover, and at the end add the cashews.

seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.src: 1 cup bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina (sooji), about 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.back: 1 cup Bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium-grain sooji, about 170 g⟦/1⟧

seg.30102cb3f08b.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧use 2 cups for a firmer upma⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧2 cups for a firmer upma⟦/1⟧

seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.src: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halved, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.t: ¼ चषकं काजूतकानि ⟦1⟧अखण्डानि अर्धितानि वा, प्रायः 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.back: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halved, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.0e1b40869004.src: 3 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tbsp oil plus 1 tbsp ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.t: 3 महाचमसाः घृतम् ⟦1⟧अथवा 2 महाचमसौ तैलं 1 महाचमसः घृतं च⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.back: 3 tablespoons ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tablespoons oil and 1 tablespoon ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.07a870690b21.src: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit; use 3 for a hotter upma⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.back: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit; 3 for a hotter upma⟦/1⟧

seg.5fe03b6066ae.src: Chop the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit the green chillies, and measure out the water.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.t: पलाण्डुम्, आर्द्रकं, धान्यकपत्राणि च कर्तयतु, हरितमरिचान् विदारयतु, जलं च मापयित्वा स्थापयतु।
seg.5fe03b6066ae.back: Cut the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit the green chillies, and measure out the water and keep it ready.

seg.015e5d6ef88c.src: Roast the rava in a dry pan till it smells toasty, about 5 minutes. Keep it pale. Stir all the time on medium-low heat, then tip it onto a plate.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.t: शुष्कस्थाल्यां रवां भृष्टगन्धपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु, प्रायः 5 निमेषाः। वर्णं पाण्डुरं रक्षतु। मध्यम-मन्दाग्नौ सततं चालयतु, ततः स्थाल्यां पातयतु।
seg.015e5d6ef88c.back: In a dry pan roast the rava until it smells roasted, about 5 minutes. Keep the colour pale. Stir constantly on medium-low fire, then tip it onto a plate.

seg.2ccb9bbfe373.src: Heat the ghee in a wide, heavy pan on medium-low heat.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.back: In a wide thick pan heat the ghee on medium-low fire.

seg.827cce77ebf1.src: Fry the cashews in the ghee till golden; lift them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan.
seg.827cce77ebf1.t: काजूतकानि घृते सुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु; उद्धरतु। अस्मै प्रायः 1–2 निमेषाः लगन्ति; घृतं स्थाल्यां रक्षतु।
seg.827cce77ebf1.back: Roast the cashews in the ghee until golden; take them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan.

seg.57b61920de4c.src: Temper mustard, dals and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chillies, add water and salt, and boil. Let the mustard seeds splutter and the dals turn light golden before the curry leaves go in, then add the ginger with the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes till the onion is soft.
seg.57b61920de4c.t: सर्षपाणां, दालानां, कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणां च संस्कारं ददातु। पलाण्डुं मरिचान् च मृदूकृत्य जलं लवणं च योजयित्वा क्वाथयतु। कृष्णनिम्बपत्रयोजनात् पूर्वं सर्षपान् स्फुटितुं दालानि लघुसुवर्णवर्णानि भवितुं च ददातु, ततः पलाण्डुना सह आर्द्रकं योजयित्वा पलाण्डुः यावत् मृदुः भवति तावत् 3–4 निमेषान् पचतु।
seg.57b61920de4c.back: Give a tempering of mustard seeds, dals and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chillies, add water and salt and boil. Before adding the curry leaves let the mustard seeds splutter and the dals become light golden, then add the ginger with the onion and cook 3–4 minutes until the onion is soft.

seg.be01d433ae80.src: Taste the water once it boils; it should taste a little salty, as the rava will take up the salt.
seg.be01d433ae80.t: जले क्वथिते आस्वादयतु; तत् किञ्चित् लवणाधिकं लगेत्, यतः रवा लवणम् अवशोषयिष्यति।
seg.be01d433ae80.back: When the water boils taste it; it should taste a little over-salted, because the rava will absorb the salt.

seg.b99b11495ead.src: Turn the heat to low. Pour in the rava in a thin stream, stirring. Cover on low for 3 minutes; top with the cashews.
seg.b99b11495ead.t: अग्निं मन्दं करोतु। चालयन् तनुधारया रवां पातयतु। आच्छाद्य मन्दाग्नौ 3 निमेषान् स्थापयतु; उपरि काजूतकानि ददातु।
seg.b99b11495ead.back: Lower the fire. Stirring, pour in the rava in a thin stream. Cover and keep on low fire 3 minutes; put the cashews on top.

seg.fbf1f55f7751.src: Before adding the cashews, check the upma: the rava should be soft with no hard grains, and the upma should leave the sides of the pan. If it is still grainy, sprinkle in 2 tbsp hot water, cover and cook 1 minute more.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.t: काजूतकयोजनात् पूर्वम् उप्मां परीक्षताम्: रवा मृद्वी कठिनकणरहिता च भवेत्, उप्मा च स्थाल्याः पार्श्वान् त्यजेत्। अद्यापि कणयुक्ता चेत् 2 महाचमसौ उष्णजलं प्रोक्ष्य आच्छाद्य 1 निमेषम् अधिकं पचतु।
seg.fbf1f55f7751.back: Before adding the cashews test the upma: the rava should be soft and without hard grains, and the upma should leave the sides of the pan. If still grainy sprinkle 2 tablespoons hot water, cover and cook 1 minute more.

seg.28e90add4ba6.src: Stir in the extra spoon of ghee and the coriander leaves, if using, along with most of the cashews.
seg.28e90add4ba6.t: अधिकं चमसमात्रं घृतं, प्रयुज्यते चेत् धान्यकपत्राणि च, अधिकांशैः काजूतकैः सह मिश्रयतु।
seg.28e90add4ba6.back: Mix in a spoonful more ghee, and coriander leaves if used, with most of the cashews.

seg.351e9512c914.src: Serve hot, with the rest of the cashews on top.
seg.351e9512c914.t: अवशिष्टानि काजूतकानि उपरि दत्त्वा उष्णां परिवेषयतु।
seg.351e9512c914.back: Put the remaining cashews on top and serve hot.

seg.4643e12d303d.src: Pour the rava in a thin stream while stirring so no lumps form.
seg.4643e12d303d.t: पिण्डाः मा भवेयुः इति चालयन् तनुधारया रवां पातयतु।
seg.4643e12d303d.back: Pour in the rava in a thin stream while stirring so that lumps do not form.

seg.3c98bb62770b.src: Roasting the rava first keeps each grain separate; skip it and the upma turns sticky.
seg.3c98bb62770b.t: प्रथमं रवाभर्जनेन प्रत्येकः कणः पृथक् तिष्ठति; तत् त्यक्तं चेत् उप्मा पिच्छिला भवति।
seg.3c98bb62770b.back: By roasting the rava first each grain stays separate; if that is skipped the upma becomes sticky.

seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.src: Fry the cashews on medium-low heat and lift them out as soon as they turn golden; they keep darkening in the hot ghee.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.t: काजूतकानि मध्यम-मन्दाग्नौ भर्जयतु सुवर्णवर्णानि भवन्ति एव उद्धरतु च; उष्णघृते तानि गाढीभवन्ति एव।
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.back: Roast the cashews on medium-low fire and take them out as soon as they become golden; in the hot ghee they keep on darkening.

seg.975560a8a158.src: Upma firms up as it stands, so take it off the heat when it is a little softer than you want.
seg.975560a8a158.t: स्थिता उप्मा दृढीभवति, अतः भवतः इष्टात् किञ्चित् मृद्वी सती एव अग्नेः अवतारयतु।
seg.975560a8a158.back: Upma that has stood becomes firm, so take it off the fire while it is a little softer than you like.

seg.508f0ab3992d.src: Vegetable upma: add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and green peas with the onion and cook them for 3–4 minutes before the water goes in.
seg.508f0ab3992d.t: शाक-उप्मा: पलाण्डुना सह ½ चषकं कर्तितानि गृञ्जन-शिम्बा-हरितकलायानि योजयतु, जलयोजनात् पूर्वं 3–4 निमेषान् पचतु।
seg.508f0ab3992d.back: Vegetable upma: with the onion add ½ cup cut carrot-beans-green peas, cook 3–4 minutes before adding the water.

seg.1742d7bd0e23.src: Tomato upma: add 1 chopped tomato after the onion and cook till soft before adding the water.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.t: टमाटा-उप्मा: पलाण्डोः अनन्तरं 1 कर्तितां टमाटां योजयित्वा जलयोजनात् पूर्वं मृदुत्वपर्यन्तं पचतु।
seg.1742d7bd0e23.back: Tomato upma: after the onion add 1 cut tomato and cook until soft before adding the water.

seg.1981c7f3fc60.src: Godhuma rava upma: use the same amount of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook it covered for 5–6 minutes.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.t: गोधुम रवा उप्मा: तावत्प्रमाणां गोधूमरवां 3 चषकैः जलैः सह प्रयुज्य आच्छाद्य 5–6 निमेषान् पचतु।
seg.1981c7f3fc60.back: Godhuma rava upma: use the same quantity of wheat rava with 3 cups of water and cook covered 5–6 minutes.

seg.01300d94ad36.src: Serve hot as a breakfast tiffin with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or a spoon of sugar, or next to pesarattu for pesarattu upma.
seg.01300d94ad36.t: प्रातराशरूपेण नारिकेल-अवलेहेन, अल्लम पच्चडि (आर्द्रक-अवलेहः) इत्यनेन, चमसमात्रया शर्करया वा सह, अथवा पेसरट्टु-उप्मायै पेसरट्टु-पार्श्वे उष्णां परिवेषयतु।
seg.01300d94ad36.back: As breakfast serve hot with coconut chutney, allam pachadi (ginger chutney), or a spoonful of sugar, or for pesarattu-upma beside pesarattu.

seg.3316a3d82f44.src: Upma is best eaten hot, soon after it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and sprinkle with water before reheating.
seg.3316a3d82f44.t: उप्मा निर्माणात् परं शीघ्रम् उष्णा एव भक्षणीया। अवशिष्टाम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां 1 दिनं यावत् स्थापयतु, पुनस्तापनात् पूर्वं जलं प्रोक्षयतु।
seg.3316a3d82f44.back: Upma should be eaten soon after making, while still hot. Cover the leftover and keep in the refrigerator up to 1 day, sprinkle water before reheating.

seg.b53646711bf0.src: How do I make upma without lumps?
seg.b53646711bf0.back: How do I make upma without lumps?

seg.429b54b4ab3a.src: Keep the water at a boil, turn the heat to low and pour in the rava in a thin stream with one hand while you stir with the other.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.t: जलं क्वथमानं रक्षतु, अग्निं मन्दं करोतु, एकेन हस्तेन तनुधारया रवां पातयन् अन्येन चालयतु।
seg.429b54b4ab3a.back: Keep the water boiling, lower the fire, and stir with one hand while pouring the rava in a thin stream with the other.

seg.0c2874233201.src: What is the right rava to water ratio for upma?
seg.0c2874233201.back: What is the right proportion of rava and water for upma?

seg.91a8fe1a38a5.src: For a soft Andhra-style upma, use 2½ cups water to 1 cup bombay rava. Use 2 cups for a firmer, more separate upma.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.t: मृद्व्यै आन्ध्रशैल्याः उप्मायै 1 चषकाय बॉम्बे-रवायै 2½ चषकाः जलम्। दृढतरायै पृथक्कणायै उप्मायै 2 चषकौ।
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.back: For soft Andhra-style upma 2½ cups of water for 1 cup of Bombay rava. For a firmer, separate-grain upma 2 cups.

seg.bd11a83d27d8.src: The rava was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the rava till it smells toasty, and stay close to 2½ cups water per cup.
seg.bd11a83d27d8.t: रवा न भृष्टा आसीत्, अथवा अतिजलं योजितम्। रवां भृष्टगन्धपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु, प्रतिचषकं प्रायः 2½ चषकाः जलं रक्षतु।
seg.bd11a83d27d8.back: The rava was not roasted, or too much water was added. Roast the rava until it smells roasted, keep about 2½ cups of water per cup.

seg.247181e411d9.src: When should I add cashews to upma?
seg.247181e411d9.back: When should I add the cashews to the upma?

seg.83f262d9c56e.src: Fry them in the ghee first and lift them out, then stir them in at the end. Added early, they turn soft in the upma.
seg.83f262d9c56e.t: प्रथमं घृते भर्जयित्वा उद्धरतु, ततः अन्ते मिश्रयतु। पूर्वं योजितानि उप्मायां मृदूनि भवन्ति।
seg.83f262d9c56e.back: First roast them in ghee and take them out, then mix in at the end. Added earlier they become soft in the upma.

seg.8b57b24af158.src: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra rava upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quick morning tiffin. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 3.
seg.8b57b24af158.t: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. घृते सुवर्णवर्णं भृष्टैः जीडिपप्पु-काजूतकैः सह आन्ध्रस्य रवा-उप्मा, मृदुः शीघ्रसिद्धः प्रातराशः। क्रमशः विधिः, सूचनाः, प्रश्नोत्तराणि च। 3 जनेभ्यः।
seg.8b57b24af158.back: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra's rava upma with Jeedipappu cashews roasted golden in ghee, a soft quick breakfast. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers. For 3 people.

seg.661f01591624.src: Jeedipappu Upma: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.661f01591624.t: जीडिपप्पु उप्मा: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.661f01591624.back: Jeedipappu Upma: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.992a8475993f.src: Kodi vepudu is the dry Andhra chicken fry: small pieces of chicken cooked in their own juices, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and a just-roasted masala until dark and sticky with spice. It is the starter at Andhra weddings and the side that sits next to rasam rice or pappu at home.
seg.992a8475993f.t: कोडि वेपुडु इति शुष्कम् आन्ध्र-भृष्टकुक्कुटमांसम्: लघवः कुक्कुटमांसखण्डाः स्वरसे पक्त्वा, ततः कृष्णनिम्बपत्रैः, हरितमरिचैः, सद्यः भृष्टमसालया च सह तैले दृढं भृज्यन्ते, यावत् गाढवर्णाः मसालया लिप्ताः च भवन्ति। आन्ध्रविवाहेषु प्रथमं व्यञ्जनम्, गृहे च रसम्-ओदनस्य पप्पोः वा पार्श्वे भवति।
seg.992a8475993f.back: Kodi vepudu is dry Andhra fried chicken: small chicken pieces are cooked in their own juices, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and freshly roasted masala, until they become dark coloured and coated with the masala. It is the first dish at Andhra weddings, and at home it is beside rasam-rice or pappu.

seg.db90598234ea.src: Our Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the heat Andhra fries are known for, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashew kernels, fried golden, go in at the end. Serves 4 as a side.
seg.db90598234ea.t: अस्माकं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम् अस्मै गाढरक्तवर्णम् आन्ध्रभर्जितव्यञ्जनानां प्रसिद्धां तीक्ष्णतां च ददाति, अस्माकं हरिद्राचूर्णं लेपने योज्यते, अस्माकम् अखण्डकाजूतकानि सुवर्णवर्णं भृष्टानि अन्ते योज्यन्ते। पार्श्वव्यञ्जनरूपेण 4 जनेभ्यः।
