seg.db90598234ea.back: Our Teja red chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and the famous heat of Andhra fry dishes, our turmeric powder is added in the marinade, and our whole cashews roasted golden are added at the end. As a side dish for 4 people.

seg.22b3994cc48a.src: Marinate chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook it in its own juices, then fry it dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and cashews.
seg.22b3994cc48a.t: कुक्कुटमांसं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, हरिद्राचूर्णेन, आर्द्रक-लशुन-पिष्टेन, जम्बीरेण च लेपयतु, स्वरसे पचतु, ततः कृष्णनिम्बपत्रैः, हरितमरिचैः, भृष्टमसालया, काजूतकैः च सह शुष्कं भर्जयतु।
seg.22b3994cc48a.back: Marinate the chicken with Teja red chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook in its own juices, then fry dry with curry leaves, green chillies, roasted masala and cashews.

seg.4cb33a348eb8.src: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.t: 500 g अस्थिरहितं कुक्कुटमांसम् ⟦1⟧1 अङ्गुलप्रमाणखण्डेषु कर्तितम्; अथवा 600 g सास्थि लघुखण्डाः⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.back: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1-inch pieces; or 600 g bone-in small pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.57789012bc80.src: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashew kernels; halve any large ones⟦/1⟧

seg.8df3bc4567e3.src: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the marinade sticks.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.t: लेपनं लगेत् इति कुक्कुटमांसं वस्त्रेण शोषयतु।
seg.8df3bc4567e3.back: Dry the chicken with a cloth so that the marinade sticks.

seg.075327f4deca.src: Marinate the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt, 30 minutes. Mix well with your hands so every piece is coated.
seg.075327f4deca.t: कुक्कुटमांसं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, हरिद्रया, आर्द्रक-लशुन-पिष्टेन, जम्बीररसेन, लवणेन च 30 निमेषान् लेपयतु। हस्ताभ्यां सम्यक् मिश्रयतु येन प्रत्येकः खण्डः लिप्तः भवति।
seg.075327f4deca.back: Marinate the chicken 30 minutes with Teja red chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt. Mix well with the hands so that each piece is coated.

seg.63af904bba96.src: Meanwhile, dry-roast the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low heat until fragrant and a shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.
seg.63af904bba96.t: तावत् लघुस्थाल्यां मन्दाग्नौ धान्यकबीजानि, जीरकं, शतपुष्पाबीजानि, लवङ्गानि, त्वचं च तैलं विना सुगन्धपर्यन्तम् एकछायया गाढानि यावत् भर्जयतु, प्रायः 2 निमेषाः। शीतलीकृत्य स्थूलचूर्णं पिनष्टु। एषा भर्जनमसाला।
seg.63af904bba96.back: Meanwhile in a small pan on low fire roast coriander seeds, cumin, fennel seeds, cloves and cinnamon without oil until fragrant and one shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the roasted masala.

seg.4406ac2e72fe.src: Put the chicken in a heavy kadai with no water, cover and set it on medium heat.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.t: कुक्कुटमांसं जलं विना स्थूलकटाहे स्थापयित्वा आच्छाद्य मध्यमाग्नौ स्थापयतु।
seg.4406ac2e72fe.back: Place the chicken without water in a thick kadai, cover and put it on medium fire.

seg.93ccca0c5178.src: Cook it covered in its own juices till no pink remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; the chicken releases water as it cooks.
seg.93ccca0c5178.t: आच्छाद्य स्वरसे पाटलवर्णः यावत् न अवशिष्यते तावत् पचतु, प्रायः 12 निमेषाः। एकवारं द्विवारं वा चालयतु; पच्यमानं कुक्कुटमांसं जलं मुञ्चति।
seg.93ccca0c5178.back: Covered, cook in its own juices until no pink colour remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; the chicken releases water as it cooks.

seg.32f3a3f56679.src: Uncover and cook on high, stirring, until the liquid has almost dried up, 3–4 minutes. Tip the chicken out onto a plate and wipe the kadai.
seg.32f3a3f56679.t: अनाच्छाद्य तीव्राग्नौ चालयन् पचतु, यावत् द्रवः प्रायः शुष्यति, 3–4 निमेषाः। कुक्कुटमांसं स्थाल्यां पातयित्वा कटाहं मार्जयतु।
seg.32f3a3f56679.back: Uncovered, cook on high fire while stirring, until the liquid almost dries, 3–4 minutes. Tip the chicken onto a plate and wipe the kadai.

seg.f3e846aa4edd.src: Heat the oil in the kadai on medium heat.
seg.f3e846aa4edd.back: Heat oil in the kadai on medium fire.

seg.e210c9534a07.src: Fry the cashews in oil till golden; lift out. They take under a minute, so stir them all the time and lift them out with a slotted spoon.
seg.e210c9534a07.t: काजूतकानि तैले सुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु; उद्धरतु। तेभ्यः निमेषात् न्यूनः कालः लगति, अतः सततं चालयित्वा छिद्रचमसेन उद्धरतु।
seg.e210c9534a07.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden; take them out. They take less than a minute, so stir constantly and take them out with a slotted spoon.

seg.09e282d2e36f.src: Add the onion, if using, and fry until golden. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand back; the leaves crackle and spit.
seg.09e282d2e36f.t: प्रयुज्यते चेत् पलाण्डुं योजयित्वा सुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु। हरितमरिचान् कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि च भर्जयतु। किञ्चित् दूरे तिष्ठतु; पत्राणि चटचटायन्ते तैलं च विक्षिपन्ति।
seg.09e282d2e36f.back: If used add the onion and fry until golden. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand a little away; the leaves crackle and splatter oil.

seg.1fae224eb27a.src: Add the chicken and fry masala. Fry on high till dry and dark, then toss in the cashews. Keep tossing for 6–8 minutes, until the masala clings to the pieces and the edges turn dark and crisp.
seg.1fae224eb27a.t: कुक्कुटमांसं भर्जनमसालां च योजयतु। तीव्राग्नौ शुष्कं गाढं च यावत् भर्जयतु, ततः काजूतकानि मिश्रयतु। 6–8 निमेषान् परिवर्तयन् तिष्ठतु, यावत् मसाला खण्डेषु लगति प्रान्ताः च गाढाः खराः च भवन्ति।
seg.1fae224eb27a.back: Add the chicken and roasted masala. Fry on high fire until dry and dark, then mix in the cashews. Keep turning 6–8 minutes, until the masala clings to the pieces and the edges become dark and crisp.

seg.0b62f402945c.src: Taste, add salt if needed, scatter the coriander leaves and serve hot.
seg.0b62f402945c.t: आस्वाद्य आवश्यकं चेत् लवणं योजयतु, धान्यकपत्राणि प्रकीर्य उष्णं परिवेषयतु।
seg.0b62f402945c.back: Taste and add salt if needed, sprinkle coriander leaves and serve hot.

seg.349c72ce839a.src: Fry it on high heat at the end so the masala clings to every piece.
seg.349c72ce839a.t: अन्ते तीव्राग्नौ भर्जयतु येन मसाला प्रत्येकस्मिन् खण्डे लगति।
seg.349c72ce839a.back: At the end fry on high fire so that the masala clings to every piece.

seg.d287ba2c2c11.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or swap in Sannam chilli powder for the red colour with less fire.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.t: तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम् अतितीक्ष्णम्। मध्यमतीक्ष्णतायै 1 लघुचमसं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, अथवा रक्तवर्णाय न्यूनतीक्ष्णतायै च तस्य स्थाने सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम्।
seg.d287ba2c2c11.back: Teja red chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or for red colour and less heat Sannam red chilli powder in its place.

seg.a0ef9b138cd4.src: Cut the pieces small and even so they cook through at the same time and crisp up well in the fry.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.t: खण्डान् लघून् समान् च कर्तयतु येन एककाले पच्यन्ते भर्जने च सम्यक् खराः भवन्ति।
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.back: Cut the pieces small and equal so that they cook at the same time and become properly crisp in frying.

seg.d72b3c1c529a.src: Grind the fry masala just before you cook; the roasted spice smell is the soul of a good vepudu.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.t: पाकात् किञ्चित् पूर्वम् एव भर्जनमसालां पिनष्टु; भृष्टमसालानां गन्धः एव उत्तमस्य वेपुडोः आत्मा।
seg.d72b3c1c529a.back: Grind the roasting masala only a little before cooking; the aroma of roasted spices is the very soul of a good vepudu.

seg.62d6684e446e.src: Bone-in: use 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook them in their juices for 18–20 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone.
seg.62d6684e446e.t: सास्थि: 600 g सास्थि लघुखण्डान् प्रयुज्य स्वरसे 18–20 निमेषान् पचतु, यावत् अस्थिसमीपे पाटलवर्णः न अवशिष्यते।
seg.62d6684e446e.back: Bone-in: use 600 g bone-in small pieces and cook in their own juices 18–20 minutes, until no pink colour remains near the bone.

seg.6960fe7f3ff8.src: Kobbari vepudu: add 3 tbsp grated dry coconut to the fry with the masala and toss until it browns.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.t: कोब्बरि वेपुडु: मसालया सह भर्जने 3 महाचमसान् घृष्टशुष्कनारिकेलं योजयित्वा पिङ्गलत्वपर्यन्तं परिवर्तयतु।
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.back: Kobbari Vepudu: in frying with the masala add 3 tablespoons grated dry coconut and turn until browned.

seg.afd92118eb80.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, then fry it the same way.
seg.afd92118eb80.t: अजमांस-वेपुडु: 500 g अस्थिरहितम् अजमांसं लेपनेन ½ चषकेण जलेन च सह प्रेशर-कुकरे 5–6 सीत्कारपर्यन्तं पचतु, ततः तथैव भर्जयतु।
seg.afd92118eb80.back: Goat meat vepudu: cook 500 g boneless goat meat with the marinade and ½ cup water in a pressure cooker up to 5–6 whistles, then fry in the same way.

seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.src: Serve hot as a side with rasam rice, pappu and rice or sambar rice, or on its own as a starter with sliced onion and lemon wedges.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.t: रसम्-ओदनेन, पप्पु-ओदनेन, साम्बार्-ओदनेन वा सह पार्श्वव्यञ्जनरूपेण, अथवा कर्तितपलाण्डुना जम्बीरखण्डैः च सह केवलं प्रथमव्यञ्जनरूपेण उष्णं परिवेषयतु।
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.back: Serve hot as a side dish with rasam-rice, pappu-rice or sambar-rice, or just as a starter with cut onion and lemon pieces.

seg.b7598301bd86.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until steaming hot all the way through; it crisps up again.
seg.b7598301bd86.t: आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां 2 दिनानि यावत् स्थापयतु। उष्णस्थाल्यां कतिपयैः तैलबिन्दुभिः सह अन्तः यावत् सम्पूर्णतया बाष्पोष्णं न भवति तावत् पुनः तापयतु; पुनः खरं भवति।
seg.b7598301bd86.back: Cover and keep in the refrigerator up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until it is completely steaming hot inside; it becomes crisp again.

seg.551573b4b443.src: What is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry in Andhra?
seg.551573b4b443.t: आन्ध्रे भृष्टकुक्कुटमांसस्य कुक्कुटमांसव्यञ्जनस्य च कः भेदः?
seg.551573b4b443.back: In Andhra what is the difference between fried chicken and chicken curry?

seg.dbeff7335e31.src: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juices, then fried until the masala coats it with no gravy. Kodi kura is a curry with an onion-tomato gravy for rice.
seg.dbeff7335e31.t: वेपुडु शुष्कम्: कुक्कुटमांसं स्वरसे पक्त्वा, ततः रसं विना मसाला यावत् आवृणोति तावत् भृज्यते। कोडि कूरा ओदनाय पलाण्डु-टमाटा-रसयुक्तं व्यञ्जनम्।
seg.dbeff7335e31.back: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juices, then fried without gravy until the masala coats it. Kodi koora is a curry with onion-tomato gravy for rice.

seg.439aacfe8e34.src: Should I use boneless or bone-in chicken for vepudu?
seg.439aacfe8e34.t: वेपुडवे अस्थिरहितं सास्थि वा कुक्कुटमांसं प्रयुञ्जीय?
seg.439aacfe8e34.back: Should I use boneless or bone-in chicken for vepudu?

seg.982f470b118d.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need about 8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.982f470b118d.t: उभयम् उपयुक्तम्। अस्थिरहितं शीघ्रं पच्यते अधिकं खरं च भवति; सास्थि लघुखण्डेषु अधिकः स्वादः, किन्तु स्वरसे प्रायः 8 निमेषाः अधिकाः लगन्ति।
seg.982f470b118d.back: Both are suitable. Boneless cooks quickly and becomes more crisp; bone-in small pieces have more flavour, but take about 8 minutes more in their own juices.

seg.ade697e78f9b.src: Cut open the thickest piece. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juices run clear.
seg.ade697e78f9b.t: स्थूलतमं खण्डं छित्त्वा पश्यतु। यदा मध्ये (अस्थिसमीपे वा) पाटलवर्णः न अवशिष्यते रसः च स्वच्छः निर्गच्छति, तदा कुक्कुटमांसं पक्वम्।
seg.ade697e78f9b.back: Cut the thickest piece and look. When no pink colour remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juice comes out clear, then the chicken is cooked.

seg.eddd3046275b.src: How do I make kodi vepudu less spicy?
seg.eddd3046275b.back: How do I make kodi vepudu less hot?

seg.9b5459aec9d6.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder, or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour full.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.t: 1 लघुचमसं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, अथवा तस्य स्थाने सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम्, केवलं 2 हरितमरिचौ च विदारयतु। काजूतकानि कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि च स्वादं पूर्णं रक्षन्ति।
seg.9b5459aec9d6.back: Use 1 teaspoon Teja red chilli powder, or Sannam red chilli powder in its place, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour full.

seg.a00af5cf9954.src: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra Chicken Fry) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.back: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra fried chicken) | 1acrefarms

seg.1af4fbb646e3.src: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra chicken fry: chicken in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and our cashews.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.t: కోడి వేపుడు. आन्ध्र-भृष्टकुक्कुटमांसम्: तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन हरिद्राचूर्णेन च लिप्तं कुक्कुटमांसं, कृष्णनिम्बपत्रैः, हरितमरिचैः, भृष्टमसालया, अस्माकं काजूतकैः च सह शुष्कं भृष्टम्।
seg.1af4fbb646e3.back: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra fried chicken: chicken coated with Teja red chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chillies, roasted masala and our cashews.

seg.917dba1166ab.src: Kodi Vepudu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.917dba1166ab.t: कोडि वेपुडु: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.917dba1166ab.back: Kodi Vepudu: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.f9771e2222df.src: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice tossed with a crackling tempering of peanuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, green chillies and curry leaves, then soured with lemon juice. It is the rice packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and it is made in big batches for festivals and pujas.
seg.f9771e2222df.t: निम्मकाय पुलिहोरा इति आन्ध्रगृहाणां दीप्तपीतं जम्बीरौदनम्: पक्वम् ओदनं भूचणक-चणकदाल-माषदाल-सर्षप-हरितमरिच-कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणां चटचटायमानेन संस्कारेण सह मिश्रयित्वा जम्बीररसेन अम्लीक्रियते। एतत् रेलयात्रायै, विद्यालयभोजनपेटिकाभ्यः, देवालयदिनेभ्यः च बध्यमानम् ओदनम्, उत्सवेभ्यः पूजाभ्यः च बृहत्प्रमाणेन क्रियते।
seg.f9771e2222df.back: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice is mixed with a crackling tempering of groundnuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, green chillies and curry leaves and soured with lemon juice. It is the rice packed for train journeys, school lunch boxes and temple days, and made in large quantity for festivals and pujas.

seg.ac569e0882d5.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the hot oil for a few seconds, which turns every grain an even golden yellow and takes away its raw edge. This recipe serves 4.
seg.ac569e0882d5.t: अस्माकं हरिद्राचूर्णं कतिपयक्षणान् उष्णतैले योज्यते, येन प्रत्येकः कणः समं सुवर्णपीतः भवति तस्य आमभावः च अपगच्छति। अयं पाकविधिः 4 जनेभ्यः।
seg.ac569e0882d5.back: Our turmeric powder is added to the hot oil for a few moments, so that every grain becomes evenly golden-yellow and its rawness goes away. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.d194bee0cc5e.src: Total includes cooking the rice and a 15-minute rest so the flavours settle.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.t: ओदनपाकः स्वादस्थिरीकरणाय 15 निमेषाणां स्थापनं च आहत्य-काले गणितौ।
seg.d194bee0cc5e.back: Cooking the rice and 15 minutes of resting for the flavour to settle are counted in the total time.

seg.1cfa4342f462.src: Fry peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and hing, then toss with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.
seg.1cfa4342f462.t: भूचणकान्, दालानि, सर्षपान्, मरिचान्, कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि च तैले भर्जयतु, हरिद्राचूर्णं हिङ्गु च योजयतु, ततः शीतलेन ओदनेन, लवणेन, जम्बीररसेन च सह मिश्रयतु।
seg.1cfa4342f462.back: Fry groundnuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and asafoetida, then mix with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.

seg.2561142fed2c.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; gives about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.t: 1 चषकं तण्डुलाः ⟦1⟧सोना मसूरी, प्रायः 200 g; प्रायः 3 चषकाः ओदनं भवति⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masuri, about 200 g; makes about 3 cups of cooked rice⟦/1⟧

seg.06ba75699134.src: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.t: 3 चषकाः पक्वौदनम् ⟦1⟧किञ्चित् दृढं पक्वम्, कणाः पृथक्⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.back: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧

seg.fbba93c11bc9.src: 3 tbsp lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; add more to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.back: 3 tablespoons lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; more to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.e254f20f8f14.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧

seg.bc63d9715c03.src: Wash the rice and cook it with 2 cups of water until just done, so the grains stay separate. You need about 3 cups of cooked rice.
seg.bc63d9715c03.t: तण्डुलान् प्रक्षाल्य 2 चषकैः जलैः सह केवलं पक्वपर्यन्तं पचतु येन कणाः पृथक् तिष्ठन्ति। प्रायः 3 चषकाः पक्वौदनम् आवश्यकम्।
seg.bc63d9715c03.back: Wash the rice and cook with 2 cups of water only until cooked so that the grains stay separate. About 3 cups of cooked rice are needed.

seg.adb2b75edafc.src: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add the salt. Fluff it with a fork and let it sit about 10 minutes until warm, not hot, so the grains do not break when mixed.
seg.adb2b75edafc.t: पक्वौदनं शीतलीकरणाय स्थाल्यां प्रसारयतु; लवणं योजयतु। कण्टकचमसेन विरलीकृत्य प्रायः 10 निमेषान् स्थापयतु यावत् कोष्णं भवति, न उष्णम्, येन मिश्रणसमये कणाः न भिद्यन्ते।
seg.adb2b75edafc.back: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add salt. Loosen it with a fork and keep about 10 minutes until it is lukewarm, not hot, so that the grains do not break while mixing.

seg.e05322a3ed24.src: Heat the oil; fry the peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves. Start with the peanuts on medium heat and fry them about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins darken.
seg.e05322a3ed24.t: तैलं तापयतु; भूचणकान्, दालानि, सर्षपान्, मरिचान्, कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि च भर्जयतु। मध्यमाग्नौ भूचणकैः आरभ्य प्रायः 2 निमेषान् भर्जयतु यावत् ते चटचटायन्ते त्वचः च गाढाः भवन्ति।
seg.e05322a3ed24.back: Heat the oil; fry the groundnuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves. On medium fire start with the groundnuts and fry about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins become dark.

seg.542a4fea7b18.src: Add the chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.
seg.542a4fea7b18.t: चणकदालं माषदालं च योजयित्वा लघुसुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु, प्रायः 1 निमेषम्।
seg.542a4fea7b18.back: Add the chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.

seg.502483d7a042.src: Add the mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the dry red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves turn crisp.
seg.502483d7a042.t: सर्षपान् योजयित्वा स्फुटितुं ददातु, ततः शुष्करक्तमरिचान्, हरितमरिचान्, आर्द्रकं, कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि च योजयित्वा पत्राणि यावत् खराणि भवन्ति तावत् कतिपयक्षणान् भर्जयतु।
seg.502483d7a042.back: Add the mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the dry red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few moments until the leaves become crisp.

seg.6e856356980b.src: Stir in the turmeric powder and hing; switch off. Stir for 5–10 seconds only so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.
seg.6e856356980b.t: हरिद्राचूर्णं हिङ्गु च मिश्रयतु; अग्निं निर्वापयतु। केवलं 5–10 क्षणान् चालयतु येन हरिद्रा उष्णतैले अदग्धा पच्यते।
seg.6e856356980b.back: Mix in the turmeric powder and asafoetida; turn off the fire. Stir only 5–10 seconds so that the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.

seg.dd6ccaf923d8.src: Pour over the rice, add the lemon juice and mix gently. Use your fingers or a flat spatula and lift the rice from below so every grain turns yellow without turning mushy.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.t: ओदनस्य उपरि पातयतु, जम्बीररसं योजयित्वा मृदु मिश्रयतु। अङ्गुलीः समतलदर्वीं वा प्रयुज्य अधस्तात् ओदनम् उत्थापयतु येन प्रत्येकः कणः पीतः भवति न तु मर्दितः।
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.back: Pour over the rice, add the lemon juice and mix gently. Using the fingers or a flat ladle lift the rice from below so that every grain becomes yellow and is not mashed.

seg.1bfc2c04d40e.src: Taste and add more salt or lemon juice if needed. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, as the flavour softens on standing.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.t: आस्वाद्य आवश्यकं चेत् अधिकं लवणं जम्बीररसं वा योजयतु। ओदनं स्पष्टम् अम्लं लवणयुक्तं च लगेत्, यतः स्थितौ स्वादः मृदूभवति।
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.back: Taste and if needed add more salt or lemon juice. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, because on standing the taste softens.

seg.8cea6688d0fb.src: Cover and rest the pulihora for 15 minutes before serving so the rice takes in the lemon and tempering.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.t: परिवेषणात् पूर्वं पुलिहोराम् आच्छाद्य 15 निमेषान् स्थापयतु येन ओदनं जम्बीरस्य संस्कारस्य च स्वादं गृह्णाति।
seg.8cea6688d0fb.back: Before serving keep the pulihora covered 15 minutes so that the rice takes the flavour of the lemon and the tempering.

seg.c1a7043ce357.src: Add the lemon juice off the heat so it stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice turns bitter.
seg.c1a7043ce357.t: जम्बीररसम् अग्नेः बहिः योजयतु येन अम्लता तीक्ष्णा तिष्ठति। पक्वः जम्बीररसः तिक्तः भवति।
seg.c1a7043ce357.back: Add the lemon juice off the fire so that the sourness stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice becomes bitter.

seg.b634a4257b6c.src: Cook the rice slightly firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice turns pasty.
seg.b634a4257b6c.t: ओदनं किञ्चित् दृढं पचतु मिश्रणात् पूर्वं च शीतलीभवितुं ददातु; उष्णं मृदु ओदनं पिच्छिलं भवति।
seg.b634a4257b6c.back: Cook the rice a little firm and let it cool before mixing; hot soft rice becomes sticky.

seg.a1d93274ea3f.src: Keep the turmeric powder in the oil for just a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and a bitter taste.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.t: हरिद्राचूर्णं कतिपयक्षणान् एव तैले रक्षतु; दग्धा हरिद्रा गाढवर्णं तिक्तस्वादं च ददाति।
seg.a1d93274ea3f.back: Keep the turmeric powder in the oil only a few moments; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and a bitter taste.

seg.747474140bbf.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as the grains are already firm and separate.
seg.747474140bbf.t: प्रातःकालस्य अवशिष्टम् ओदनं सम्यक् उपयुज्यते, यतः कणाः पूर्वम् एव दृढाः पृथक् च।
seg.747474140bbf.back: Leftover rice from the morning works well, because the grains are already firm and separate.

seg.7a379d805448.src: Cashews: fry 10 cashew halves with the peanuts for a festive pulihora.
seg.7a379d805448.t: काजूतकानि: उत्सवपुलिहोरायै भूचणकैः सह 10 अर्धकाजूतकानि भर्जयतु।
seg.7a379d805448.back: Cashews: for festival pulihora fry 10 half-cashews with the groundnuts.

seg.be93899ec308.src: Mamidikaya pulihora: in place of lemon juice, mix in 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.
seg.be93899ec308.t: मामिडिकाय पुलिहोरा: जम्बीररसस्य स्थाने संस्कारेण सह 1 चषकं घृष्टम् अपक्वाम्रं मिश्रयतु।
seg.be93899ec308.back: Mamidikaya Pulihora: instead of the lemon juice mix in 1 cup grated unripe mango with the tempering.

seg.867dba923c04.src: Grated coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the lemon juice for a milder rice.
seg.867dba923c04.t: घृष्टनारिकेलम्: मृदुतराय ओदनाय जम्बीररसेन सह 2 महाचमसौ घृष्टनारिकेलं योजयतु।
seg.867dba923c04.back: Grated coconut: for a milder rice add 2 tablespoons grated coconut with the lemon juice.

seg.88b87529b506.src: Serve at room temperature with curd, a pickle or appadams. It is a classic tiffin-box and travel rice.
seg.88b87529b506.t: कक्षतापमाने दध्ना, सन्धानेन, पर्पटैः वा सह परिवेषयतु। एतत् भोजनपेटिकायाः यात्रायाः च प्रसिद्धम् ओदनम्।
seg.88b87529b506.back: Serve at room temperature with curd, pickle or papads. This is the famous rice of lunch boxes and journeys.

seg.9791f1c7a8e4.src: It keeps well at room temperature for about 6 hours, which is why it travels. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within a day.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.t: कक्षतापमाने प्रायः 6 होराः सम्यक् तिष्ठति, अतः यात्रायां नीयते। अवशिष्टम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु एकस्मिन् दिने च भक्षयतु।
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.back: At room temperature it keeps well about 6 hours, so it is taken on journeys. Cover the leftover, keep it in the refrigerator and eat within one day.

seg.c12ab7274709.src: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?
seg.c12ab7274709.back: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?

seg.44b56d19b9fb.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Switch off the stove before the turmeric goes in, and add the lemon juice only to the rice, off the heat.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.t: जम्बीररसः पक्वः, अथवा हरिद्रा तैले दग्धा। हरिद्रायोजनात् पूर्वं चुल्लीं निर्वापयतु, जम्बीररसं च केवलम् ओदने, अग्नेः बहिः योजयतु।
seg.44b56d19b9fb.back: The lemon juice was cooked, or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Turn off the stove before adding the turmeric, and add the lemon juice only into the rice, off the fire.

seg.69e4bfb93ba8.src: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.back: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?

seg.f2f993f1b94b.src: Pulihora is the Telugu name for soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon version, quicker to make and lighter in colour.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.t: पुलिहोरा अम्लौदनस्य तेलुगुनाम। चिन्तपण्डु पुलिहोरा चिञ्चापिष्टेन अम्लीक्रियते; निम्मकाय पुलिहोरा जम्बीरप्रकारः, शीघ्रसिद्धः लघुवर्णः च।
seg.f2f993f1b94b.back: Pulihora is the Telugu name of sour rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon type, quick to make and light in colour.

seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.src: How do I stop lemon rice from getting mushy?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.t: जम्बीरौदनं पिच्छिलं न भवेत् इति कथं करवाणि?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.back: How do I make sure the lemon rice does not become sticky?

seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.src: Cook the rice a little firm with less water, cool it on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from below instead of pressing.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.t: न्यूनेन जलेन ओदनं किञ्चित् दृढं पचतु, स्थाल्यां शीतलीकरोतु, निपीडनस्य स्थाने अधस्तात् उत्थाप्य मृदु मिश्रयतु।
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.back: Cook the rice a little firm with less water, cool it on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from below instead of pressing.

seg.dd00224f5f94.src: How much lemon juice for 3 cups of rice?
seg.dd00224f5f94.back: How much lemon juice for 3 cups of rice?

seg.50f8efabb87e.src: About 3 tbsp, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add it slowly and taste, because lemons vary in sourness.
seg.50f8efabb87e.t: प्रायः 3 महाचमसाः, 2 मध्यमजम्बीराणां रसः। मन्दं योजयित्वा आस्वादयतु, यतः जम्बीराणाम् अम्लता भिद्यते।
seg.50f8efabb87e.back: About 3 tablespoons, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add slowly and taste, because the sourness of lemons varies.

seg.2d3c4d5f7608.src: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra lemon rice: cooled rice tossed with a peanut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.t: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. आन्ध्रस्य जम्बीरौदनम्: शीतलम् ओदनं भूचणक-दाल-संस्कारेण, अस्माकं हरिद्राचूर्णेन, जम्बीररसेन च सह मिश्रितम्। क्रमशः विधिः, सूचनाः, प्रश्नोत्तराणि च।
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.back: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra's lemon rice: cooled rice mixed with a groundnut-dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.5f0282fcd0a8.src: Nimmakaya Pulihora: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.t: निम्मकाय पुलिहोरा: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.8922ef1e3767.src: Pasupu annam is plain rice turned bright yellow with turmeric and tossed in a crackling tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, with fried cashews on top. Andhra homes make it for lunch boxes, for quick weekday meals and as a prasadam on puja days, often with the morning's leftover rice.
seg.8922ef1e3767.t: पसुपु अन्नम् इति हरिद्रया दीप्तपीतीकृतं साधारणम् ओदनं, सर्षप-चणकदाल-कृष्णनिम्बपत्र-हरितमरिचानां चटचटायमानेन संस्कारेण सह मिश्रितम्, उपरि भृष्टकाजूतकैः सह। आन्ध्रगृहेषु भोजनपेटिकाभ्यः, सप्ताहदिनानां शीघ्रभोजनाय, पूजादिनेषु प्रसादरूपेण च क्रियते, प्रायः प्रातःकालस्य अवशिष्टेन ओदनेन।
seg.8922ef1e3767.back: Pasupu annam is plain rice made bright yellow with turmeric, mixed with a crackling tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, with roasted cashews on top. In Andhra homes it is made for lunch boxes, for quick weekday meals and as prasadam on puja days, usually with leftover rice from the morning.

seg.510252086556.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) gives the rice its deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric smell, so half a teaspoon is enough for 4. Whole cashews (Jeedipappu) fried in the same oil add the crunch.
seg.510252086556.t: अस्माकं गिरिहरिद्राचूर्णं (कोण्डा पसुपु) ओदनाय गाढपीतवर्णं मृत्तिकासदृशं हरिद्रागन्धं च ददाति, अतः 4 जनेभ्यः अर्धलघुचमसः पर्याप्तः। तस्मिन्नेव तैले भृष्टानि अखण्डकाजूतकानि (जीडिपप्पु) खरत्वं योजयन्ति।
seg.510252086556.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) gives the rice a deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric aroma, so for 4 people half a teaspoon is enough. Whole cashews (jeedipappu) roasted in the same oil add crispness.

seg.38badedc8d11.src: Total includes about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.
seg.38badedc8d11.t: पक्वौदनस्य शीतलीभवनाय प्रायः 15 निमेषाः अपि आहत्य-काले गणिताः।
seg.38badedc8d11.back: About 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool are also counted in the total time.

seg.8ad70ebff643.src: Cook rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and toss in the rice.
seg.8ad70ebff643.t: ओदनं पक्त्वा शीतलीभवितुं ददातु। काजूतकानि, सर्षपान्, चणकदालं, मरिचान्, कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि च तैले भर्जयतु, गिरिहरिद्राचूर्णं योजयित्वा ओदनं मिश्रयतु।
seg.8ad70ebff643.back: Cook the rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add the hill turmeric powder and mix in the rice.

seg.bc286f12f1ba.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; makes about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.t: 1 चषकं तण्डुलाः ⟦1⟧सोना मसूरी, प्रायः 200 g; प्रायः 3 चषकाः ओदनं भवति⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masuri, about 200 g; makes about 3 cups of cooked rice⟦/1⟧

seg.06cd9d581aec.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu⟦/1⟧

seg.399f19de4e13.src: 1 tbsp ghee (optional) ⟦1⟧stirred in at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.back: 1 tablespoon ghee (optional) ⟦1⟧for mixing in at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.53fcfe53b909.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.53fcfe53b909.t: तण्डुलान् 2–3 वारं जलं परिवर्त्य प्रक्षाल्य जलं निःसारयतु।
seg.53fcfe53b909.back: Wash the rice 2–3 times changing the water and drain the water.

seg.cdcf37be99e8.src: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate, then spread it on a plate to cool. Use 2 cups water to 1 cup rice in a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles), and fluff it with a fork before spreading it out.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.t: कणाः पृथक् तिष्ठेयुः इति ओदनं पचतु, ततः शीतलीकरणाय स्थाल्यां प्रसारयतु। भाण्डे प्रेशर-कुकरे वा (2 सीत्काराः) 1 चषकाय तण्डुलेभ्यः 2 चषकौ जलं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, प्रसारणात् पूर्वं कण्टकचमसेन विरलीकरोतु।
seg.cdcf37be99e8.back: Cook the rice so that the grains stay separate, then spread it on a plate to cool. In a pot or a pressure cooker (2 whistles) use 2 cups of water for 1 cup of rice, loosen with a fork before spreading.

seg.296995189451.src: Let the rice cool for about 15 minutes until it is just warm. Sprinkle the salt over it.
seg.296995189451.t: ओदनं प्रायः 15 निमेषान् शीतलीभवितुं ददातु यावत् केवलं कोष्णं भवति। उपरि लवणं प्रकिरतु।
seg.296995189451.back: Let the rice cool about 15 minutes until it is only lukewarm. Sprinkle salt on top.

seg.48839bd22983.src: Heat the oil in a wide kadai on medium heat.
seg.48839bd22983.back: Heat oil in a wide kadai on medium fire.

seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.src: Fry the cashews in the oil till golden; lift out. Add mustard seeds and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they turn golden in about 1 minute.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.t: काजूतकानि तैले सुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु; उद्धरतु। सर्षपान् चणकदालं च योजयतु। काजूतकानि स्थाल्यां स्थापयतु; प्रायः 1 निमेषे तानि सुवर्णवर्णानि भवन्ति।
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden; take them out. Add the mustard seeds and chana dal. Put the cashews on a plate; in about 1 minute they become golden.

seg.0729c6efc94a.src: Once the mustard seeds splutter, add the urad dal and the dried red chillies and stir.
seg.0729c6efc94a.t: सर्षपेषु स्फुटितेषु माषदालं शुष्करक्तमरिचान् च योजयित्वा चालयतु।
seg.0729c6efc94a.back: When the mustard seeds splutter add the urad dal and dry red chillies and stir.

seg.2688182af66a.src: When the dal turns golden, add the chillies and curry leaves, then the turmeric on low heat. Add the ginger and asafoetida with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric for only 5–10 seconds.
seg.2688182af66a.t: दाले सुवर्णवर्णे जाते मरिचान् कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि च योजयतु, ततः मन्दाग्नौ हरिद्राम्। कृष्णनिम्बपत्रैः सह आर्द्रकं हिङ्गु च योजयतु, हरिद्रां केवलं 5–10 क्षणान् चालयतु।
seg.2688182af66a.back: When the dal turns golden add the chillies and curry leaves, then on low fire the turmeric. Add ginger and asafoetida with the curry leaves, stir the turmeric only 5–10 seconds.

seg.59fd9b87153d.src: Switch off the heat straight away so the turmeric does not burn.
seg.59fd9b87153d.t: हरिद्रा न दह्येत इति सद्यः अग्निं निर्वापयतु।
seg.59fd9b87153d.back: Turn off the fire immediately so that the turmeric does not burn.

seg.15dc85e42ca1.src: Tip in the rice, cashews and salt and toss gently till evenly yellow. Use a flat spatula and lift and fold rather than pressing down, so the grains stay whole.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.t: ओदनं, काजूतकानि, लवणं च योजयित्वा समं पीतं यावत् मृदु मिश्रयतु। समतलदर्वीं प्रयुज्य निपीडनस्य स्थाने उत्थाप्य परिवर्तयतु, येन कणाः अखण्डाः तिष्ठन्ति।
seg.15dc85e42ca1.back: Add the rice, cashews and salt and mix gently until evenly yellow. Using a flat ladle lift and turn instead of pressing, so that the grains stay whole.

seg.b005e5771235.src: Taste for salt, stir in the ghee if using, cover and leave for 5 minutes before serving so the rice takes on the tempering.
seg.b005e5771235.t: लवणम् आस्वादयतु, प्रयुज्यते चेत् घृतं मिश्रयतु, आच्छाद्य परिवेषणात् पूर्वं 5 निमेषान् स्थापयतु येन ओदनं संस्कारस्वादं गृह्णाति।
seg.b005e5771235.back: Taste the salt, mix in ghee if used, cover and keep 5 minutes before serving so that the rice takes the taste of the tempering.

seg.9bce1ed4dbee.src: Spread the rice to cool first so the grains do not break.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.t: कणाः न भिद्येरन् इति प्रथमम् ओदनं प्रसार्य शीतलीकरोतु।
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.back: Spread the rice and cool it first so that the grains do not break.

seg.1f9a348f8750.src: Add the turmeric on low heat and stir for only a few seconds; burnt turmeric turns the rice bitter.
seg.1f9a348f8750.t: मन्दाग्नौ हरिद्रां योजयित्वा कतिपयक्षणान् एव चालयतु; दग्धा हरिद्रा ओदनं तिक्तं करोति।
seg.1f9a348f8750.back: Add the turmeric on low fire and stir only a few moments; burnt turmeric makes the rice bitter.

seg.394d01a50207.src: Hill turmeric powder colours strongly; start with ½ tsp for 1 cup of rice and add a pinch more only if you want a deeper yellow.
seg.394d01a50207.t: गिरिहरिद्राचूर्णं गाढं रञ्जयति; 1 चषकाय तण्डुलेभ्यः ½ लघुचमसेन आरभताम्, गाढतरं पीतवर्णम् इच्छति चेत् एव चिमटिकाम् अधिकां योजयतु।
seg.394d01a50207.back: Hill turmeric powder colours strongly; start with ½ teaspoon for 1 cup of rice, add one more pinch only if you want a deeper yellow colour.

seg.505872469eb9.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as long as the grains are separate.
seg.505872469eb9.t: कणाः पृथक् चेत् प्रातःकालस्य अवशिष्टम् ओदनं सम्यक् उपयुज्यते।
seg.505872469eb9.back: Leftover rice from the morning works well if the grains are separate.

seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.src: Turmeric powder: our everyday Pasupu turmeric powder works the same way; use the same ½ tsp.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.t: हरिद्राचूर्णम्: अस्माकं दैनिकं पसुपु हरिद्राचूर्णम् अपि तथैव कार्यं करोति; तमेव ½ लघुचमसं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.back: Turmeric powder: our everyday pasupu turmeric powder also does the same job; use the same ½ teaspoon.

seg.302f50dc74c9.src: Peanuts: fry 2 tbsp raw peanuts in the oil before the cashews for extra crunch.
seg.302f50dc74c9.t: भूचणकाः: अधिकखरत्वाय काजूतकेभ्यः पूर्वं तैले 2 महाचमसौ अपक्वभूचणकान् भर्जयतु।
seg.302f50dc74c9.back: Groundnuts: for more crunch fry 2 tablespoons raw groundnuts in the oil before the cashews.

seg.551f49339b3d.src: Lemon: squeeze in the juice of half a lemon with the rice for a tangy, pulihora-style rice.
seg.551f49339b3d.t: जम्बीरम्: अम्लाय पुलिहोरा-शैल्याः ओदनाय ओदनेन सह अर्धजम्बीरस्य रसं निष्पीडयतु।
seg.551f49339b3d.back: Lemon: for a sour pulihora-style rice squeeze the juice of half a lemon over the rice.

seg.6b9e9c07efba.src: Coconut: toss in 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the rice.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.t: नारिकेलम्: ओदनेन सह 2 महाचमसौ घृष्टनारिकेलं मिश्रयतु।
seg.6b9e9c07efba.back: Coconut: mix 2 tablespoons grated coconut with the rice.

seg.d541a1d237fc.src: Serve warm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry potato fry. It also packs well for lunch boxes and travel.
seg.d541a1d237fc.t: दध्ना, अप्पडालु इत्यनेन, शुष्कालुकभर्जितेन वा सह कोष्णं कक्षतापमानं वा परिवेषयतु। भोजनपेटिकाभ्यः यात्रायै च सम्यक् बध्यते।
seg.d541a1d237fc.back: Serve lukewarm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry potato fry. It packs well for lunch boxes and journeys.

seg.db97e1ae49fa.src: Best eaten the same day. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and warm them with a sprinkle of water.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.t: तस्मिन्नेव दिने भक्षणं श्रेष्ठम्। अवशिष्टम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां 1 दिनं यावत् स्थापयतु, किञ्चित् जलं प्रोक्ष्य तापयतु।
seg.db97e1ae49fa.back: Eating it the same day is best. Cover the leftover and keep in the refrigerator up to 1 day, sprinkle a little water and heat.

seg.54acb7b11b4c.src: How do you make pasupu annam?

seg.d99d12f26e71.src: Cook rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low heat for a few seconds, then toss in the rice with salt.
seg.d99d12f26e71.t: कणाः पृथक् तिष्ठेयुः इति ओदनं पक्त्वा शीतलीभवितुं ददातु। काजूतकानि, सर्षपान्, चणकदालं, मरिचान्, कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि च तैले भर्जयतु, मन्दाग्नौ कतिपयक्षणान् हरिद्रां योजयतु, ततः लवणेन सह ओदनं मिश्रयतु।
seg.d99d12f26e71.back: Cook the rice so that the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric for a few moments on low fire, then mix in the rice with salt.

seg.a4a87b4f7d63.src: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.back: How much turmeric powder is added to turmeric rice?

seg.aa37527cdcfb.src: About ½ tsp for 1 cup of raw rice (about 3 cups cooked). Hill turmeric powder colours strongly, so start with less and add a pinch more if needed.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.t: 1 चषकाय अपक्वतण्डुलेभ्यः (प्रायः 3 चषकाः ओदनम्) प्रायः ½ लघुचमसः। गिरिहरिद्राचूर्णं गाढं रञ्जयति, अतः न्यूनेन आरभ्य आवश्यकं चेत् चिमटिकाम् अधिकां योजयतु।
seg.aa37527cdcfb.back: About ½ teaspoon for 1 cup of uncooked rice (about 3 cups of cooked rice). Hill turmeric powder colours strongly, so start with less and add one more pinch if needed.

seg.3d200fb0e6fc.src: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.back: Why does my turmeric rice taste bitter?

seg.2c9da3559a42.src: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low heat, stir for only a few seconds and switch off before tipping in the rice.
seg.2c9da3559a42.t: हरिद्रा उष्णतैले दग्धा, अथवा अतिमात्रा योजिता। मन्दाग्नौ योजयतु, कतिपयक्षणान् एव चालयतु, ओदनयोजनात् पूर्वं च अग्निं निर्वापयतु।
seg.2c9da3559a42.back: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much was added. Add it on low fire, stir only a few moments, and turn off the fire before adding the rice.

seg.36ca370ac0d9.src: Can I make pasupu annam with leftover rice?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.t: अवशिष्टेन ओदनेन पसुपु अन्नम् कर्तुं शक्नोमि किम्?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.back: Can I make pasupu annam with leftover rice?

seg.71df75edcd26.src: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works well. Break up any lumps with your fingers before tossing it in the tempering.
seg.71df75edcd26.t: आम्। पृथक्कणयुक्तम् अवशिष्टम् ओदनं सम्यक् उपयुज्यते। संस्कारे मिश्रणात् पूर्वम् अङ्गुलीभिः पिण्डान् भिनत्तु।
seg.71df75edcd26.back: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works well. Break up the lumps with the fingers before mixing into the tempering.

seg.720281a9dc26.src: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice tossed in a mustard, chana dal and curry leaf tempering with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.720281a9dc26.t: పసుపు అన్నం. पसुपु अन्नम्, आन्ध्रस्य हरिद्रौदनम्: पक्वम् ओदनं सर्षप-चणकदाल-कृष्णनिम्बपत्र-संस्कारेण, गिरिहरिद्राचूर्णेन, भृष्टकाजूतकैः च सह मिश्रितम्। 4 जनेभ्यः।
seg.720281a9dc26.back: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra's turmeric rice: cooked rice mixed with a mustard-chana dal-curry leaf tempering, hill turmeric powder and roasted cashews. For 4 people.

seg.a5bf108c0e27.src: Pasupu Annam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.a5bf108c0e27.t: पसुपु अन्नम्: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.a5bf108c0e27.back: Pasupu Annam: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.cc1333072822.src: Ragi java is a pourable porridge of ragi flour cooked in water, a daily drink in many Andhra and Rayalaseema homes. The salted version is made with buttermilk; this sweet one is loosened with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and it is drunk warm from a steel tumbler at breakfast or in the evening.
seg.cc1333072822.t: रागि जावा इति जले पक्वस्य रागिपिष्टस्य पेया यवागूः, आन्ध्र-रायलसीमयोः बहुषु गृहेषु दैनिकं पेयम्। लवणयुक्तः प्रकारः तक्रेण क्रियते; अयं मधुरः प्रकारः दुग्धेन तनूक्रियते गुडेन मधुरीक्रियते च, प्रातराशे सायं वा स्टील्-टम्ब्लरात् कोष्णः पीयते।
seg.cc1333072822.back: Ragi java is a drinkable porridge of ragi flour cooked in water, a daily drink in many homes of Andhra and Rayalaseema. The salty type is made with buttermilk; this sweet type is thinned with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and drunk lukewarm from a steel tumbler at breakfast or in the evening.

seg.b29ec96bcd5c.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery suits the earthy taste of ragi and gives the java a toffee-brown colour. It takes about 15 minutes from start to finish. This recipe serves 2.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.t: अस्माकं ताटि बेल्लम तालगुडः रागेः मृत्तिकासदृशेन स्वादेन सह सङ्गच्छते जावायै टॉफी-सदृशं पिङ्गलवर्णं च ददाति। आरम्भात् अन्तपर्यन्तं प्रायः 15 निमेषाः लगन्ति। अयं पाकविधिः 2 जनेभ्यः।
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.back: Our tati bellam palm jaggery goes with the earthy taste of ragi and gives the java a toffee-like brown colour. From start to end it takes about 15 minutes. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.f65620e4f5c4.src: Total includes the 2-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.t: गुडयोजनात् पूर्वं 2 निमेषाणां स्थापनम् आहत्य-काले गणितम्।
seg.f65620e4f5c4.back: 2 minutes of resting before adding the jaggery are counted in the total time.

seg.f0a8282433d4.src: Whisk ragi flour into water, cook it in boiling water till thick and glossy, then add milk. Off the heat, stir in palm jaggery and cardamom.
seg.f0a8282433d4.t: रागिपिष्टं जले मथ्नातु, क्वथमाने जले घनत्वं चिक्कणत्वं च यावत् पचतु, ततः दुग्धं योजयतु। अग्नेः बहिः तालगुडम् एलाः च मिश्रयतु।
seg.f0a8282433d4.back: Whisk the ragi flour in water, cook in boiling water until thick and glossy, then add the milk. Off the fire mix in the palm jaggery and cardamom.

seg.41bd564147d7.src: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.back: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger-millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.d9504b3b8592.src: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup to mix the flour, 1 cup to boil⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.back: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup for mixing the flour, 1 cup for boiling⟦/1⟧

seg.0570314748ee.src: 3 tbsp grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; add a spoon more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.t: 3 महाचमसाः घृष्टतालगुडः ⟦1⟧प्रायः 30 g; अधिकमाधुर्याय चमसमात्रम् अधिकम्⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.back: 3 tablespoons grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; a spoonful more for more sweetness⟦/1⟧

seg.0a94735294ba.back: Can also be sweetened with ⟦1⟧sugarcane jaggery⟦/1⟧.

seg.2b7de8d37fd0.src: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.
seg.2b7de8d37fd0.back: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.

seg.fce6db4082ef.src: Whisk the ragi flour into 1 cup water till smooth, with no lumps. Use a whisk or a fork and break up any lumps against the side of the bowl.
seg.fce6db4082ef.t: रागिपिष्टं 1 चषके जले पिण्डरहितं मसृणं यावत् मथ्नातु। मन्थनीं कण्टकचमसं वा प्रयुज्य पिण्डान् पात्रस्य पार्श्वे निपीड्य भिनत्तु।
seg.fce6db4082ef.back: Whisk the ragi flour in 1 cup of water until smooth without lumps. Using a whisk or a fork press the lumps against the side of the bowl and break them.

seg.ac6b0e0e7003.src: Pour the remaining 1 cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan and set it on medium heat.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.t: अवशिष्टं 1 चषकं जलं स्थूलतलस्थाल्यां पातयित्वा मध्यमाग्नौ स्थापयतु।
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.back: Pour the remaining 1 cup of water into a thick-bottomed pan and put it on medium fire.

seg.ec55acf2b96a.src: Boil the other cup of water, pour in the ragi and stir on low heat till thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Stir the mix once more before pouring, as the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.t: अपरं चषकं जलं क्वाथयतु, रागिं पातयित्वा मन्दाग्नौ घनत्वं चिक्कणत्वं च यावत् चालयतु, 6–8 निमेषाः। पातनात् पूर्वं मिश्रणं पुनः एकवारं चालयतु, यतः पिष्टं पात्रतले उपविशति।
seg.ec55acf2b96a.back: Boil the other cup of water, pour in the ragi and stir on low fire until thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Before pouring stir the mixture once more, because the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.

seg.d0f8efa78d43.src: Keep stirring all the time. The java is cooked when it turns from dull pinkish-brown to a darker, glossy brown and coats the back of the spoon.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.t: सततं चालयन् तिष्ठतु। यदा जावा मलिन-पाटल-पिङ्गलवर्णात् गाढं चिक्कणं पिङ्गलवर्णं भूत्वा चमसस्य पृष्ठभागं लिम्पति, तदा पक्वा।
seg.d0f8efa78d43.back: Keep stirring constantly. When the java turns from a dull pinkish-brown colour to a deep glossy brown colour and coats the back of the spoon, then it is cooked.

seg.e7ef07a808c5.src: Add the milk and simmer 2 minutes. Switch off and rest 2 minutes. Stir once or twice while it simmers so it does not catch.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.t: दुग्धं योजयित्वा 2 निमेषान् मन्दं क्वाथयतु। अग्निं निर्वाप्य 2 निमेषान् स्थापयतु। क्वथनसमये एकवारं द्विवारं वा चालयतु येन तले न लगति।
seg.e7ef07a808c5.back: Add the milk and simmer gently 2 minutes. Turn off the fire and keep 2 minutes. While boiling stir once or twice so that it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.8f86db3a6d08.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely while the java rests, so it melts quickly.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.t: जावायां स्थितायां तालगुडं सूक्ष्मं घर्षयतु, येन शीघ्रं द्रवति।
seg.8f86db3a6d08.back: While the java rests grate the palm jaggery finely, so that it melts quickly.

seg.9cad3a0176bc.src: Stir in the palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve warm. Stir till the jaggery has fully melted, then taste and add a little more if needed.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.t: तालगुडम् एलाः च मिश्रयतु। कोष्णां परिवेषयतु। गुडः यावत् पूर्णतया द्रवति तावत् चालयतु, ततः आस्वाद्य आवश्यकं चेत् किञ्चित् अधिकं योजयतु।
seg.9cad3a0176bc.back: Mix in the palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve lukewarm. Stir until the jaggery melts completely, then taste and add a little more if needed.

seg.a8de8fe6382d.src: Pour into tumblers or bowls. If it is too thick to drink, stir in a few spoons of warm milk.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.t: टम्ब्लरेषु पात्रेषु वा पातयतु। पानाय अतिघना चेत् कतिपयचमसान् कोष्णदुग्धं मिश्रयतु।
seg.a8de8fe6382d.back: Pour into tumblers or bowls. If too thick for drinking mix in a few spoons of warm milk.

seg.c3916a972329.src: Always mix the ragi flour in water first; flour added straight to boiling water forms lumps that do not break up.
seg.c3916a972329.t: सर्वदा रागिपिष्टं प्रथमं जले मिश्रयतु; साक्षात् क्वथमाने जले योजितं पिष्टं पिण्डान् रचयति ये न भिद्यन्ते।
seg.c3916a972329.back: Always mix the ragi flour in water first; flour added directly to boiling water forms lumps that do not break.

seg.966098732312.src: Do not rush the cooking; undercooked ragi tastes raw and floury.
seg.966098732312.t: पाके त्वरां मा करोतु; अपक्वा रागिः आमा पिष्टसदृशी च लगति।
seg.966098732312.back: Do not hurry the cooking; uncooked ragi tastes raw and floury.

seg.7c0f350f3691.src: For a thinner java to drink from a tumbler, use 2 tbsp ragi flour; for a spoonable porridge, use ⅓ cup.
seg.7c0f350f3691.t: टम्ब्लरात् पानाय तनुतरायै जावायै 2 महाचमसौ रागिपिष्टं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्; चमसेन भक्षणीयायै यवाग्वै ⅓ चषकम्।
seg.7c0f350f3691.back: For a thinner java for drinking from a tumbler use 2 tablespoons ragi flour; for a porridge to be eaten with a spoon ⅓ cup.

seg.146636ba6c2e.src: With dry fruit: stir in a few chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins at the end.
seg.146636ba6c2e.t: शुष्कफलैः सह: अन्ते कतिपयानि कर्तितानि काजूतकानि वातादानि वा चमसमात्राः शुष्कद्राक्षाः च मिश्रयतु।
seg.146636ba6c2e.back: With dry fruits: at the end mix in a few cut cashews or almonds and a spoonful of raisins.

seg.6fc3ada569ad.src: Without milk: cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and stir in the jaggery once it has stopped bubbling, for a thinner, darker java.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.t: दुग्धं विना: तनुतरायै गाढवर्णायै जावायै रागिं 2½ चषकेषु जलेषु पचतु, क्वथने स्थगिते गुडं मिश्रयतु।
seg.6fc3ada569ad.back: Without milk: for a thinner, darker java cook the ragi in 2½ cups of water, and mix in the jaggery when the boiling has stopped.

seg.639ea388ead3.src: Serve warm in a steel tumbler or bowl for breakfast, or as an evening drink with a few biscuits or murukulu. Some like it chilled in summer.
seg.639ea388ead3.t: प्रातराशाय स्टील्-टम्ब्लरे पात्रे वा कोष्णां परिवेषयतु, अथवा सायंपेयरूपेण कतिपयैः बिस्कुटैः मुरुकुलु इत्यनेन वा सह। ग्रीष्मे केचन शीतलां पिबन्ति।
seg.639ea388ead3.back: For breakfast serve lukewarm in a steel tumbler or bowl, or as an evening drink with a few biscuits or murukulu. In summer some drink it cold.

seg.e770a9eec01e.src: Best drunk the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, when reheating.
seg.e770a9eec01e.t: निर्माणदिने एव पानं श्रेष्ठम्। अवशिष्टाम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां 1 दिनं यावत् स्थापयतु, पुनस्तापनसमये अग्नेः बहिः किञ्चित् कोष्णदुग्धं मिश्रयतु।
seg.e770a9eec01e.back: Drinking it on the day of making is best. Cover the leftover and keep in the refrigerator up to 1 day, and when reheating mix in a little warm milk off the fire.

seg.a10b6147a5ac.src: How do I make ragi java without lumps?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.t: पिण्डान् विना रागि जावां कथं करवाणि?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.back: How do I make ragi java without lumps?

seg.ca8628b7e082.src: Whisk the ragi flour into room-temperature water first until smooth, then pour this into boiling water while stirring all the time.
seg.ca8628b7e082.t: प्रथमं रागिपिष्टं कक्षतापमानस्य जले मसृणं यावत् मथ्नातु, ततः सततं चालयन् तत् क्वथमाने जले पातयतु।
seg.ca8628b7e082.back: First whisk the ragi flour in room-temperature water until smooth, then pour it into boiling water while stirring constantly.

seg.8bd78affc52d.src: How do I know ragi java is cooked?
seg.8bd78affc52d.t: रागि जावा पक्वा इति कथं जानीयाम्?
seg.8bd78affc52d.back: How do I know the ragi java is cooked?

seg.9b05db7490cb.src: It turns darker and glossy, thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, and no longer tastes floury. This takes about 6–8 minutes on low heat.
seg.9b05db7490cb.t: सा गाढा चिक्कणा च भवति, चमसस्य पृष्ठभागं लिम्पति इति यावत् घना भवति, पिष्टस्वादः च न अवशिष्यते। मन्दाग्नौ अस्मै प्रायः 6–8 निमेषाः लगन्ति।
seg.9b05db7490cb.back: It becomes dark and glossy, thick enough to coat the back of the spoon, and no floury taste remains. On low fire this takes about 6–8 minutes.

seg.6d748d67adfb.src: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?
seg.6d748d67adfb.t: रागि जावायां तालगुडं प्रयोक्तुं शक्नोमि किम्?
seg.6d748d67adfb.back: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?

seg.06e768643767.src: Yes. Grate the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a deeper colour and a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.06e768643767.t: आम्। तालगुडं (ताटि बेल्लम) सूक्ष्मं घृष्ट्वा चुल्लीनिर्वापणात् परं मिश्रयतु, येन दुग्धं न भिद्यते। तत् गाढवर्णं किञ्चित् धूमसदृशं माधुर्यं च ददाति।
seg.06e768643767.back: Yes. Grate the palm jaggery (tati bellam) finely and mix it in after turning off the stove, so that the milk does not split. It gives a dark colour and a slightly smoky sweetness.

seg.9a71713417de.src: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?
seg.9a71713417de.t: रागि जावायाः रागि माल्ट् इत्यस्य च कः भेदः?
seg.9a71713417de.back: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?

seg.c2632b6d0b4f.src: They are the same drink with different names. Ragi java is the Telugu name; ragi malt is what it is often called in shops and on menus.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.t: उभे एकमेव पेयम्, नामनी भिन्ने। रागि जावा तेलुगुनाम; आपणेषु भोजनसूचीषु च प्रायः रागि माल्ट् इति उच्यते।
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.back: Both are the same drink, the names are different. Ragi java is the Telugu name; in shops and menus it is usually called ragi malt.

seg.6134777fbfa8.src: రాగి జావ · Sweet Ragi Java Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.t: రాగి జావ · मधुरायाः रागि जावायाः पाकविधिः | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.back: రాగి జావ · Sweet ragi java recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.708e3c523d72.src: రాగి జావ. Sweet ragi java, the Andhra way: ragi flour cooked in water till glossy, loosened with milk and sweetened with Thati Bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.
seg.708e3c523d72.t: రాగి జావ. आन्ध्ररीत्या मधुरा रागि जावा: रागिपिष्टं जले चिक्कणत्वपर्यन्तं पक्वं, दुग्धेन तनूकृतं, ताटि बेल्लम तालगुडेन मधुरीकृतम्। विधिः सूचनाः च।
seg.708e3c523d72.back: రాగి జావ. Sweet ragi java in Andhra style: ragi flour cooked in water until glossy, thinned with milk, sweetened with tati bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.

seg.2889ed2cf93b.src: Ragi Java: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.2889ed2cf93b.t: रागि जावा: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.2889ed2cf93b.back: Ragi Java: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.671d48882eed.src: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns down in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the spices cling to every piece. Royyala iguru comes from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari to Srikakulam, where prawns from the backwaters and the sea are a Sunday lunch with rice.
seg.671d48882eed.t: इगुरु इति मांसस्य चिङ्गटानां वा घने पलाण्डु-मसालायां प्रायः शुष्कत्वपर्यन्तं पाकस्य आन्ध्ररीतिः, येन मसालाः प्रत्येकस्मिन् खण्डे लगन्ति। रोय्यल इगुरु तटीयमण्डलेभ्यः आगतम्, नेल्लूरतः गोदावरीं श्रीकाकुलं यावत्, यत्र पश्चज्जलानां समुद्रस्य च चिङ्गटाः ओदनेन सह रविवासरस्य मध्याह्नभोजनम्।
seg.671d48882eed.back: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so that the spices cling to every piece. Royyala iguru comes from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari and Srikakulam, where backwater and sea prawns with rice are the Sunday lunch.

seg.ff39877dbdbd.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) goes on the prawns first and into the masala. Teja chilli powder brings the deep red colour and strong heat coastal homes like, so scale it to your table.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.t: अस्माकं गिरिहरिद्राचूर्णं (कोण्डा पसुपु) प्रथमं चिङ्गटेषु लिप्यते मसालायां च योज्यते। तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं गाढरक्तवर्णं तटीयगृहाणां प्रियां प्रबलतीक्ष्णतां च आनयति, अतः भवतः कुटुम्बस्य रुच्यनुसारं प्रमाणं निश्चिनोतु।
seg.ff39877dbdbd.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) is first rubbed on the prawns and added to the masala. Teja red chilli powder brings a deep red colour and the strong heat loved by coastal homes, so decide the quantity according to your family's taste.

seg.885826f68de3.src: Prep includes cleaning the prawns and the 10-minute rest with turmeric.
seg.885826f68de3.t: सज्जताकाले चिङ्गटशोधनं हरिद्रया सह 10 निमेषाणां स्थापनं च अन्तर्भवतः।
seg.885826f68de3.back: The preparation time includes cleaning the prawns and 10 minutes of resting with turmeric.

seg.cff5bbd725a6.src: Rub prawns with turmeric and salt. Fry onions and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala till it coats them.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.t: चिङ्गटेषु हरिद्रां लवणं च मर्दयतु। पलाण्डून् आर्द्रक-लशुन-पिष्टं च भर्जयित्वा तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं धान्यकचूर्णं च योजयतु, ततः मसाला यावत् तान् आवृणोति तावत् चिङ्गटान् मसालायां पचतु।
seg.cff5bbd725a6.back: Rub turmeric and salt on the prawns. Fry the onions and ginger-garlic paste and add Teja red chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala until the masala coats them.

seg.cf489166a3fd.src: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shelled and deveined, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.t: 500 g चिङ्गटाः ⟦1⟧मध्यमप्रमाणाः, कवचरहिताः कृष्णसिरारहिताः च, शोधनानन्तरं तुलिताः⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.back: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shelled and deveined, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧

seg.141eb60cb009.src: ¾ tsp salt ⟦1⟧divided, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.t: ¾ लघुचमसः लवणम् ⟦1⟧द्विधा विभक्तम्, अथवा रुच्यनुसारम्⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.back: ¾ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧divided in two, or to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.716dc45cf0b3.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu; ¼ tsp for the prawns, ¼ tsp for the masala⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.t: ½ लघुचमसः गिरिहरिद्राचूर्णम् ⟦1⟧कोण्डा पसुपु; ¼ लघुचमसः चिङ्गटेभ्यः, ¼ लघुचमसः मसालायै⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu; ¼ teaspoon for the prawns, ¼ teaspoon for the masala⟦/1⟧

seg.f7ec1e72abc0.src: 1½ tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat, ½ tsp for mild⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.t: 1½ लघुचमसौ तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम् ⟦1⟧अतितीक्ष्णम्; मध्यमतीक्ष्णतायै 1 लघुचमसः, मृदुतायै ½ लघुचमसः⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.back: 1½ teaspoons Teja red chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; 1 teaspoon for medium heat, ½ teaspoon for mild⟦/1⟧

seg.fce641038ff4.src: Shell and devein the prawns, rinse them well and drain in a colander.
seg.fce641038ff4.t: चिङ्गटानां कवचं कृष्णसिरां च निष्कास्य सम्यक् प्रक्षाल्य चालन्यां जलं निःसारयतु।
seg.fce641038ff4.back: Remove the shell and black vein of the prawns, wash well and drain the water in a colander.

seg.152d1d89f6a5.src: Rub the prawns with half the turmeric and a little salt; set aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ tsp turmeric and ¼ tsp of the salt.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.t: चिङ्गटेषु अर्धां हरिद्रां किञ्चित् लवणं च मर्दयतु; 10 निमेषान् पृथक् स्थापयतु। ¼ लघुचमसं हरिद्रां लवणात् ¼ लघुचमसं च प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.152d1d89f6a5.back: Rub half the turmeric and a little salt on the prawns; set aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ teaspoon of turmeric and ¼ teaspoon of the salt.

seg.9e027c56020d.src: Heat the oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the mustard seeds. When they splutter, add the green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.9e027c56020d.t: स्थूलकटाहे मध्यमाग्नौ तैलं तापयित्वा सर्षपान् योजयतु। स्फुटितेषु हरितमरिचान् कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि च योजयतु।
seg.9e027c56020d.back: In a thick kadai heat oil on medium fire and add mustard seeds. When they splutter add green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.5d608fabeb97.src: Fry the onions in the oil till golden, then the ginger-garlic paste till it smells cooked. The onions take about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.
seg.5d608fabeb97.t: पलाण्डून् तैले सुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु, ततः आर्द्रक-लशुन-पिष्टं पक्वगन्धपर्यन्तम्। पलाण्डुभ्यः प्रायः 8–10 निमेषाः; पिष्टाय प्रायः 1 निमेषः, आमगन्धः यावत् गच्छति।
seg.5d608fabeb97.back: Fry the onions in the oil until golden, then the ginger-garlic paste until it smells cooked. About 8–10 minutes for the onions; about 1 minute for the paste, until the raw smell goes.

seg.7677bdc79559.src: If using the tomato, add it now and cook until soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.
seg.7677bdc79559.t: टमाटा प्रयुज्यते चेत् इदानीं योजयित्वा मृदुत्वं मर्दनीयत्वं च यावत् पचतु, प्रायः 4 निमेषाः।
seg.7677bdc79559.back: If a tomato is used add it now and cook until soft and mashable, about 4 minutes.

seg.5aff56b73c8a.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the rest of the turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so the spices do not catch.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.t: अग्निं मन्दं करोतु। अवशिष्टां हरिद्रां, तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं, धान्यकचूर्णं च योजयतु; 1 निमेषं भर्जयतु। अवशिष्टं लवणं योजयित्वा चालयतु येन मसालाः तले न लगन्ति।
seg.5aff56b73c8a.back: Lower the fire. Add the remaining turmeric, Teja red chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so that the spices do not stick to the bottom.

seg.ba25fbb9cf98.src: Pour in the water and cook the masala on medium heat until the oil starts to separate at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.t: जलं पातयित्वा मध्यमाग्नौ मसालां पचतु यावत् पार्श्वेषु तैलं पृथक् भवितुम् आरभते, प्रायः 3–4 निमेषाः।
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.back: Pour in water and cook the masala on medium fire until the oil begins to separate at the sides, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.e60a6389cdf2.src: Add the prawns and cook till they curl and turn pink, 5–6 minutes. Finish with garam masala. Stir often on medium-high heat so the masala dries and coats the prawns.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.t: चिङ्गटान् योजयित्वा कुञ्चिताः पाटलवर्णाः च यावत् पचतु, 5–6 निमेषाः। अन्ते गरम-मसालां योजयतु। मध्यम-तीव्राग्नौ पुनः पुनः चालयतु येन मसाला शुष्यति चिङ्गटान् च आवृणोति।
seg.e60a6389cdf2.back: Add the prawns and cook until curled and pink, 5–6 minutes. At the end add the garam masala. On medium-high fire stir again and again so that the masala dries and coats the prawns.

seg.af87e48d1429.src: Check doneness: prawns are cooked when they are pink and opaque all the way through and curled into a loose C. Cut one open if unsure; there should be no grey, see-through centre.
seg.af87e48d1429.t: पक्वतां परीक्षताम्: यदा चिङ्गटाः अन्तः यावत् पाटलाः अपारदर्शकाः च भूत्वा शिथिल-C-आकारेण कुञ्चिताः भवन्ति, तदा पक्वाः। संशये एकं छित्त्वा पश्यतु; मध्ये धूसरः पारदर्शकः भागः न भवेत्।
seg.af87e48d1429.back: Test for doneness: when the prawns are pink and opaque right through inside and curled into a loose C shape, then they are cooked. If in doubt cut one and look; there should be no grey translucent part in the middle.

seg.32e58c09609e.src: Taste for salt, scatter the coriander leaves and switch off. Do not keep cooking once the prawns are done, or they turn rubbery.
seg.32e58c09609e.t: लवणम् आस्वाद्य धान्यकपत्राणि प्रकीर्य अग्निं निर्वापयतु। चिङ्गटेषु पक्वेषु पाकं मा अनुवर्तयतु, अन्यथा ते रबर-सदृशाः कठिनाः भवन्ति।
seg.32e58c09609e.back: Taste the salt, sprinkle coriander leaves and turn off the fire. Once the prawns are cooked do not continue cooking, otherwise they become rubbery and hard.

seg.89a9cb293875.src: Teja is very hot: 1½ tsp makes a fiery iguru the way coastal homes like it; use 1 tsp for medium heat, or ½ tsp for mild.
seg.89a9cb293875.t: तेजा अतितीक्ष्णम्: 1½ लघुचमसाभ्यां तटीयगृहाणां प्रियम् अतितीक्ष्णम् इगुरु भवति; मध्यमतीक्ष्णतायै 1 लघुचमसं, मृदुतायै ½ लघुचमसं वा प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.89a9cb293875.back: Teja is very hot: with 1½ teaspoons the iguru becomes the very hot one loved by coastal homes; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or for mild ½ teaspoon.

seg.095c6105ce36.src: Fry the onions until properly golden; the colour and body of an iguru come from well-browned onions.
seg.095c6105ce36.t: पलाण्डून् सम्यक् सुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु; इगुरोः वर्णः घनत्वं च सुभृष्टपलाण्डुभ्यः एव आगच्छतः।
seg.095c6105ce36.back: Fry the onions properly until golden; the colour and thickness of the iguru come only from well-fried onions.

seg.04fb6307d058.src: Prawns cook fast. A loose C shape means done; a tight O means overcooked and chewy.
seg.04fb6307d058.t: चिङ्गटाः शीघ्रं पच्यन्ते। शिथिलः C-आकारः पक्वतां सूचयति; दृढः O-आकारः अतिपाकं कठिनत्वं च सूचयति।
seg.04fb6307d058.back: Prawns cook quickly. A loose C shape indicates doneness; a tight O shape indicates overcooking and hardness.

seg.a5e6a832090a.src: Pat the prawns dry after rinsing so they fry in the masala instead of stewing in water.
seg.a5e6a832090a.t: प्रक्षालनानन्तरं चिङ्गटान् शोषयतु येन ते जले स्विद्यमानाः न, मसालायां भृज्यन्ते।
seg.a5e6a832090a.back: After washing dry the prawns so that they fry in the masala, not stew in water.

seg.4145e1ca56b5.src: Gongura royyalu: stir in ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted in a little oil and mashed, with the prawns.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.t: गोंगूर रोय्यलु: स्वल्पे तैले म्लापितानि मर्दितानि च ½ चषकं गोंगूरपत्राणि चिङ्गटैः सह मिश्रयतु।
seg.4145e1ca56b5.back: Gongura Royyalu: mix ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted and mashed in a little oil, with the prawns.

seg.e52b316e5c51.src: Coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut or 3 tbsp thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes for a softer, richer masala.
seg.e52b316e5c51.t: नारिकेलम्: मृदुतरायै समृद्धतरायै मसालायै अन्तिमयोः 2 निमेषयोः 2 महाचमसौ घृष्टनारिकेलं 3 महाचमसान् घननारिकेलदुग्धं वा योजयतु।
seg.e52b316e5c51.back: Coconut: for a milder, richer masala add 2 tablespoons grated coconut or 3 tablespoons thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes.

seg.fc55c7b1a788.src: Gravy style: add ¾ cup water after the prawns for a thinner royyala kura to pour over rice.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.t: रसशैली: ओदनस्य उपरि पातनाय तनुतराय रोय्यल कूरा इत्यस्मै चिङ्गटानाम् अनन्तरं ¾ चषकं जलं योजयतु।
seg.fc55c7b1a788.back: Gravy style: for a thinner royyala koora to pour over rice add ¾ cup water after the prawns.

seg.8ccb6d545dd0.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar rice. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.t: उष्णं परिवेषयतु, बाष्पपक्वेन ओदनेन चमसमात्रेण घृतेन च सह, अथवा रसम्-ओदनेन साम्बार्-ओदनेन वा सह। चपात्या सह अपि सम्यक् भवति।
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.back: Serve hot, with steamed rice and a spoonful of ghee, or with rasam-rice or sambar-rice. Also good with chapati.

seg.d51021b311d0.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Warm gently in a pan; long reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.d51021b311d0.t: अवशिष्टम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु 1 दिने च भक्षयतु। स्थाल्यां मन्दं तापयतु; दीर्घपुनस्तापनेन चिङ्गटाः कठिनाः भवन्ति।
seg.d51021b311d0.back: Cover the leftover, keep it in the refrigerator and eat within 1 day. Heat gently in a pan; by long reheating the prawns become hard.

seg.8381d6ac4e4f.src: How do I know when prawns are cooked?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.back: How do I know the prawns are cooked?

seg.45cd36ecb77b.src: They turn pink and opaque all the way through and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in the hot masala. A grey, see-through centre means they need a little longer.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.t: ते अन्तः यावत् पाटलाः अपारदर्शकाः च भूत्वा शिथिल-C-आकारेण कुञ्चन्ति, उष्णमसालायां प्रायः 5–6 निमेषेषु। मध्ये धूसरः पारदर्शकः भागः चेत् किञ्चित् अधिकः कालः आवश्यकः।
seg.45cd36ecb77b.back: They become pink and opaque right through inside and curl into a loose C shape, in about 5–6 minutes in the hot masala. If there is a grey translucent part in the middle a little more time is needed.

seg.2e4c4a4632d7.src: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.back: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?

seg.1ee73f38a967.src: Iguru is cooked down in an onion masala until thick and almost dry, with the masala clinging to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, with less or no onion gravy, cooked until the prawns are crisp at the edges.
seg.1ee73f38a967.t: इगुरु पलाण्डु-मसालायां घनत्वं प्रायः शुष्कत्वं च यावत् पच्यते, मसाला चिङ्गटेषु लग्ना तिष्ठति। वेपुडु भर्जितव्यञ्जनम्, न्यूनेन पलाण्डुरसेन विना वा, चिङ्गटानां प्रान्ताः यावत् खराः भवन्ति तावत् पक्वम्।
seg.1ee73f38a967.back: Iguru is cooked in onion masala until thick and almost dry, the masala stays clinging to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry dish, with little or no onion gravy, cooked until the edges of the prawns become crisp.

seg.d248a2970455.src: How can I make royyala iguru less spicy?
seg.d248a2970455.back: How do I make royyala iguru less hot?

seg.8c9c12b68361.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder for medium heat or ½ tsp for mild, and skip the green chillies. A tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.
seg.8c9c12b68361.t: मध्यमतीक्ष्णतायै 1 लघुचमसं मृदुतायै ½ लघुचमसं वा तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, हरितमरिचान् च त्यजतु। अन्ते महाचमसमात्रं दधि नारिकेलदुग्धं वा अपि तीक्ष्णतां मृदूकरोति।
seg.8c9c12b68361.back: Use 1 teaspoon Teja red chilli powder for medium heat or ½ teaspoon for mild, and leave out the green chillies. A tablespoonful of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.

seg.9cd9740c2604.src: Yes. Thaw them in the fridge, drain them well and pat them dry before rubbing with turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.
seg.9cd9740c2604.t: आम्। शीतकपेटिकायां हिमं द्रावयतु, सम्यक् जलं निःसार्य हरिद्रा-लवण-मर्दनात् पूर्वं शोषयतु। हिमीकृताः चिङ्गटाः अधिकं जलं मुञ्चन्ति, अतः मसालां किञ्चित् अधिककालं पचतु।
seg.9cd9740c2604.back: Yes. Thaw them in the refrigerator, drain the water well and dry them before rubbing with turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.

seg.0484ea984ed7.src: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, the coastal Andhra prawn roast: prawns cooked down in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and fiery Teja chilli powder. Serves 4.
seg.0484ea984ed7.t: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. रोय्यल इगुरु, तटीय-आन्ध्रस्य भृष्टचिङ्गटाः: गिरिहरिद्राचूर्णेन अतितीक्ष्णेन तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन च सह पलाण्डु-मसालायां पक्वाः चिङ्गटाः। 4 जनेभ्यः।
seg.0484ea984ed7.back: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, coastal Andhra's fried prawns: prawns cooked in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and very hot Teja red chilli powder. For 4 people.

seg.1b1d6a89c215.src: Royyala Iguru: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.1b1d6a89c215.t: रोय्यल इगुरु: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.1b1d6a89c215.back: Royyala Iguru: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.965a1e93fb08.src: Sunnundalu are the urad dal laddus of Andhra: split urad dal roasted till nutty, ground fine with jaggery and pressed together with hot ghee. There is no cooking of syrup, so they come together in about half an hour. Andhra homes make a tin for Sankranti and Diwali, pack them for relatives travelling abroad, and keep them for an evening sweet with tea.
seg.965a1e93fb08.t: सुन्नुण्डलु आन्ध्रस्य माषदाल-लड्डुकाः: विभक्तं माषदालं बीजगन्धपर्यन्तं भृष्ट्वा गुडेन सह सूक्ष्मं पिष्ट्वा उष्णघृतेन सह निपीड्य बध्यते। पाकरसस्य पाकः नास्ति, अतः प्रायः अर्धहोरायां सिध्यन्ति। आन्ध्रगृहेषु सङ्क्रान्त्यै दीपावल्यै च एकं पात्रं क्रियते, विदेशं गच्छद्भ्यः बन्धुभ्यः बध्यन्ते, सायं चायेन सह मिष्टान्नरूपेण च रक्ष्यन्ते।
seg.965a1e93fb08.back: Sunnundalu are Andhra's urad dal laddus: split urad dal is roasted until nutty (seed-like) in smell, ground fine with jaggery and bound by pressing with hot ghee. There is no cooking of sugar syrup, so they are done in about half an hour. In Andhra homes one batch is made for Sankranti and Deepavali, packed for relatives going abroad, and kept as a sweet with evening tea.

seg.e564344550cd.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness that suits the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.
seg.e564344550cd.t: अस्माकं ताटि बेल्लम तालगुडः सुन्नुण्डलुभ्यः गाढपिङ्गलवर्णं समृद्धं किञ्चित् धूमसदृशं माधुर्यं च ददाति यत् भृष्टदालेन सह सङ्गच्छते। अनेन विधिना प्रायः 15 लड्डुकाः भवन्ति।
seg.e564344550cd.back: Our tati bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness that goes with the roasted dal. By this method about 15 laddus are made.

seg.b1400f429b2f.src: Total includes cooling the roasted dal before grinding.
seg.b1400f429b2f.t: पेषणात् पूर्वं भृष्टदालस्य शीतलीकरणम् आहत्य-काले गणितम्।
seg.b1400f429b2f.back: Cooling the roasted dal before grinding is counted in the total time.

seg.6c6369238635.src: Roast urad dal till golden, cool and grind fine, then grind in palm jaggery and cardamom. Mix with hot ghee and shape into laddus.
seg.6c6369238635.t: माषदालं सुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयित्वा शीतलीकृत्य सूक्ष्मं पिनष्टु, ततः तालगुडम् एलाः च योजयित्वा पिनष्टु। उष्णघृतेन सह मिश्रयित्वा लड्डुकान् रचयतु।
seg.6c6369238635.back: Roast the urad dal until golden, cool and grind fine, then add the palm jaggery and cardamom and grind. Mix with hot ghee and shape laddus.

seg.890ddaaca185.src: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, skinless (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.back: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, skinless (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.06c2723f717d.src: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly packed; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.t: 1 चषकं घृष्टतालगुडः ⟦1⟧प्रायः 180 g, लघु निपीड्य; प्रथमं खण्डान् कुट्टयतु घर्षयतु वा⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.back: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly pressed; first crush or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.25c886ef1375.src: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tbsp extra on hand⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.t: ½ चषकं घृतम् ⟦1⟧द्रवम् उष्णं च; 1–2 महाचमसौ अधिकं समीपे रक्षतु⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.back: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tablespoons more nearby⟦/1⟧

seg.99983266b588.src: Pick through the urad dal for any small stones. Do not wash it; it must stay dry for roasting.
seg.99983266b588.t: माषदालात् लघुशिलाखण्डान् चित्वा निष्कासयतु। मा प्रक्षालयतु; भर्जनाय तत् शुष्कं तिष्ठेत्।
seg.99983266b588.back: Pick out and remove small stones from the urad dal. Do not wash; it should stay dry for roasting.

seg.2f2807ce216b.src: Put the dal in a heavy pan on a low flame.
seg.2f2807ce216b.back: Put the dal in a thick pan on low fire.

seg.65588a76c883.src: Dry-roast the urad dal on a low flame till golden and nutty, about 10 minutes. Stir all the time so every grain colours evenly; it should smell toasty and snap when you bite a grain.
seg.65588a76c883.t: माषदालं मन्दाग्नौ तैलं विना सुवर्णवर्णं बीजगन्धं च यावत् भर्जयतु, प्रायः 10 निमेषाः। सततं चालयतु येन प्रत्येकः कणः समं रज्यते; भृष्टगन्धः आगच्छेत्, कणः दन्तैः दष्टः भज्येत च।
seg.65588a76c883.back: Roast the urad dal on low fire without oil until golden and nutty (seed-like) in smell, about 10 minutes. Stir constantly so that every grain colours evenly; a roasted smell should come, and a grain bitten with the teeth should snap.

seg.9e8dc23d38fa.src: Tip the dal onto a plate and spread it out. Cool it, then grind to a fine powder. Grind in short bursts so the mixer does not heat up, and sieve out any coarse bits to grind again.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.t: दालं स्थाल्यां पातयित्वा प्रसारयतु। शीतलीकृत्य सूक्ष्मचूर्णं पिनष्टु। मिश्रकयन्त्रं न उष्णीभवेत् इति अल्पावर्तनैः पिनष्टु, स्थूलांशान् चालन्या पृथक्कृत्य पुनः पिनष्टु।
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.back: Tip the dal onto a plate and spread it. Cool and grind to a fine powder. Grind in short pulses so the mixer does not get hot, separate the coarse parts with a sieve and grind again.

seg.edfa5bb66e59.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.edfa5bb66e59.t: तालगुडं सूक्ष्मं घर्षयतु, अथवा खले खण्डान् कुट्टयतु, कठिनपिण्डान् भिनत्तु।
seg.edfa5bb66e59.back: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or crush the pieces in a mortar, breaking the hard lumps.

seg.fcf7bce21bc5.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder in the mixer jar. Grind in the jaggery and cardamom till evenly mixed. A few pulses are enough; tip it all into a wide bowl.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.t: मिश्रकपात्रे दालचूर्णे गुडम् एलाचूर्णं च योजयतु। गुडः एलाः च समं मिश्रिताः यावत् पिनष्टु। कतिपयाः अल्पावर्तनाः पर्याप्ताः; सर्वं विस्तृतपात्रे पातयतु।
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.back: In the mixer jar add the jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder. Grind until the jaggery and cardamom are evenly mixed. A few short pulses are enough; tip everything into a wide bowl.

seg.1cd01dc31b1a.src: Melt the ghee in a small pan until it is hot but not smoking.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.t: लघुस्थाल्यां घृतम् उष्णं यावत् द्रावयतु, किन्तु धूमः न निर्गच्छेत्।
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.back: In a small pan melt the ghee until hot, but smoke should not come out.

seg.0b0ec921a239.src: Pour in the hot ghee, mix well and press into small balls. Start with most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then use your hands once it is cool enough to touch.
seg.0b0ec921a239.t: उष्णघृतं पातयित्वा सम्यक् मिश्रयतु लघुगोलकान् च निपीड्य रचयतु। प्रथमम् अधिकांशं घृतं योजयित्वा चमसेन मिश्रयतु, ततः स्पर्शयोग्यं शीतलं जाते हस्तौ प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.0b0ec921a239.back: Pour in the hot ghee, mix well and press into small balls. First add most of the ghee and mix with a spoon, then use the hands when it is cool enough to touch.

seg.0c005163369c.src: Take a small handful and squeeze it firmly in your fist, then roll it round between your palms. If it crumbles, add a spoon more hot ghee to the bowl and mix.
seg.0c005163369c.t: लघुमुष्टिमात्रं गृहीत्वा मुष्टौ दृढं निपीडयतु, ततः करतलयोः मध्ये वर्तुलं परिवर्तयतु। विशीर्यते चेत् पात्रे चमसमात्रम् अधिकम् उष्णघृतं योजयित्वा मिश्रयतु।
seg.0c005163369c.back: Take a small handful, press it firmly in the fist, then roll it round between the palms. If it falls apart add a spoonful more hot ghee to the bowl and mix.

seg.7ac27bb5fb12.src: Set the laddus on a plate to firm up for 15–20 minutes before storing.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.t: संरक्षणात् पूर्वं लड्डुकान् स्थाल्यां 15–20 निमेषान् दृढीभवितुं स्थापयतु।
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.back: Before storing keep the laddus on a plate 15–20 minutes to firm up.

seg.591b2b7e4ef4.src: Roast the dal on a low flame so it cooks through without burning.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.t: दालं मन्दाग्नौ भर्जयतु येन अदग्धं अन्तः यावत् भृज्यते।
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.back: Roast the dal on low fire so that it roasts right through inside without burning.

seg.07daa833e53a.src: Grind the dal only after it has cooled completely; warm dal turns pasty in the mixer.
seg.07daa833e53a.t: दालं पूर्णतया शीतलीभूते एव पिनष्टु; कोष्णं दालं मिश्रकयन्त्रे पिच्छिलं भवति।
seg.07daa833e53a.back: Grind the dal only when completely cooled; warm dal becomes sticky in the mixer.

seg.33701abc66f0.src: Shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm; it binds best with the heat of the ghee.
seg.33701abc66f0.t: मिश्रणे कोष्णे सति एव लड्डुकान् रचयतु; घृतस्य उष्णतया तत् सम्यक् बध्यते।
seg.33701abc66f0.back: Shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm; with the heat of the ghee it binds well.

seg.b6fb58b6b287.src: Palm jaggery pieces vary in hardness, so grate or pound them small before they go into the mixer.
seg.b6fb58b6b287.t: तालगुडखण्डानां कठिनता भिद्यते, अतः मिश्रकयन्त्रे योजनात् पूर्वं घृष्ट्वा कुट्टयित्वा वा लघून् कुरुताम्।
seg.b6fb58b6b287.back: The hardness of palm jaggery pieces varies, so make them small by grating or crushing before adding to the mixer.

seg.1797acff16a2.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter colour and a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1797acff16a2.t: इक्षुगुडः: लघुवर्णाय कैरमेल्-सदृशमाधुर्याय च तावत्प्रमाणं घृष्टम् इक्षुगुडं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.1797acff16a2.back: Sugarcane jaggery: for a lighter colour and caramel-like sweetness use the same quantity of grated sugarcane jaggery.

seg.f95b0650add7.src: With skin: use black split urad dal with its skin for darker, grainier sunnundalu, the way some village homes make them.
