seg.f95b0650add7.t: त्वक्सहितम्: गाढतरेभ्यः कणयुक्तेभ्यः सुन्नुण्डलुभ्यः त्वक्सहितं कृष्णविभक्तमाषदालं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, यथा केषुचित् ग्रामगृहेषु क्रियन्ते।
seg.f95b0650add7.back: With skin: for darker, grainy sunnundalu use black split urad dal with skin, as made in some village homes.

seg.07498f6166e4.src: With sugar: use ¾ cup powdered sugar in place of the jaggery for pale, crisp-melting laddus.
seg.07498f6166e4.t: शर्करया सह: पाण्डुवर्णेभ्यः मुखे द्रवमाणेभ्यः खरलड्डुकेभ्यः गुडस्य स्थाने ¾ चषकं चूर्णशर्करां प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.07498f6166e4.back: With sugar: for pale, melt-in-the-mouth crisp laddus use ¾ cup powdered sugar in place of the jaggery.

seg.8fea3a4a695f.src: Serve as an evening sweet with tea or coffee, or as part of the Sankranti and Diwali sweet plate.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.t: सायं चायेन काफ्या वा सह मिष्टान्नरूपेण, अथवा सङ्क्रान्तेः दीपावल्याः च मिष्टान्नपात्रस्य अङ्गरूपेण परिवेषयतु।
seg.8fea3a4a695f.back: Serve as a sweet with evening tea or coffee, or as part of the sweet plate of Sankranti and Deepavali.

seg.83b4edc5c69d.src: Keep in an airtight steel tin at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In warm weather they keep longer in the fridge; let them come to room temperature before eating.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.t: वायुरोधिनि स्टील्-पात्रे कक्षतापमाने रक्षतु 2 सप्ताहेषु च भक्षयतु। उष्णर्तौ शीतकपेटिकायां दीर्घकालं तिष्ठन्ति; भक्षणात् पूर्वं कक्षतापमानं प्राप्तुं ददातु।
seg.83b4edc5c69d.back: Keep in an airtight steel container at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In the hot season they keep longer in the refrigerator; let them reach room temperature before eating.

seg.c0ae9315eb0e.src: Why are my sunnundalu not holding shape?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.t: मम सुन्नुण्डलु किमर्थम् आकारं न धारयन्ति?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.back: Why don't my sunnundalu hold their shape?

seg.03c64235659e.src: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has cooled down. Warm a spoon or two of ghee, mix it in and shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm.
seg.03c64235659e.t: मिश्रणे अधिकम् उष्णघृतम् आवश्यकम्, अथवा तत् शीतलं जातम्। एकं द्वौ वा चमसौ घृतं तापयित्वा मिश्रयतु मिश्रणे कोष्णे सति एव लड्डुकान् रचयतु।
seg.03c64235659e.back: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has become cold. Heat one or two spoons of ghee and mix, and shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm.

seg.c125d749f215.src: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?
seg.c125d749f215.back: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?

seg.7b13a91f65e1.src: Yes. Grate or pound the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and use the same amount as cane jaggery. The laddus turn darker and taste deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.t: आम्। तालगुडं (ताटि बेल्लम) सूक्ष्मं घर्षयतु कुट्टयतु वा, इक्षुगुडवत् तावत्प्रमाणं च प्रयुङ्क्ताम्। लड्डुकाः गाढवर्णाः भवन्ति तेषां स्वादः गभीरः किञ्चित् धूमसदृशः च।
seg.7b13a91f65e1.back: Yes. Grate or crush the palm jaggery (tati bellam) finely, and use the same quantity as sugarcane jaggery. The laddus become dark coloured and their taste deep and a little smoky.

seg.b2aed25ebff6.src: About 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature, and longer in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.t: वायुरोधिपात्रे कक्षतापमाने प्रायः 2 सप्ताहान्, शीतकपेटिकायां च दीर्घतरम्। निष्कासनाय शुष्कं चमसं शुष्कहस्तौ वा प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.b2aed25ebff6.back: About 2 weeks in an airtight container at room temperature, and longer in the refrigerator. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.

seg.e750875c4912.src: Should I use urad dal with or without skin?
seg.e750875c4912.back: Should I use urad dal with skin or without skin?

seg.b12320430e22.src: Both are made in Andhra. White skinless urad dal gives smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin gives darker, grainier ones.
seg.b12320430e22.t: आन्ध्रे उभयम् अपि क्रियते। श्वेतं त्वग्रहितं माषदालं मसृणान् लघुपिङ्गलान् लड्डुकान् ददाति; त्वक्सहितं कृष्णमाषदालं गाढतरान् कणयुक्तान्।
seg.b12320430e22.back: In Andhra both are made. White skinless urad dal gives smooth light-brown laddus; black urad dal with skin gives darker, grainy ones.

seg.d8e8e5770555.src: సున్నుండలు. Andhra sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with Thati Bellam palm jaggery and bound with hot ghee into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.d8e8e5770555.t: సున్నుండలు. आन्ध्रस्य सुन्नुण्डलु: भृष्टं माषदालं ताटि बेल्लम तालगुडेन सह पिष्टम् उष्णघृतेन लड्डुकरूपेण बद्धम्। क्रमशः विधिः, सूचनाः, प्रश्नोत्तराणि च।
seg.d8e8e5770555.back: సున్నుండలు. Andhra's sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with tati bellam palm jaggery and bound into laddus with hot ghee. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.c61b125404d0.src: Sunnundalu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.c61b125404d0.t: सुन्नुण्डलु: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.c61b125404d0.back: Sunnundalu: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.02d0a5789a02.src: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes cooked down in oil with roasted dals, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it in the stone roti for a rough, spoonable texture, though a mixer in short pulses does the job. It goes with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.
seg.02d0a5789a02.t: टमाटा पच्चडि आन्ध्रपाकशालानां दैनिकः अवलेहः: पक्वाः टमाटाः भृष्टदालैः सह तैले विलाप्य, ततः रक्तमरिचेन, लशुनेन, स्वल्पया चिञ्चया च सह स्थूलं पिष्यन्ते। बहुषु गृहेषु अद्यापि स्थूलस्य चमसग्राह्यस्य रूपस्य कृते शिलापेषण्यां (रोलु) पिष्यते, यद्यपि अल्पावर्तनैः मिश्रकयन्त्रम् अपि कार्यं करोति। उष्णौदनेन घृतेन, दोसया, इड्ल्या, पेसरट्टुना च सह भक्ष्यते।
seg.02d0a5789a02.back: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes are melted down in oil with roasted dals, then ground coarse with red chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. In many homes it is still ground on a grinding stone (rolu) for a coarse, spoonable texture, though a mixer with short pulses also works. It is eaten with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.

seg.7735dff0ccd2.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and steady, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.t: अस्माकं सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम् अस्मै गाढरक्तवर्णं स्थिरां मध्यमतीक्ष्णतां च ददाति, टमाटाभिः सह स्वल्पं हरिद्राचूर्णं च योज्यते। अनेन विधिना प्रायः 1½ चषकौ भवतः।
seg.7735dff0ccd2.back: Our Sannam red chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and steady medium heat, and a little turmeric powder is added with the tomatoes. By this method about 1½ cups are made.

seg.44c4d82a4524.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.
seg.44c4d82a4524.t: पेषणात् पूर्वं टमाटानां शीतलीभवनाय 5 निमेषाः अपि आहत्य-काले गणिताः।
seg.44c4d82a4524.back: 5 minutes for cooling the tomatoes before grinding are also counted in the total time.

seg.827e4421a48d.src: Fry dals and methi in oil, cook tomatoes down with turmeric and salt, then grind coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.827e4421a48d.t: दालानि मेथिकां च तैले भर्जयतु, टमाटाः हरिद्रया लवणेन च सह विलापयतु, ततः सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, लशुनेन, चिञ्चया च सह स्थूलं पिनष्टु। अन्ते सर्षप-कृष्णनिम्बपत्र-संस्कारं ददातु।
seg.827e4421a48d.back: Fry the dals and fenugreek in oil, melt down the tomatoes with turmeric and salt, then grind coarse with Sannam red chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end give a mustard-curry leaf tempering.

seg.4171dd59d18a.back: 2 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil or sesame oil⟦/1⟧

seg.826b52ef9f19.src: ¼ tsp methi seeds ⟦1⟧fenugreek seeds; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.t: ¼ लघुचमसः मेथिकाबीजानि ⟦1⟧न अधिकम्, अन्यथा पच्चडि तिक्ता भवति⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧not more, otherwise the pachadi becomes bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.src: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.t: 5 मध्यमाः टमाटाः ⟦1⟧प्रायः 500 g, पक्वाः रक्ताः च, कर्तिताः⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.back: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, cut⟦/1⟧

seg.29558a247c61.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam red chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧

seg.2c1074e3a23e.src: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a kadai on medium-low heat.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.back: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a kadai on medium-low fire.

seg.9d0674551be0.src: Fry the urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil till golden; lift them out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir all the time, as methi burns fast and turns bitter.
seg.9d0674551be0.t: माषदालं, चणकदालं, मेथिकां च तैले सुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु; उद्धरतु। अस्मै 2–3 निमेषाः लगन्ति; सततं चालयतु, यतः मेथिका शीघ्रं दह्यते तिक्ता च भवति।
seg.9d0674551be0.back: Fry the urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in the oil until golden; take them out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir constantly, because fenugreek quickly burns and becomes bitter.

seg.4727da6f2a95.src: In the same oil, add the chopped tomatoes and stir for a minute on medium heat.
seg.4727da6f2a95.t: तस्मिन्नेव तैले कर्तिताः टमाटाः योजयित्वा मध्यमाग्नौ एकं निमेषं चालयतु।
seg.4727da6f2a95.back: In the same oil add the cut tomatoes and stir one minute on medium fire.

seg.8032f2a2778c.src: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt till soft and the juice dries up. Cover for the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered, stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes are pulpy and oil shows at the edges.
seg.8032f2a2778c.t: टमाटाः हरिद्रया लवणेन च सह मृदुत्वपर्यन्तं रसः यावत् शुष्यति तावत् पचतु। प्रथमान् 5 निमेषान् आच्छादयतु, ततः अनाच्छाद्य मध्ये मध्ये चालयन् पचतु, आहत्य प्रायः 12–15 निमेषाः, यावत् टमाटाः मर्दिताः पार्श्वेषु तैलं च दृश्यते।
seg.8032f2a2778c.back: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt until soft, until the juice dries up. Cover for the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes are mashed and oil is seen at the sides.

seg.d606b6ac13a2.src: Switch off, stir in the tamarind so it softens in the heat, and let everything cool for about 5 minutes.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.t: अग्निं निर्वाप्य चिञ्चां मिश्रयतु येन उष्णतया मृदूभवति, सर्वं च प्रायः 5 निमेषान् शीतलीभवितुं ददातु।
seg.d606b6ac13a2.back: Turn off the fire and mix in the tamarind so that it softens with the heat, and let everything cool about 5 minutes.

seg.c1820dcae462.src: In the stone roti or a mixer jar, first grind the fried dals and methi to a coarse powder.
seg.c1820dcae462.t: शिलापेषण्यां मिश्रकपात्रे वा प्रथमं भृष्टदालानि मेथिकां च स्थूलचूर्णं पिनष्टु।
seg.c1820dcae462.back: On the grinding stone or in the mixer jar first grind the roasted dals and fenugreek into a coarse powder.

seg.f07d8b97d1db.src: Grind the dals, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarsely. In a mixer, add the garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while it still has texture. Stir in the coriander leaves, if using.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.t: दालानि, लशुनं, चिञ्चां, रक्तमरिचचूर्णं, टमाटाः च स्थूलं पिनष्टु। मिश्रकयन्त्रे दालचूर्णे लशुनं, रक्तमरिचचूर्णं, पक्वटमाटाः च योजयित्वा जलं विना 4–5 वारम् अल्पावर्तनैः पिनष्टु; रूपे अवशिष्टे एव स्थगयतु। प्रयुज्यन्ते चेत् धान्यकपत्राणि मिश्रयतु।
seg.f07d8b97d1db.back: Grind the dals, garlic, tamarind, red chilli powder and tomatoes coarse. In the mixer add the garlic, red chilli powder and cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and grind without water in 4–5 short pulses; stop while texture remains. If used mix in the coriander leaves.

seg.6675d75425f6.src: Taste and adjust: a pinch more salt, or a little more chilli powder pulsed in, if you want it hotter.
seg.6675d75425f6.t: आस्वाद्य समीकरोतु: लवणस्य चिमटिकाम् अधिकाम्, अधिकतीक्ष्णताम् इच्छति चेत् किञ्चित् अधिकं रक्तमरिचचूर्णं योजयित्वा पिनष्टु।
seg.6675d75425f6.back: Taste and adjust: add a pinch more salt, and if you want more heat a little more red chilli powder, and grind.

seg.27426b7ca3c6.src: Spoon the pachadi into a bowl. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small pan and add the mustard seeds; when they splutter, add the urad dal and fry until golden.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.t: पच्चडिं पात्रे चमसेन स्थापयतु। लघुस्थाल्यां 1 महाचमसं तैलं तापयित्वा सर्षपान् योजयतु; स्फुटितेषु माषदालं योजयित्वा सुवर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु।
seg.27426b7ca3c6.back: Spoon the pachadi into a bowl. In a small pan heat 1 tablespoon oil and add mustard seeds; when they splutter add urad dal and fry until golden.

seg.77131f9506c3.src: Add the red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir for a few seconds.
seg.77131f9506c3.t: रक्तमरिचान्, हिङ्गु, कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि च योजयित्वा कतिपयक्षणान् चालयतु।
seg.77131f9506c3.back: Add red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir a few moments.

seg.d4a4b9439500.src: Temper with mustard, red chillies and curry leaves; pour over. Mix it in just before serving.
seg.d4a4b9439500.t: सर्षपैः रक्तमरिचैः कृष्णनिम्बपत्रैः च संस्कृत्य उपरि पातयतु। परिवेषणात् किञ्चित् पूर्वं मिश्रयतु।
seg.d4a4b9439500.back: Temper with mustard seeds, red chillies and curry leaves and pour on top. Mix a little before serving.

seg.0f23e6b9231e.src: Cook the tomatoes till the juice dries up so the pachadi keeps longer and does not taste raw.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.t: टमाटानां रसः यावत् शुष्यति तावत् पचतु येन पच्चडि दीर्घकालं तिष्ठति आमा च न लगति।
seg.0f23e6b9231e.back: Cook until the tomatoes' juice dries up so that the pachadi keeps a long time and does not taste raw.

seg.bad083b47507.src: Ripe, deep-red tomatoes give the best colour; if yours are sour, cut the tamarind to half.
seg.bad083b47507.t: पक्वाः गाढरक्ताः टमाटाः उत्तमं वर्णं ददति; भवतः टमाटाः अम्लाः चेत् चिञ्चाम् अर्धां करोतु।
seg.bad083b47507.back: Ripe deep-red tomatoes give the best colour; if your tomatoes are sour, halve the tamarind.

seg.99bd4830d431.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: a coarse pachadi is how Andhra homes like it, and a smooth paste loses that texture.
seg.99bd4830d431.t: अल्पावर्तनैः पिनष्टु, मिश्रकयन्त्रं सततं मा चालयतु: आन्ध्रगृहेषु स्थूला पच्चडि प्रिया, मसृणपिष्टे च तत् रूपं नश्यति।
seg.99bd4830d431.back: Grind in short pulses, do not run the mixer constantly: in Andhra homes a coarse pachadi is loved, and in a smooth paste that texture is lost.

seg.27f2aaa2d25d.src: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start at 2 tsp and add more after tasting; the heat settles a little as the pachadi rests.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.t: सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं मध्यमां तीक्ष्णतां ददाति। 2 लघुचमसाभ्याम् आरभ्य आस्वादनानन्तरम् अधिकं योजयतु; स्थितायां पच्चड्यां तीक्ष्णता किञ्चित् शाम्यति।
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.back: Sannam red chilli powder gives medium heat. Start with 2 teaspoons and add more after tasting; in a pachadi that has stood the heat calms a little.

seg.5e0bf03c1b36.src: Green chilli: replace the chilli powder with 4–5 green chillies, fried with the dals.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.t: हरितमरिचः: रक्तमरिचचूर्णस्य स्थाने दालैः सह भृष्टान् 4–5 हरितमरिचान् प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.back: Green chilli: instead of red chilli powder use 4–5 green chillies fried with the dals.

seg.d7301a50c407.src: Onion-tomato: fry 1 sliced onion until soft before the tomatoes go in.
seg.d7301a50c407.t: पलाण्डु-टमाटा: टमाटायोजनात् पूर्वं 1 कर्तितं पलाण्डुं मृदुत्वपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु।
seg.d7301a50c407.back: Onion-tomato: before adding the tomatoes fry 1 cut onion until soft.

seg.bc90e2638112.src: Hotter: use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder in place of 1 tsp of the Sannam; Teja is very hot, so go slowly.
seg.bc90e2638112.t: अधिकतीक्ष्णम्: सन्नमस्य 1 लघुचमसस्य स्थाने 1 लघुचमसं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्; तेजा अतितीक्ष्णम्, अतः मन्दं वर्धयतु।
seg.bc90e2638112.back: Hotter: in place of 1 teaspoon of Sannam use 1 teaspoon Teja red chilli powder; Teja is very hot, so increase slowly.

seg.aab608a427a9.src: Without garlic: leave out the garlic and add a pinch more asafoetida to the tempering.
seg.aab608a427a9.t: लशुनं विना: लशुनं त्यक्त्वा संस्कारे हिङ्गोः चिमटिकाम् अधिकां योजयतु।
seg.aab608a427a9.back: Without garlic: leave out the garlic and add one more pinch of asafoetida in the tempering.

seg.62d9491c4e58.src: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve alongside dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.
seg.62d9491c4e58.t: उष्णौदने स्वल्पेन घृतेन सह चमसमात्रं मिश्रयतु, अथवा दोसया, इड्ल्या, पेसरट्टुना, उप्मया वा सह परिवेषयतु।
seg.62d9491c4e58.back: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve with dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.

seg.3f0b892d2728.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.3f0b892d2728.t: स्वच्छे शुष्के काचपात्रे शीतकपेटिकायां रक्षतु 4 दिनेषु च भक्षयतु। सर्वदा शुष्कं चमसं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.3f0b892d2728.back: Keep in a clean dry glass jar in the refrigerator and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.20425f76c6e2.src: How do you make Andhra tomato pachadi?
seg.20425f76c6e2.back: How is Andhra tomato pachadi made?

seg.32ae9ac6b03c.src: Fry urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil, cook chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries up, then grind everything coarsely with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard, red chilli and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.t: माषदालं, चणकदालं, मेथिकां च तैले भर्जयतु, कर्तिताः टमाटाः हरिद्रया लवणेन च सह रसः यावत् शुष्यति तावत् पचतु, ततः सर्वं रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, लशुनेन, चिञ्चया च सह स्थूलं पिनष्टु। अन्ते सर्षप-रक्तमरिच-कृष्णनिम्बपत्र-संस्कारं ददातु।
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in oil, cook the cut tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries up, then grind everything coarse with red chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end give a mustard-red chilli-curry leaf tempering.

seg.2e87824684cb.src: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?
seg.2e87824684cb.back: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?

seg.b367557bedfc.src: Usually the methi seeds burnt or there were too many. Use only ¼ tsp for 500 g tomatoes and fry them on medium-low heat, lifting them out as soon as they turn golden.
seg.b367557bedfc.t: प्रायः मेथिकाबीजानि दग्धानि अतिमात्राणि वा आसन्। 500 g टमाटाभ्यः केवलं ¼ लघुचमसं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, मध्यम-मन्दाग्नौ भर्जयित्वा सुवर्णवर्णानि भवन्ति एव उद्धरतु।
seg.b367557bedfc.back: Usually the fenugreek seeds were burnt or too much. For 500 g tomatoes use only ¼ teaspoon, roast on medium-low fire and take them out as soon as they become golden.

seg.acdf33e5cc6d.src: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.t: चिञ्चां विना टमाटा पच्चडिं कर्तुं शक्नोमि किम्?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.back: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?

seg.53fbd8949e0b.src: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need the small piece of tamarind for balance.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.t: आम्, यदि भवतः टमाटाः पर्याप्तम् अम्लाः। पाकानन्तरम् आस्वादयतु; पक्वाः मधुराः टमाटाः सन्तुलनाय तं लघुचिञ्चाखण्डम् अपेक्षन्ते।
seg.53fbd8949e0b.back: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe sweet tomatoes need that small piece of tamarind for balance.

seg.2938c7a0249e.src: How long does tomato pachadi last?
seg.2938c7a0249e.back: How long does tomato pachadi keep?

seg.a35105e3a4af.src: About 4 days in the fridge in a clean, dry jar, as long as the tomatoes were cooked down well and you use a dry spoon.
seg.a35105e3a4af.t: यदि टमाटाः सम्यक् विलापिताः शुष्कः चमसः च प्रयुज्यते, तर्हि स्वच्छे शुष्के पात्रे शीतकपेटिकायां प्रायः 4 दिनानि।
seg.a35105e3a4af.back: If the tomatoes are properly melted down and a dry spoon is used, then about 4 days in a clean dry container in the refrigerator.

seg.de4e2a65c3ae.src: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked down with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.t: టమాటా పచ్చడి. आन्ध्रस्य टमाटा पच्चडि: हरिद्राचूर्णेन सह विलापिताः टमाटाः, सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन लशुनेन चिञ्चया च सह स्थूलं पिष्टाः, ततः संस्कृताः।
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.back: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra's tomato pachadi: tomatoes melted down with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam red chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.

seg.03de1ac75259.src: Tomato Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.03de1ac75259.t: टमाटा पच्चडि: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.03de1ac75259.back: Tomato Pachadi: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.3d323a4b41cc.src: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, mashed smooth and finished with a garlic tempering. It is cooked most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or a pickle on the side.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.t: टमाटा पप्पु आन्ध्रगृहाणां दैनिकं दालम्: आढकीदालं (कन्दि पप्पु) टमाटाभिः हरितमरिचैः च सह मृदु पक्त्वा, मसृणं मर्दयित्वा, लशुनसंस्कारेण समाप्यते। सप्ताहस्य प्रायः सर्वेषु दिनेषु पच्यते उष्णौदनेन, चमसमात्रेण घृतेन, पार्श्वे पर्पटेन सन्धानेन वा सह भक्ष्यते।
seg.3d323a4b41cc.back: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) is cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, mashed smooth and finished with a garlic tempering. It is cooked on almost every day of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoonful of ghee, and a papad or pickle on the side.

seg.734276af9399.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder adds a red tinge and a steady, medium heat that sits behind the sour tomato. This recipe serves 4.
seg.734276af9399.t: अस्माकं हरिद्राचूर्णं दालेन सह कुकरे योज्यते गाढपीतवर्णं च ददाति। सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं रक्ताभां अम्लटमाटायाः पृष्ठे स्थितां स्थिरां मध्यमतीक्ष्णतां च योजयति। अयं पाकविधिः 4 जनेभ्यः।
seg.734276af9399.back: Our turmeric powder is added with the dal in the cooker and gives a deep yellow colour. Sannam red chilli powder adds a reddish tinge and a steady medium heat sitting behind the sour tomato. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.8c5a5da215b1.src: Total includes letting the cooker release its steam.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.back: The cooker's steam-release time is also counted in the total time.

seg.2c1a760b1cf8.src: Pressure-cook toor dal with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder, mash it with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and finish with a garlic and mustard tempering.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.t: आढकीदालं टमाटाभिः, हरितमरिचैः, हरिद्राचूर्णेन च सह प्रेशर-कुकरे पचतु, सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन लवणेन च सह मर्दयतु, अन्ते लशुन-सर्षप-संस्कारं ददातु।
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.back: Cook the toor dal with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder in a pressure cooker, mash with Sannam red chilli powder and salt, at the end give a garlic-mustard tempering.

seg.d102a6fa5887.src: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.t: ¾ चषकम् आढकीदालम् ⟦1⟧कन्दि पप्पु, प्रायः 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.back: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧

seg.258b0303a820.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes in the cooker⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧added in the cooker⟦/1⟧

seg.25c2493b65be.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; up to 2 tsp for more heat⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.t: 1 लघुचमसः सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम् ⟦1⟧मर्दनानन्तरं योज्यते; अधिकतीक्ष्णतायै 2 लघुचमसौ यावत्⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam red chilli powder ⟦1⟧added after mashing; up to 2 teaspoons for more heat⟦/1⟧

seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧plus ½ cup to adjust⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧½ cup more for adjusting⟦/1⟧

seg.5f7d589d9776.src: 1 tbsp tamarind water (optional) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.back: 1 tablespoon tamarind water (optional) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧

seg.4efa92e0ce99.src: Wash the toor dal in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.t: आढकीदालं 2–3 वारं जलं परिवर्त्य प्रक्षाल्य जलं निःसारयतु।
seg.4efa92e0ce99.back: Wash the toor dal 2–3 times changing the water and drain the water.

seg.3f536116a096.src: Put the dal in a pressure cooker with the tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups of water.
seg.3f536116a096.t: दालं टमाटाभिः, हरितमरिचैः, पलाण्डुना, 2½ चषकैः जलैः च सह प्रेशर-कुकरे स्थापयतु।
seg.3f536116a096.back: Put the dal in the pressure cooker with the tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups of water.

seg.7d012f63f2a2.src: Pressure-cook the dal with the tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder for 4 whistles. Stir the turmeric powder into the water before closing the lid, then cook on medium heat.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.t: दालं टमाटाभिः हरितमरिचैः हरिद्राचूर्णेन च सह 4 सीत्कारपर्यन्तं पचतु। पिधानबन्धनात् पूर्वं हरिद्राचूर्णं जले मिश्रयतु, ततः मध्यमाग्नौ पचतु।
seg.7d012f63f2a2.back: Cook the dal with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder up to 4 whistles. Before closing the lid mix the turmeric powder into the water, then cook on medium fire.

seg.5dccba018dbc.src: Let the pressure drop on its own, about 10 minutes. The dal is done when a grain mashes completely between two fingers.
seg.5dccba018dbc.t: दाबः स्वयं न्यूनीभवितुं ददातु, प्रायः 10 निमेषाः। यदा द्वयोः अङ्गुल्योः मध्ये कणः पूर्णतया मृद्यते, तदा दालं पक्वम्।
seg.5dccba018dbc.back: Let the pressure come down by itself, about 10 minutes. When a grain mashes completely between two fingers, then the dal is cooked.

seg.da76f4c700ad.src: Mash well; add the chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash while the dal is still hot, until the tomatoes and dal turn into one smooth mix.
seg.da76f4c700ad.t: सम्यक् मर्दयतु; रक्तमरिचचूर्णं लवणं च योजयतु। काष्ठमर्दकं (पप्पु गुत्ति) दर्व्याः पृष्ठभागं वा प्रयुज्य दाले उष्णे सति एव मर्दयतु, यावत् टमाटाः दालं च एकं मसृणं मिश्रणं भवति।
seg.da76f4c700ad.back: Mash well; add red chilli powder and salt. Using a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle mash while the dal is still hot, until the tomatoes and dal become one smooth mixture.

seg.c1cb2443fbeb.src: Simmer 5 minutes with a splash of water. Add up to ½ cup water for a pouring consistency, and the tamarind water if using, and keep the heat on low so it does not catch.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.t: स्वल्पेन जलेन सह 5 निमेषान् मन्दं क्वाथयतु। पातनयोग्यतायै ½ चषकं यावत् जलं, प्रयुज्यते चेत् चिञ्चाजलं च योजयतु, तले न लगेत् इति अग्निं मन्दं रक्षतु।
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.back: Simmer gently 5 minutes with a little water. For pouring consistency add up to ½ cup water, and tamarind water if used, keep the fire low so it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.b24472a45a67.src: Taste for salt and sourness, then stir in the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.b24472a45a67.t: लवणम् अम्लतां च आस्वाद्य धान्यकपत्राणि मिश्रयित्वा अग्निं निर्वापयतु।
seg.b24472a45a67.back: Taste the salt and sourness, mix in coriander leaves and turn off the fire.

seg.6f90b7e4f66a.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium heat and add the mustard seeds; let them splutter.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.t: लघुस्थाल्यां मध्यमाग्नौ घृतं तापयित्वा सर्षपान् योजयतु; स्फुटितुं ददातु।
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.back: In a small pan heat ghee on medium fire and add mustard seeds; let them splutter.

seg.0d1dd3c84a64.src: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in the ghee; pour over. Add the cumin, garlic and dry red chillies after the mustard and fry until the garlic turns golden, then add the curry leaves and hing, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.t: घृते सर्षपान्, जीरकं, लशुनं, कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि च भर्जयित्वा उपरि पातयतु। सर्षपाणाम् अनन्तरं जीरकं, लशुनं, शुष्करक्तमरिचान् च योजयित्वा लशुनं सुवर्णवर्णं यावत् भर्जयतु, ततः कृष्णनिम्बपत्राणि हिङ्गु च योजयित्वा चटचटायमानं संस्कारं दालस्य उपरि पातयतु।
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.back: Fry mustard seeds, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in the ghee and pour on top. After the mustard seeds add cumin, garlic and dry red chillies and fry until the garlic is golden, then add curry leaves and asafoetida and pour the crackling tempering over the dal.

seg.81a1668adc10.src: Cover for 2 minutes so the tempering flavours the dal, then stir and serve hot.
seg.81a1668adc10.t: संस्कारः दालं सुगन्धयेत् इति 2 निमेषान् आच्छादयतु, ततः चालयित्वा उष्णं परिवेषयतु।
seg.81a1668adc10.back: Cover 2 minutes so that the tempering perfumes the dal, then stir and serve hot.

seg.f904a5f14a1b.src: Mash the dal while it is hot for a smooth pappu. Once it cools, the grains set and stay lumpy.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.t: मसृणाय पप्पवे दालम् उष्णं सत् एव मर्दयतु। शीतलीभूते कणाः दृढीभवन्ति पिण्डिताः च तिष्ठन्ति।
seg.f904a5f14a1b.back: For a smooth pappu mash the dal while it is still hot. When cooled the grains firm up and stay lumpy.

seg.1a8211877e00.src: Sannam chilli powder is medium-hot. Start with 1 tsp; go up to 2 tsp for a spicier pappu.
seg.1a8211877e00.t: सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं मध्यमतीक्ष्णम्। 1 लघुचमसेन आरभताम्; अधिकतीक्ष्णाय पप्पवे 2 लघुचमसौ यावत् वर्धयतु।
seg.1a8211877e00.back: Sannam red chilli powder is medium hot. Start with 1 teaspoon; for a hotter pappu increase up to 2 teaspoons.

seg.d85da2ea2cf7.src: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the best flavour; with mild hybrid tomatoes add the tamarind water.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.t: पक्वाः अम्लाः देशीयटमाटाः (नाटु टमाटा) उत्तमं स्वादं ददति; मृदुसंकरटमाटाभिः सह चिञ्चाजलं योजयतु।
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.back: Ripe sour country tomatoes (natu tomato) give the best taste; with mild hybrid tomatoes add tamarind water.

seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.src: Let the garlic turn golden in the tempering before the curry leaves go in; pale garlic tastes raw.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.t: कृष्णनिम्बपत्रयोजनात् पूर्वं संस्कारे लशुनं सुवर्णवर्णं भवितुं ददातु; पाण्डुरं लशुनम् आमम् इव लगति।
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.back: Before adding the curry leaves let the garlic in the tempering become golden; pale garlic tastes as if raw.

seg.dfd3706fe457.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu, use ½ tsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not go over 1 tsp.
seg.dfd3706fe457.t: तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम्: अधिकतीक्ष्णाय पप्पवे सन्नमस्य स्थाने ½ लघुचमसं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्। तेजा अतितीक्ष्णम्, अतः 1 लघुचमसात् अधिकं मा प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.dfd3706fe457.back: Teja red chilli powder: for a hotter pappu use ½ teaspoon Teja red chilli powder instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not use more than 1 teaspoon.

seg.434f1a510bbb.src: Palakura tomato pappu: add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal after mashing and simmer 5 minutes.
seg.434f1a510bbb.t: पालकूर टमाटा पप्पु: मर्दनानन्तरं दाले 2 चषकौ कर्तितं पालक्यं योजयित्वा 5 निमेषान् मन्दं क्वाथयतु।
seg.434f1a510bbb.back: Palakura Tomato Pappu: after mashing add 2 cups cut spinach to the dal and simmer gently 5 minutes.

seg.8d7a932afdbe.src: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and cook for 2 whistles only.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.t: पेसरपप्पु: पीतमुद्गदालेन कुरुताम् केवलं 2 सीत्कारपर्यन्तं च पचतु।
seg.8d7a932afdbe.back: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and cook only up to 2 whistles.

seg.94f44314ecbb.src: Serve hot with steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or avakaya on the side. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.94f44314ecbb.t: उष्णं परिवेषयतु, बाष्पपक्वेन ओदनेन, चमसमात्रेण घृतेन, पार्श्वे पर्पटेन आवकाय (आम्रसन्धानम्) इत्यनेन वा सह। चपात्या सह अपि सम्यक् भवति।
seg.94f44314ecbb.back: Serve hot, with steamed rice, a spoonful of ghee, and a papad or avakaya (mango pickle) on the side. Also good with chapati.

seg.29a23e2fa864.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. The dal thickens when chilled; add a little hot water and heat through before serving.
seg.29a23e2fa864.t: अवशिष्टम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु 2 दिनेषु च भक्षयतु। शीतलीकृतं दालं घनीभवति; परिवेषणात् पूर्वं किञ्चित् उष्णजलं योजयित्वा सम्यक् तापयतु।
seg.29a23e2fa864.back: Cover the leftover, keep it in the refrigerator and eat within 2 days. Cooled dal thickens; before serving add a little hot water and heat well.

seg.8e56f1d7c871.src: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.back: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?

seg.562abdd39933.src: About 4 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own. Older dal or dal that was not washed well may need 5.
seg.562abdd39933.t: मध्यमाग्नौ प्रायः 4 सीत्काराः, ततः दाबः स्वयं न्यूनीभवितुं ददातु। पुराणं दालं सम्यक् अप्रक्षालितं दालं वा 5 अपेक्षेत।
seg.562abdd39933.back: About 4 whistles on medium fire, then let the pressure come down by itself. Old dal or dal not properly washed may need 5.

seg.6a800f643cf1.src: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?
seg.6a800f643cf1.t: टमाटा पप्पोः साम्बारस्य च कः भेदः?
seg.6a800f643cf1.back: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?

seg.05135ac52968.src: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal with a simple tempering and no sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thinner, uses tamarind, vegetables and a roasted spice powder.
seg.05135ac52968.t: टमाटा पप्पु सरलसंस्कारयुक्तं घनं मर्दितं दालम्, साम्बार्-चूर्णं शाकानि च विना। साम्बार् तनुतरः, तस्मिन् चिञ्चा, शाकानि, भृष्टमसालाचूर्णं च प्रयुज्यन्ते।
seg.05135ac52968.back: Tomato pappu is a thick mashed dal with a simple tempering, without sambar powder and vegetables. Sambar is thinner, and in it tamarind, vegetables and roasted masala powder are used.

seg.19117f898a31.src: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?
seg.19117f898a31.t: प्रेशर-कुकरं विना टमाटा पप्पु कर्तुं शक्नोमि किम्?
seg.19117f898a31.back: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?

seg.631df239c7a7.src: Yes. Soak the dal for 30 minutes and cook it in a covered pot with 3½ cups of water for about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.
seg.631df239c7a7.t: आम्। दालं 30 निमेषान् आर्द्रीकृत्य आच्छादिते भाण्डे 3½ चषकैः जलैः सह प्रायः 40–45 निमेषान् पचतु, मध्ये मध्ये चालयन्, यावत् सुलभं मृद्यते।
seg.631df239c7a7.back: Yes. Soak the dal 30 minutes and cook in a covered pot with 3½ cups of water about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.

seg.b1140d6c02b4.src: Why is my tomato pappu too sour?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.back: Why is my tomato pappu too sour?

seg.6fb0505bf751.src: Some tomatoes are very sour. Simmer the dal a few more minutes and stir in a pinch of jaggery or a spoon of extra mashed dal to balance it.
seg.6fb0505bf751.t: केचन टमाटाः अत्यम्लाः भवन्ति। दालं कतिपयनिमेषान् अधिकं मन्दं क्वाथयतु सन्तुलनाय च गुडस्य चिमटिकां चमसमात्रम् अधिकं मर्दितदालं वा मिश्रयतु।
seg.6fb0505bf751.back: Some tomatoes are very sour. Simmer the dal gently a few minutes more and for balance mix in a pinch of jaggery or a spoonful more of mashed dal.

seg.80a51a64344d.src: టమాటో పప్పు · Andhra Tomato Dal Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.back: టమాటో పప్పు · Andhra tomato dal recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.src: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and a garlic tempering. Serves 4.
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.t: టమాటో పప్పు. आन्ध्रस्य टमाटा-दालम्: टमाटाभिः, हरितमरिचैः, अस्माकं हरिद्रया, सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन च सह मृदु पक्वम् आढकीदालं, लशुनसंस्कारेण सह। 4 जनेभ्यः।
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.back: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra's tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomatoes, green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam red chilli powder, with a garlic tempering. For 4 people.

seg.bf96bcd14023.src: Tomato Pappu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.bf96bcd14023.t: टमाटा पप्पु: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.bf96bcd14023.back: Tomato Pappu: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.9078b361da10.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Kaaram · Lahsun Ki Sookhi Chutney
seg.9078b361da10.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · वेल्लुल्लि कारम् · लहसुन की सूखी चटनी
seg.9078b361da10.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Karam · Lahsun ki Sookhi Chutney

seg.464f01dcf4e8.src: Vellulli kaaram is the garlic chilli podi kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed into the first handful of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkled over idli and dosa with a little oil, it is a quick meal on busy days and a staple in tiffin boxes.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.t: वेल्लुल्लि कारम् इति आन्ध्रभोजनपीठेषु स्थापितं लशुन-रक्तमरिच-पोडि: रक्तमरिचचूर्णं प्रचुरेण लशुनेन, भृष्टधान्यकेन जीरकेण च, लवणेन च सह कुट्यते। उष्णौदनस्य प्रथमग्रासे घृतेन सह मिश्रितम्, इड्ली-दोसयोः उपरि स्वल्पतैलेन सह प्रकीर्णं वा, व्यस्तदिनेषु शीघ्रभोजनं भोजनपेटिकासु नित्यवस्तु च भवति।
seg.464f01dcf4e8.back: Vellulli karam is the garlic-red chilli podi kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder is pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed with ghee into the first mouthful of hot rice, or sprinkled over idli and dosa with a little oil, it is a quick meal on busy days and a regular item in lunch boxes.

seg.a9654adade5e.src: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, the way Guntur homes like it. For less heat, use half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.a9654adade5e.t: अस्माकं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम् एतत् गाढरक्तम् अतितीक्ष्णं च करोति, यथा गुण्टूरगृहेषु प्रियम्। न्यूनतीक्ष्णतायै अर्धं सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.a9654adade5e.back: Our Teja red chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, as loved in Guntur homes. For less heat use half Sannam red chilli powder.

seg.b43a6fdf4164.src: Total includes cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.t: पेषणात् पूर्वं बीजानां लशुनस्य च शीतलीकरणम् आहत्य-काले गणितम्।
seg.b43a6fdf4164.back: Cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding is counted in the total time.

seg.501bcac1011e.src: Roast coriander and cumin, grind them, then pulse with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic into a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.
seg.501bcac1011e.t: धान्यकं जीरकं च भर्जयित्वा पिनष्टु, ततः तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन, लवणेन, लघूष्णीकृतेन लशुनेन च सह अल्पावर्तनैः स्थूलं पोडिं कुरुताम्। उष्णौदनेन घृतेन, इड्ल्या, दोसया वा सह भक्षयतु।
seg.501bcac1011e.back: Roast and grind coriander and cumin, then with Teja red chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic make a coarse podi in short pulses. Eat with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.

seg.e9ce857fe180.src: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can stay⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.t: 25 लशुनकलिकाः ⟦1⟧प्रायः ½ चषकं, त्वग्रहिताः; अन्तःस्था तनुत्वक् तिष्ठेत्⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.back: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin may stay⟦/1⟧

seg.47382aff4c0b.src: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it milder⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.t: ¼ चषकं तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णम् ⟦1⟧अतितीक्ष्णम्; मृदूकरणाय सूचनाः पश्यतु⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.back: ¼ cup Teja red chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips for making it milder⟦/1⟧

seg.7bca54595a6a.src: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 tsp per serving⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.back: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon per portion⟦/1⟧

seg.074d39a3f8b1.src: Peel the garlic and pat the cloves completely dry with a cloth; any water shortens how long the podi keeps.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.t: लशुनस्य त्वचं निष्कास्य कलिकाः वस्त्रेण पूर्णतया शोषयतु; किञ्चिदपि जलं पोडेः स्थितिकालं न्यूनीकरोति।
seg.074d39a3f8b1.back: Peel the garlic and dry the cloves completely with a cloth; even a little water reduces the keeping time of the podi.

seg.33bb0e9eea87.src: Dry-roast the coriander and cumin seeds till fragrant; let them cool. Use a small pan on medium-low heat; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should turn a shade darker, not brown.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.t: धान्यकं जीरकं च तैलं विना सुगन्धपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु; शीतलीभवितुं ददातु। मध्यम-मन्दाग्नौ लघुस्थालीं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्; अस्मै 1–2 निमेषौ लगतः, धान्यकम् एकछायया गाढं भवेत्, न पिङ्गलम्।
seg.33bb0e9eea87.back: Roast the coriander and cumin without oil until fragrant; let cool. Use a small pan on medium-low fire; this takes 1–2 minutes, the coriander should become one shade darker, not brown.

seg.a2f7a86fc993.src: Warm the garlic in 1 tsp oil for 2 minutes. Keep the heat low and stir; the cloves should soften slightly at the edges without browning. Let it cool.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.t: लशुनं 1 लघुचमसे तैले 2 निमेषौ तापयतु। अग्निं मन्दं रक्षित्वा चालयतु; कलिकानां प्रान्ताः किञ्चित् मृदवः भवेयुः न तु पिङ्गलाः। शीतलीभवितुं ददातु।
seg.a2f7a86fc993.back: Warm the garlic in 1 teaspoon of oil for 2 minutes. Keep the fire low and stir; the edges of the cloves should become a little soft but not brown. Let cool.

seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.src: Grind the seeds to a powder, then pulse with the chilli powder and salt. Add the tamarind with the seeds, if using, so it breaks down evenly.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.t: बीजानि चूर्णं पिनष्टु, ततः रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन लवणेन च सह अल्पावर्तनैः पिनष्टु। प्रयुज्यते चेत् चिञ्चां बीजैः सह योजयतु, येन समं भिद्यते।
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.back: Grind the seeds to a powder, then grind with the red chilli powder and salt in short pulses. If used add the tamarind with the seeds, so that it breaks up evenly.

seg.c12763cab28c.src: Add the garlic and pulse in short bursts to a coarse, moist powder. Stop and scrape down the jar after every 2–3 pulses, as garlic sticks to the sides.
seg.c12763cab28c.t: लशुनं योजयित्वा अल्पावर्तनैः स्थूलम् आर्द्रं चूर्णं कुरुताम्। प्रति 2–3 आवर्तनानि स्थगयित्वा पात्रस्य पार्श्वेभ्यः अवकर्षतु, यतः लशुनं पार्श्वेषु लगति।
seg.c12763cab28c.back: Add the garlic and make a coarse, moist powder in short pulses. Stop every 2–3 pulses and scrape down from the sides of the jar, because the garlic sticks to the sides.

seg.31358182425b.src: In a stone mortar, pound the seeds first, then the garlic with the salt, and work in the chilli powder last.
seg.31358182425b.t: शिलाखले प्रथमं बीजानि कुट्टयतु, ततः लवणेन सह लशुनम्, अन्ते रक्तमरिचचूर्णं मिश्रयतु।
seg.31358182425b.back: In a stone mortar first pound the seeds, then the garlic with the salt, and at the end mix in the red chilli powder.

seg.29ac6dd20660.src: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.
seg.29ac6dd20660.t: स्वल्पेन ओदनेन घृतेन च सह चिमटिकाम् आस्वाद्य आवश्यकं चेत् लवणं योजयतु।
seg.29ac6dd20660.back: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee and add salt if needed.

seg.b4ccc3b591dd.src: Spread the podi on a plate for 10 minutes so the steam escapes, then pack it into a clean, dry jar.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.t: बाष्पनिर्गमनाय पोडिं स्थाल्यां 10 निमेषान् प्रसार्य स्थापयतु, ततः स्वच्छे शुष्के पात्रे पूरयतु।
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.back: For the steam to escape keep the podi spread on a plate 10 minutes, then fill it into a clean dry container.

seg.23d348ffe051.src: Teja is very hot; use half Sannam for a milder podi, or cut the chilli powder to 3 tbsp for the same garlic.
seg.23d348ffe051.t: तेजा अतितीक्ष्णम्; मृदुतराय पोडये अर्धं सन्नमं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, अथवा तावता लशुनेन सह रक्तमरिचचूर्णं 3 महाचमसान् यावत् न्यूनीकरोतु।
seg.23d348ffe051.back: Teja is very hot; for a milder podi use half Sannam, or with the same garlic reduce the red chilli powder to 3 tablespoons.

seg.948075d5f572.src: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; damp garlic makes the podi go off quickly.
seg.948075d5f572.t: लशुनं सम्यक् शोषयित्वा तैले तापयतु; आर्द्रं लशुनं पोडिं शीघ्रं दूषयति।
seg.948075d5f572.back: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; moist garlic spoils the podi quickly.

seg.1a71c64c8c74.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: run it long and the garlic turns into a paste.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.t: अल्पावर्तनैः पिनष्टु, मिश्रकयन्त्रं सततं मा चालयतु: दीर्घं चालितं चेत् लशुनं पिष्टं भवति।
seg.1a71c64c8c74.back: Grind in short pulses, do not run the mixer constantly: if run long the garlic becomes a paste.

seg.d1432fb9a627.src: Mix 1 tsp podi with 1 tsp ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.
seg.d1432fb9a627.t: एकस्मिन् चषके उष्णौदने 1 लघुचमसं पोडिं 1 लघुचमसं घृतं च मिश्रयतु; रुच्यनुसारं समीकरोतु।
seg.d1432fb9a627.back: Mix 1 teaspoon podi and 1 teaspoon ghee into one cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.

seg.bdc5e9728b98.src: With dals: dry-roast 1 tbsp chana dal and 1 tbsp urad dal with the seeds for a nuttier, slightly milder podi.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.t: दालैः सह: अधिकबीजसदृशस्वादाय किञ्चित् मृदुतराय च पोडये बीजैः सह 1 महाचमसं चणकदालं 1 महाचमसं माषदालं च तैलं विना भर्जयतु।
seg.bdc5e9728b98.back: With dals: for a more nutty (seed-like) taste and a slightly milder podi roast 1 tablespoon chana dal and 1 tablespoon urad dal without oil with the seeds.

seg.4d03eacf7428.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste, and eat it within a week.
seg.4d03eacf7428.t: अपक्वलशुनम्: तीक्ष्णतरस्वादाय लशुनतापनं त्यजतु, एकस्मिन् सप्ताहे च भक्षयतु।
seg.4d03eacf7428.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper taste skip warming the garlic, and eat within one week.

seg.21139bdcd961.src: Medium heat: use 2 tbsp Teja and 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder.
seg.21139bdcd961.t: मध्यमतीक्ष्णता: 2 महाचमसौ तेजा 2 महाचमसौ सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं च प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.21139bdcd961.back: Medium heat: use 2 tablespoons Teja and 2 tablespoons Sannam red chilli powder.

seg.bceea7c8cb4f.src: Mix with the first handful of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle over idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.t: उष्णौदनस्य प्रथमग्रासेन घृतेन च सह मिश्रयतु, अथवा इड्ली-दोसा-पेसरट्टूनाम् उपरि स्वल्पेन तैलेन घृतेन वा सह प्रकिरतु।
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.back: Mix with the first mouthful of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle over idli, dosa and pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.

seg.5fd9cf1554fd.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar for about 2 weeks at room temperature, or a month in the fridge. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.t: स्वच्छे शुष्के वायुरोधिपात्रे कक्षतापमाने प्रायः 2 सप्ताहान्, शीतकपेटिकायां वा एकं मासं रक्षतु। सर्वदा शुष्कं चमसं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.back: Keep in a clean dry airtight container at room temperature about 2 weeks, or in the refrigerator one month. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.c58bc6538b2f.src: How do you make vellulli kaaram?

seg.0ecd3203de93.src: Roast coriander and cumin seeds, grind them, add chilli powder and salt, then pulse in peeled garlic cloves to a coarse, moist powder. Andhra homes often pound it in a stone mortar.
seg.0ecd3203de93.t: धान्यकं जीरकं च भर्जयित्वा पिनष्टु, रक्तमरिचचूर्णं लवणं च योजयतु, ततः त्वग्रहिताः लशुनकलिकाः योजयित्वा अल्पावर्तनैः स्थूलम् आर्द्रं चूर्णं कुरुताम्। आन्ध्रगृहेषु प्रायः शिलाखले कुट्यते।
seg.0ecd3203de93.back: Roast and grind coriander and cumin, add red chilli powder and salt, then add the peeled garlic cloves and make a coarse moist powder in short pulses. In Andhra homes it is usually pounded in a stone mortar.

seg.727d415cb888.src: How do I make garlic podi less spicy?
seg.727d415cb888.back: How do I make garlic podi less hot?

seg.e4231ea5cf7a.src: Use half Sannam chilli powder in place of half the Teja, or use 3 tbsp chilli powder in all. Eating it with plenty of ghee also takes the edge off.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.t: अर्धस्य तेजायाः स्थाने अर्धं सन्नम-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्, अथवा आहत्य 3 महाचमसान् रक्तमरिचचूर्णम्। प्रचुरेण घृतेन सह भक्षणम् अपि तीक्ष्णतां शमयति।
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.back: In place of half the Teja use half Sannam red chilli powder, or 3 tablespoons red chilli powder in all. Eating it with plenty of ghee also calms the heat.

seg.982e854e4417.src: How long does vellulli kaaram last?
seg.982e854e4417.back: How long does vellulli karam keep?

seg.a620f29950c0.src: About 2 weeks at room temperature in a dry, airtight jar, or a month in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first so it lasts longer.
seg.a620f29950c0.t: शुष्के वायुरोधिपात्रे कक्षतापमाने प्रायः 2 सप्ताहान्, शीतकपेटिकायां वा एकं मासम्। दीर्घस्थित्यै लशुनं सम्यक् शोषयित्वा प्रथमं तैले तापयतु।
seg.a620f29950c0.back: About 2 weeks in a dry airtight container at room temperature, or one month in the refrigerator. For long keeping dry the garlic well and first warm it in oil.

seg.4c626acd1bdd.src: Can I use whole dried red chillies instead of chilli powder?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.t: रक्तमरिचचूर्णस्य स्थाने अखण्डशुष्करक्तमरिचान् प्रयोक्तुं शक्नोमि किम्?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.back: Can I use whole dry red chillies instead of red chilli powder?

seg.c796942589c3.src: Yes. Dry-roast about 20 dried red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.c796942589c3.t: आम्। प्रायः 20 शुष्करक्तमरिचान् कतिपयैः तैलबिन्दुभिः सह खरत्वपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु, शीतलीकृत्य लशुनयोजनात् पूर्वं पिनष्टु।
seg.c796942589c3.back: Yes. Fry about 20 dry red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.c5afa85ab56d.src: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra garlic chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or idli and dosa.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.t: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. आन्ध्रस्य लशुन-रक्तमरिच-पोडि: भृष्टधान्यकं जीरकं च लशुनेन लवणेन तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णेन च सह कुट्टितम्। उष्णौदनेन घृतेन, इड्ल्या दोसया वा सह मिश्रयतु।
seg.c5afa85ab56d.back: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra's garlic-red chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja red chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.

seg.eff09f5a48ed.src: Vellulli Kaaram: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.eff09f5a48ed.t: वेल्लुल्लि कारम्: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
seg.eff09f5a48ed.back: Vellulli Karam: recipe card of 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method

seg.a09662135f29.back: ¼ cup Teja red chilli powder

seg.3b01a30ec3ce.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge while it rests.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.t: कुक्कुटमांसे दधि, तेजा-रक्तमरिचचूर्णं, हरिद्राचूर्णं, लवणं च मर्दयतु। 30 निमेषान् स्थापयतु। तावत्कालं पात्रम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु।
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.back: Rub curd, Teja red chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt into the chicken. Keep for 30 minutes. For that time cover the vessel and keep it in the refrigerator.

seg.6cceb77cd01b.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.t: 500 g मत्स्यखण्डाः ⟦1⟧दृढमांसः मत्स्यः स्थूलखण्डेषु कर्तितः: रोहितः, कतला (बोच्चा), कोरमीनु (मरेल्), सीर्-मत्स्यः (वंजरम्) वा⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm-fleshed fish cut into thick pieces: rohu, catla (boccha), korameenu (murrel), or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.3248f0a2bb4b.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.t: 40 g चिञ्चा ⟦1⟧प्रायः जम्बीरप्रमाणौ द्वौ गोलौ, 2 चषकेषु कोष्णजलेषु 15 निमेषान् आर्द्रीकृतौ⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups of lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.6efbfa504170.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring, until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.6efbfa504170.t: अवशिष्टम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु 2 दिनेषु च भक्षयतु। स्थाल्याम् अचालयन् मन्दं पुनः तापयतु, यावत् अन्तः अपि सर्वत्र बाष्पायमानम् उष्णं भवति।
seg.6efbfa504170.back: Cover the leftover, keep in the refrigerator and eat within 2 days. In a pan, without stirring, reheat gently until it becomes steaming hot everywhere, even inside.

seg.379b410c6994.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), murrel (korameenu) or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.379b410c6994.t: स्थूलखण्डेषु कर्तिताः नदीसमुद्रयोः दृढमांसाः मत्स्याः: रोहितः, कतला (बोच्चा), मरेल् (कोरमीनु), सीर्-मत्स्यः वा। कण्टकयुक्ताः लघुमत्स्याः अपि उपयुज्यन्ते, किन्तु मृदु व्यवहर्तव्याः।
seg.379b410c6994.back: Firm-fleshed river and sea fish cut into thick pieces: rohu, catla (boccha), murrel (korameenu), or seer fish. Small bony fish are also usable, but must be handled gently.

seg.3af5b68fc2e1.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu in a pan with a splash of water until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.t: अवशिष्टम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु 2 दिनेषु च भक्षयतु। पुलुसुं स्थाल्यां स्वल्पेन जलेन सह तापयतु, यावत् अन्तः अपि सर्वत्र बाष्पायमानम् उष्णं भवति।
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.back: Cover the leftover, keep in the refrigerator and eat within 2 days. Heat the pulusu in a pan with a little water until it becomes steaming hot everywhere, even inside.

seg.b4d28033bb05.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, until tender, then fry it the same way.
seg.b4d28033bb05.t: अजमांस-वेपुडु: 500 g अस्थिरहितम् अजमांसं लेपनेन ½ चषकेण जलेन च सह प्रेशर-कुकरे 5–6 सीत्कारपर्यन्तं, मृदु यावत् भवति तावत् पचतु, ततः तथैव भर्जयतु।
seg.b4d28033bb05.back: Mutton vepudu: cook 500 g boneless goat meat with the marinade and ½ cup of water in a pressure cooker up to 5–6 whistles, until it becomes soft, then fry the same way.

seg.04112853a660.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need 6–8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.04112853a660.t: उभयम् उपयुक्तम्। अस्थिरहितं शीघ्रं पच्यते अधिकं खरं च भवति; सास्थि लघुखण्डेषु अधिकः स्वादः, किन्तु स्वरसे 6–8 निमेषाः अधिकाः लगन्ति।
seg.04112853a660.back: Both are suitable. Boneless cooks quickly and becomes crispier; small bone-in pieces have more flavour, but take 6–8 more minutes in their own juice.

seg.d20a641bec03.src: Pack it for a lunch box or a short journey and eat it within about 4 hours. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them within a day.
seg.d20a641bec03.t: भोजनपेटिकायै लघुयात्रायै वा बद्ध्वा प्रायः 4 होराणाम् अन्तः भक्षयतु। अवशिष्टम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु एकस्मिन् दिने च भक्षयतु।
seg.d20a641bec03.back: If packed for a lunch box or a short journey, eat within about 4 hours. Cover the leftover, keep in the refrigerator and eat within one day.

seg.bc9078e02646.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric last, switch off the stove right after and stir for only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice, off the heat.
seg.bc9078e02646.t: जम्बीररसः पक्वः, अथवा हरिद्रा तैले दग्धा। हरिद्रां सर्वान्ते योजयतु, तत्क्षणं चुल्लीं निर्वापयतु, केवलं 5–10 क्षणान् चालयतु च; जम्बीररसम् अग्नेः बहिः ओदने योजयतु।
seg.bc9078e02646.back: The lemon juice was cooked, or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add turmeric at the very end, put out the stove immediately, and stir only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice off the fire.

seg.c288f67fcabb.src: Pour the other cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan; a thin pan lets the ragi catch.
seg.c288f67fcabb.t: अपरं चषकं जलं स्थूलतलस्थाल्यां पातयतु; तनुस्थाल्यां रागि अधः लगति।
seg.c288f67fcabb.back: Pour the other cup of water into a thick-bottomed pan; in a thin pan the ragi sticks to the bottom.

seg.e87c26125f87.src: Can I use cane jaggery in ragi java?
seg.e87c26125f87.t: रागि जावायाम् इक्षुगुडं प्रयोक्तुं शक्नोमि किम्?
seg.e87c26125f87.back: Can I use sugarcane jaggery in ragi java?

seg.a9a06390a945.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a lighter colour and a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.a9a06390a945.t: आम्। तावत्प्रमाणं घृष्टम् इक्षुगुडं (चेरुकु बेल्लम) गृहीत्वा चुल्लीनिर्वापणात् परं मिश्रयतु, येन दुग्धं न भिद्यते। तत् लघुवर्णं मृदु कैरमेल्-सदृशं माधुर्यं च ददाति।
seg.a9a06390a945.back: Yes. Take the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and mix it in after putting out the stove, so that the milk does not split. It gives a light colour and a mild, caramel-like sweetness.

seg.e7cb15cc47e2.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Reheat in a pan only until steaming hot all the way through; longer reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.t: अवशिष्टम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु 1 दिने च भक्षयतु। स्थाल्यां केवलं तावत् तापयतु यावत् अन्तः अपि सर्वत्र बाष्पायमानम् उष्णं भवति; ततः अधिकेन पुनस्तापनेन चिङ्गटाः कठिनाः भवन्ति।
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.back: Cover the leftover, keep in the refrigerator and eat within 1 day. In a pan heat only until it becomes steaming hot everywhere, even inside; reheating longer than that makes the prawns hard.

seg.ea5408ec0853.src: Can I make sunnundalu with cane jaggery?
seg.ea5408ec0853.back: Can I make sunnundalu with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.ec48010dffbe.src: Yes. Grate the cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus turn lighter in colour, with a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.ec48010dffbe.t: आम्। इक्षुगुडं (चेरुकु बेल्लम) सूक्ष्मं घर्षयतु, तालगुडवत् तावत्प्रमाणं च प्रयुङ्क्ताम्। लड्डुकाः लघुवर्णाः भवन्ति, तेषां माधुर्यं मृदु कैरमेल्-सदृशं च।
seg.ec48010dffbe.back: Yes. Grate sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely, and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus become light-coloured, and their sweetness mild and caramel-like.

seg.767f9e16fa95.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste; keep it in the fridge and eat it within 3 days.
seg.767f9e16fa95.t: अपक्वलशुनम्: तीक्ष्णतरस्वादाय लशुनतापनं त्यजतु; शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु 3 दिनेषु च भक्षयतु।
seg.767f9e16fa95.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper taste skip heating the garlic; keep in the refrigerator and eat within 3 days.

seg.8665687f81ce.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use it within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.8665687f81ce.t: स्वच्छे शुष्के वायुरोधिपात्रे शीतकपेटिकायां रक्षतु 2 सप्ताहेषु च उपयुङ्क्ताम्। सर्वदा शुष्कं चमसं प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.8665687f81ce.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight container in the refrigerator and use within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.367798df40e3.src: Up to 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first, and always use a dry spoon.
seg.367798df40e3.t: शुष्के वायुरोधिपात्रे शीतकपेटिकायां 2 सप्ताहान् यावत्। लशुनं सम्यक् शोषयित्वा प्रथमं तैले तापयतु, सर्वदा शुष्कं चमसं च प्रयुङ्क्ताम्।
seg.367798df40e3.back: Up to 2 weeks in the refrigerator in a dry, airtight container. Dry the garlic thoroughly and first heat it in oil, and always use a dry spoon.

seg.1d41be2d17f9.src: Yes. Roast about 20 dried red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.t: आम्। प्रायः 20 शुष्करक्तमरिचान् कतिपयेषु तैलबिन्दुषु खरत्वपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु, शीतलीकृत्य लशुनयोजनात् पूर्वं पिनष्टु।
seg.1d41be2d17f9.back: Yes. Fry about 20 dry red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool them and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.7099f7c35107.src: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery)⟦/1⟧
seg.7099f7c35107.back: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(sweet flattened rice with palm jaggery)⟦/1⟧

seg.c9c11f5b43da.src: Bellam atukulu is the 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. It is the poha offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, recalling Kuchela's gift, and it is also a quick sweet for children after school. The poha is only rinsed, never cooked in water, and then tossed in warm jaggery syrup.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलु तेलुगु-गृहाणां 10-निमेषात्मकं मिष्टान्नम्। कृष्णाष्टम्यां कृष्णाय एते पृथुकाः अर्प्यन्ते, कुचेलस्य उपहारं स्मारयन्तः; विद्यालयात् आगतेभ्यः बालेभ्यः शीघ्रं मिष्टान्नम् अपि एतत्। पृथुकाः केवलं प्रक्षाल्यन्ते, कदापि जले न पच्यन्ते, ततः ईषदुष्णे गुडपाके मिश्र्यन्ते।
seg.c9c11f5b43da.back: Bellam Atukulu is a 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. On Krishnashtami this flattened rice is offered to Krishna, recalling Kuchela's gift; it is also a quick sweet for children come from school. The flattened rice is only washed, never cooked in water, then mixed in lukewarm jaggery syrup.

seg.8594fedb25dc.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness. This recipe serves 2.
seg.8594fedb25dc.t: अस्माकं ताटि बेल्लम तालगुडः अस्मै गाढं पिङ्गलवर्णं, गाढस्वादु ईषद्धूमस्वादयुक्तं च माधुर्यं ददाति। अनेन पाकविधिना 2 जनेभ्यः पर्याप्तं भवति।
seg.8594fedb25dc.back: Our Tati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a deep-tasting, slightly smoke-flavoured sweetness. By this recipe it is enough for 2 people.

seg.25e28614accb.src: Prep includes 5 minutes for the rinsed poha to soften.
seg.25e28614accb.t: सज्जतायां प्रक्षालितानां पृथुकानां मृदूभवनाय 5 निमेषाः अन्तर्भवन्ति।
seg.25e28614accb.back: Prep includes 5 minutes for the washed flattened rice to soften.

seg.b9dedcd705aa.src: Soften thick poha, toss it in warm palm jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and finish with ghee.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.t: स्थूलपृथुकान् मृदून् कृत्वा नारिकेलेन एलया च सह ईषदुष्णे तालगुडपाके मिश्रयतु, अन्ते घृतं योजयतु।
seg.b9dedcd705aa.back: Soften the thick flattened rice, mix into lukewarm palm jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and add ghee at the end.

seg.04f65369bdaa.back: 1 cup thick flattened rice ⟦1⟧atukulu, about 100 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e13864ccb71f.src: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.back: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧

seg.b78c520dca8d.src: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧white part only⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.back: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧only the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.2d6d2ff14f71.src: ¼ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 2–3 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.back: ¼ teaspoon cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or crushed seeds of 2–3 cardamoms⟦/1⟧

seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.src: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out any bits of husk.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.back: Put the flattened rice in a sieve and pick out the husk pieces.

seg.b0f730c0b062.src: Rinse the poha in a sieve under running water for a few seconds, drain, and leave it for 5 minutes to soften. It should feel soft when pressed, but not wet.
seg.b0f730c0b062.t: पृथुकान् चालन्यां प्रवहज्जलेन कतिपयक्षणान् प्रक्षाल्य, जलं निःस्राव्य, मृदूभवनाय 5 निमेषान् स्थापयतु। निपीडने ते मृदवः भवेयुः, न तु आर्द्राः।
seg.b0f730c0b062.back: Wash the flattened rice in the sieve under running water for a few seconds, let the water drain, and leave 5 minutes to soften. When pressed they should feel soft, but not wet.

seg.0a3e2261d7bc.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.back: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking hard lumps.

seg.d2b892bf70af.src: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back in.
seg.d2b892bf70af.t: तालगुडं 2 महाचमसजलेन सह मन्दाग्नौ द्रावयित्वा गालयतु। स्थालीं मार्जयित्वा पाकं पुनः तस्यां पातयतु।
seg.d2b892bf70af.back: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 tablespoons of water on low flame, then strain. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back into it.

seg.d073ead78aef.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden.
seg.d073ead78aef.t: यदि काजूतकानि प्रयुङ्क्ते, तानि स्वल्पे घृते यावत् स्वर्णवर्णानि भवन्ति तावत् भर्जयतु।
seg.d073ead78aef.back: If using cashews, fry them in a little ghee until golden.

seg.62c17a0f01a5.src: Add the poha, coconut and cardamom to the warm syrup and toss gently on a low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every flake is coated. Use a light hand so the flakes do not break.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.t: ईषदुष्णे पाके पृथुकान्, नारिकेलम्, एलां च योजयित्वा मन्दाग्नौ 1–2 निमेषान् मृदु मिश्रयतु, यावत् प्रत्येकः पृथुकः पाकेन आवृतः भवति। लघुहस्तेन मिश्रयतु येन पृथुकाः न भज्येरन्।
seg.62c17a0f01a5.back: Add the flattened rice, coconut and cardamom to the lukewarm syrup and gently mix on low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every flake is coated with syrup. Work with a light hand so the flakes do not break.

seg.d1abe3d7557d.src: Take the pan off the heat as soon as the flakes are coated; longer cooking makes them chewy.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.t: यदा एव पृथुकाः आवृताः भवन्ति, तदा एव स्थालीम् अग्नेः अवतारयतु; अधिककालपाकेन ते दुश्चर्व्याः भवन्ति।
seg.d1abe3d7557d.back: Only when the flakes are coated, only then take the pan off the fire; by cooking longer they become hard to chew.

seg.c91ffab6359d.src: Finish with the ghee and cashews. Serve warm or at room temperature.
seg.c91ffab6359d.t: घृतं काजूतकानि च योजयित्वा समापयतु। ईषदुष्णं वा कक्षतापमाने वा परिवेषयतु।
seg.c91ffab6359d.back: Finish by adding ghee and cashews. Serve lukewarm or at room temperature.

seg.544ea222a497.src: Use thick poha. Thin poha turns mushy in the syrup.
seg.544ea222a497.t: स्थूलपृथुकान् प्रयुङ्क्ताम्। तनुपृथुकाः पाके अतिमृदवः पिण्डीभवन्ति।
seg.544ea222a497.back: Use thick flattened rice. Thin flattened rice becomes too soft and lumps together in the syrup.

seg.0f56d718ca89.src: Do not soak the poha in a bowl of water; a quick rinse is enough, or it turns soft and sticky.
seg.0f56d718ca89.t: पृथुकान् जलपात्रे न निमज्जयतु; शीघ्रं प्रक्षालनम् एव पर्याप्तम्, अन्यथा ते अतिमृदवः श्लेषयुक्ताः च भवन्ति।
seg.0f56d718ca89.back: Do not immerse the flattened rice in a vessel of water; a quick wash alone is enough, otherwise they become too soft and sticky.

seg.972f174730fe.src: Keep the syrup warm, not bubbling, when the poha goes in, so the flakes coat evenly.
seg.972f174730fe.t: पृथुकाः यदा पाके योज्यन्ते तदा पाकः ईषदुष्णः भवेत्, न तु क्वथन्, येन पृथुकाः समम् आवृताः भवेयुः।
seg.972f174730fe.back: Keep the syrup lukewarm, not boiling, when adding the flattened rice, so that every flake gets coated evenly with syrup.

seg.8496cfe4aa1d.src: With milk: pour 2–3 tbsp warm milk over the finished poha for a softer sweet.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.t: दुग्धेन: मृदुतराय मिष्टान्नाय सिद्धेषु पृथुकेषु 2–3 महाचमसान् ईषदुष्णं दुग्धं सिञ्चतु।
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.back: With milk: for a softer sweet, sprinkle 2–3 tablespoons of lukewarm milk on the finished flattened rice.

seg.bb5e4ee879e6.src: With sesame: add 1 tbsp roasted sesame seeds along with the coconut.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.t: तिलैः: नारिकेलेन सह 1 महाचमसं भृष्टतिलान् योजयतु।
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.back: With sesame: add 1 tablespoon of roasted sesame along with the coconut.

seg.25d7247d3c7b.src: Serve it as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or as a quick sweet for children after school.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.t: कृष्णाष्टम्यां नैवेद्यरूपेण परिवेषयतु, अथवा विद्यालयात् आगतेभ्यः बालेभ्यः शीघ्रं मिष्टान्नरूपेण ददातु।
seg.25d7247d3c7b.back: Serve as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or give to children after school as a quick sweet.

seg.1170385c1b79.src: Best eaten the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them the next day; the poha firms up as it stands.
seg.1170385c1b79.t: निर्माणदिने एव भक्षणं श्रेष्ठम्। अवशिष्टम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु, परदिने च भक्षयतु; स्थिताः पृथुकाः कठिनतराः भवन्ति।
seg.1170385c1b79.back: Best eaten the same day it is made. Cover the leftover, keep in the fridge and eat the next day; when kept, the flattened rice becomes hard.

seg.6acb206e9df4.src: Which poha is best for bellam atukulu?
seg.6acb206e9df4.back: Which flattened rice is best for Bellam Atukulu?

seg.7cb97f8423cf.src: Thick poha (atukulu). It holds its shape in the warm syrup; thin poha turns mushy.
seg.7cb97f8423cf.t: स्थूलपृथुकाः (अटुकुलु)। ते ईषदुष्णे पाके स्वाकारं रक्षन्ति; तनुपृथुकाः अतिमृदवः पिण्डीभवन्ति।
seg.7cb97f8423cf.back: Thick flattened rice (atukulu). They keep their own shape in lukewarm syrup; thin flattened rice becomes too soft and lumps together.

seg.ba8eb1721096.src: Can I make bellam atukulu with cane jaggery?
seg.ba8eb1721096.t: किम् इक्षुगुडेन बेल्लम अटुकुलु निर्मातुं शक्यते?
seg.ba8eb1721096.back: Can Bellam Atukulu be made with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.2a1aa941db07.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam). It turns lighter in colour, with a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.2a1aa941db07.t: आम्। तावन्तम् एव घृष्टम् इक्षुगुडं (चेरुकु बेल्लम) प्रयुङ्क्ताम्। तस्य वर्णः लघुतरः भवति, माधुर्यं च कैरमेल्-सदृशम्।
seg.2a1aa941db07.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (Cheruku Bellam). The colour is lighter, and the sweetness caramel-like.

seg.88008fa2d0e6.src: Why is my bellam atukulu sticky?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.t: मम बेल्लम अटुकुलु किमर्थं श्लेषयुक्ताः जाताः?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.back: Why did my Bellam Atukulu become sticky?

seg.a6945e480c9a.src: The poha was soaked or cooked too long. Rinse it for only a few seconds, and take the pan off the heat as soon as every flake is coated.
seg.a6945e480c9a.t: पृथुकाः निमज्जिताः अतिदीर्घकालं पक्वाः वा। केवलं कतिपयक्षणान् प्रक्षालयतु, यदा एव प्रत्येकः पृथुकः आवृतः भवति, तदा एव स्थालीम् अग्नेः अवतारयतु।
seg.a6945e480c9a.back: The flattened rice was soaked or cooked too long. Wash it only a few seconds, and as soon as every flake is coated with syrup, take the pan off the flame immediately.

seg.d4c0fab65bf7.src: Why is it made on Krishnashtami?
seg.d4c0fab65bf7.back: Why is this made on Krishnashtami?

seg.51ab1914ac8d.src: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who brought a handful of poha to his friend Krishna as his only gift.
seg.51ab1914ac8d.t: एतत् कुचेलस्य कथां स्मारयति, यः स्वमित्राय कृष्णाय एकमात्रम् उपहाररूपेण मुष्टिमात्रान् पृथुकान् आनीतवान्।
seg.51ab1914ac8d.back: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who brought a handful of flattened rice to his friend Krishna as his only gift.

seg.5080241b3883.src: బెల్లం అటుకులు. Andhra bellam atukulu: thick poha tossed in warm Thati Bellam palm jaggery syrup with coconut, cardamom and ghee. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and FAQs.
seg.5080241b3883.t: బెల్లం అటుకులు. आन्ध्र-बेल्लम अटुकुलु: ईषदुष्णे ताटि बेल्लम तालगुडपाके नारिकेलेन, एलया, घृतेन च सह मिश्रिताः स्थूलपृथुकाः। 10-निमेषात्मकं मिष्टान्नम्, सूचनाभिः प्रश्नोत्तरैः च सह।
seg.5080241b3883.back: Bellam Atukulu. Andhra Bellam Atukulu: thick flattened rice mixed with coconut, cardamom and ghee in lukewarm Tati Bellam palm jaggery syrup. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and questions-and-answers.

seg.4239bed21420.src: Bellam Atukulu (Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery) · 1acrefarms
seg.4239bed21420.back: Bellam Atukulu (sweet flattened rice with palm jaggery) · 1acrefarms

seg.8dafb14d8ade.src: Bellam Atukulu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.8dafb14d8ade.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलु: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह
